zh_title: 编码代理强化学习中的部署基础设施税
translation: 编码代理强化学习将执行基础设施视为背景实现细节，尽管它依赖于大量的交互式软件部署。这是一个被错失的机会：衡量基础设施开销可以为强化学习训练后阶段揭示实际的效率提升，其中每次部署节省的小量时间会随着规模扩大而累积。我们对四种执行底座进行了对比研究：单容器、托管沙盒、Kubernetes编排容器和云虚拟机。我们发现冷启动延迟的变化高达110倍，在一百万条150步轨迹的情况下，预计工作时数存在1.8倍的差距。我们的结果表明，未来的编码代理强化学习系统应该将执行底座作为训练系统本身的一部分进行优化，而不仅仅是作为部署管道。
tldr: 通过对比四种执行底座，发现基础设施选择对编码代理强化学习的效率影响巨大（延迟差异高达110倍），证明了将基础设施纳入训练系统优化范畴的必要性。
ai_comments: 该论文通过量化不同执行基础设施对编码代理强化学习的影响，强调了基础设施选择在RL训练过程中的重要性，这在以往的研究中常被忽视。其创新点在于将基础设施视为性能优化的核心部分而非单纯的后台配置，为大规模RL训练提供了实用的工程指导。
motivation: 编码代理强化学习依赖大量交互式软件运行，但目前将执行基础设施视为背景细节，忽视了其在训练效率上的优化空间，导致了性能浪费。
method: 对四种执行底座（单容器、托管沙盒、Kubernetes编排容器、云虚拟机）进行了对比研究，测量了冷启动延迟以及一百万条150步轨迹下的预计工作时数。
results: 发现不同执行底座在冷启动延迟上存在高达110倍的差异，在一百万条轨迹的规模下，工作时数存在1.8倍的差距。
conclusion: 编码代理的强化学习系统应将执行基础设施作为训练系统优化的关键组成部分，而非仅仅视为部署工具，以实现显著的效率提升。

title: BIFROST: Bridging Invariant Feature Representation for Observation-space Sim2Real Transfer
authors: Yunfu Deng, Josiah P. Hanna
abstract: Sim2real transfer for robot policy learning suffers due to mismatch between simulation and reality. Existing methods typically address each gap in isolation through separate adaptation modules, which are composed or layered when both gaps coexist. Yet the basis for attempting sim2real in the first place is that there is shared structure between a task in simulation and reality, where equivalent actions from equivalent configurations produce equivalent long term outcomes regardless of domain specific differences in rendering or physics. In this paper, we study whether we can identify and exploit this shared structure from raw observations to train a policy that enables zero shot transfer. We introduce BIFROST, which learns a shared history encoder on paired cross-domain data via cross-domain bisimulation objective: observation-action sequences leading to equivalent long-term behavior are mapped to nearby latent states, regardless of domain. Policies trained on these latent states in simulation transfer zero-shot to reality. We provide empirical evidence on sim2sim visual navigation and sim2real contact rich manipulation task and visual servoing task that BIFROST achieves effective transfer where domain adaptation and co-training baselines fail under both visual and dynamics domain gaps.
zh_title: BIFROST：连接观测空间Sim2Real迁移的不变特征表征
translation: 机器人策略学习中的Sim2Real迁移因模拟与现实之间的差异而受到阻碍。现有的方法通常通过独立的适应模块来分别处理每种差异，当两种差异共存时，这些模块会被组合或分层使用。然而，进行Sim2Real的根本基础在于模拟环境与现实环境的任务之间存在共享结构，即无论渲染或物理差异如何，等价配置下的等价动作都会产生等价的长期结果。在本文中，我们研究了是否可以从原始观测中识别并利用这种共享结构，以训练出能够实现零样本迁移的策略。我们介绍了BIFROST，它通过跨域双模拟目标在成对的跨域数据上学习共享的历史编码器：无论领域如何，导致等价长期行为的观测-动作序列被映射到相近的潜在状态。在模拟中基于这些潜在状态训练的策略可以零样本迁移到现实中。我们在模拟到模拟的视觉导航、模拟到现实的接触丰富操作任务以及视觉伺服任务上提供了实证证据，证明了在视觉和动力学领域差异下，当领域自适应和联合训练基准失效时，BIFROST仍能实现有效的迁移。
tldr: BIFROST通过学习跨域行为等价性，使得机器人策略能够直接从模拟环境零样本迁移到现实环境。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了“跨域双模拟（cross-domain bisimulation）”目标，利用行为等价性而非仅仅是视觉或物理参数的匹配来对齐模拟与现实。这种方法为解决Sim2Real中的结构性差异提供了一个优雅的统一视角，尤其在处理复杂接触任务时表现出优于传统领域自适应方法的鲁棒性。
motivation: 现有的Sim2Real方法通常针对视觉或物理差异分别处理，难以同时解决多种领域差异。作者认为模拟与现实之间存在共享的结构（即等价配置下的等价操作产生等价结果），旨在利用这种结构实现零样本迁移。
method: 提出BIFROST框架，通过跨域双模拟目标学习一个共享的历史编码器。该方法将导致等价长期行为的观测-动作序列映射到相近的潜在状态，从而使策略在模拟中训练后可直接迁移至现实。
results: 在模拟到模拟的视觉导航、模拟到现实的接触丰富操作任务以及视觉伺服任务中，BIFROST表现出卓越的迁移能力，优于现有的领域自适应和联合训练基准方法。
conclusion: BIFROST通过学习跨域共享的潜在空间，成功实现了机器人策略在模拟到现实环境中的零样本迁移，证明了捕捉行为等价结构比简单的领域对齐更为有效。

title: GPUAlert: A Zero-Instrumentation Process-Boundary Monitor for Diagnosing GPU Training-Job Failures
authors: Parv Agarwal, Asif Ekbal
abstract: GPU training jobs fail often, roughly two in five on large production clusters, yet the operator typically learns of a failure only by reconnecting hours later. Experiment trackers require editing the training script and maintaining a cloud connection; the scheduler's mail hook delivers a single status line with no cause and no logs. GPUAlert is a command-line wrapper that monitors any training command at the process boundary, and with no change to that command, emails a structured notification on completion carrying a classified failure cause, durable logs, and output artifacts. The tool is organized around three reliability primitives: a pre-launch log guarantee that establishes the durable destination before the child process can crash, notifier isolation that makes the wrapper's exit code a pure function of the child's status regardless of whether the email succeeds, and a non-silent artifact budget that bounds attachment size without ever dropping output silently. We release a labelled corpus of 474 GPU training logs across 15 failure classes and a reproducible evaluation harness. On the twelve hardware-reproduced classes, the ordered-rule classifier reaches 0.997 macro-F1, against 0.830 for unordered keyword matching and 0.133 for exit-code inspection. Wrapper overhead is a constant approximately 3ms per job; the pre-launch guarantee preserves a log where a shell redirect yields nothing; and across all 15 failure modes the wrapper returns the child's exit code unchanged even when the SMTP relay is unreachable.
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables,3 Listings. Submitted as an arXiv preprint. Source, corpus and evaluation harness available at https://github.com/Parv-01/gpualert and https://github.com/Parv-01/gpualert-eval
zh_title: GPUAlert：一种用于诊断 GPU 训练作业故障的零侵入进程边界监控器
translation: GPU 训练任务经常失败，在大规模生产集群中大约每五次就有两次失败，然而操作员通常在数小时后重新连接时才知道失败。实验追踪器需要编辑训练脚本并维持云连接；调度器的邮件挂钩仅提供一行没有原因和日志的状态信息。GPUAlert 是一个命令行包装器，它在进程边界监控任何训练命令，无需更改该命令，即可在完成时发送结构化通知，包含分类的故障原因、持久化日志和输出工件。该工具围绕三个可靠性原语进行组织：预启动日志保证，在子进程崩溃前建立持久化目的地；通知器隔离，使包装器的退出代码成为子进程状态的纯函数，无论电子邮件是否发送成功；以及非静默工件预算，在不静默丢弃输出的情况下限制附件大小。我们发布了一个包含 474 个 GPU 训练日志的标注语料库，涵盖 15 个故障类别和一个可复现的评估工具。在 12 个硬件复现的类别上，有序规则分类器达到了 0.997 的 Macro-F1，而无序关键词匹配为 0.830，退出代码检查为 0.133。包装器开销约为每个作业 3ms；预启动保证在 shell 重定向无法获得日志的情况下保留了日志；在所有 15 种故障模式中，即便 SMTP 中继不可达，包装器仍能原样返回子进程的退出代码。
tldr: GPUAlert 是一款无需修改代码的 GPU 训练监控工具，能自动进行故障分类并发送详细通知，显著提升了运维响应效率。
ai_comments: 该论文针对GPU训练任务故障诊断这一痛点，提出了一种零侵入（Zero-Instrumentation）的监控方案。其核心创新在于通过进程边界监控和三种可靠性原语（预启动日志保证、通知器隔离、非静默工件预算），在不修改代码的前提下实现了高效、可靠的故障自动诊断与通知。该工具对于提升大型生产集群的运维效率具有显著的实用价值，其提供的带标注日志语料库也为该领域后续研究提供了宝贵资源。
motivation: GPU 训练任务在生产集群中失败率高，且现有工具（如实验追踪器或调度器邮件通知）存在需要修改代码、依赖云连接或无法提供详细故障原因和日志的缺陷，导致运维人员无法及时获取有效的故障反馈。
method: 提出一种名为 GPUAlert 的命令行包装器，通过进程边界监控训练任务。核心技术包括：1. 预启动日志保证（pre-launch log guarantee）；2. 通知器隔离（notifier isolation）；3. 非静默工件预算（non-silent artifact budget）。采用有序规则分类器对故障进行分类。
results: 在 12 个硬件复现的故障类别上，有序规则分类器达到了 0.997 的 Macro-F1 分数；包装器开销极低（约 3ms/作业）；即便在 SMTP 中继不可达的情况下，也能保持子进程的退出状态码，并成功保留关键日志。
conclusion: GPUAlert 通过零侵入的进程边界监控，有效解决了 GPU 训练任务故障诊断难、响应慢的问题，在保持极低开销的同时，实现了高准确率的故障分类与可靠的日志记录。

title: Spin-Weighted Spherical Harmonics Enable Complete and Scalable $\mathrm{E}(3)$-Equivariant Networks
authors: Chenxing Liang, Yuchao Lin, Andrii Kryvenko, Wendi Yu, Chuan Li, Jianwen Xie, Xiaofeng Qian, Shuiwang Ji
abstract: $\mathrm{E}(3)$-equivariant networks are promising for 3D atomistic system modeling, yet their scalability is limited by the $O(L^6)$ complexity of the Clebsch-Gordan Tensor Product (CGTP). The recently proposed Gaunt Tensor Product (GTP) reduces the complexity but is unable to capture the antisymmetric paths, resulting in incomplete expressivity. In this work, we present SpinGTP, an approach to overcome the GTP incompleteness by generalizing from scalar functions to Spin-Weighted Spherical Harmonics (SWSH). By relying on the algebraic properties of SWSH, SpinGTP recovers the missing antisymmetric interactions while maintaining the asymptotic efficiency of GTP. It also allows for a more expressive equivariant basis that naturally accounts for the parity-odd components of tensor products. We evaluate SpinGTP across diverse benchmarks, including Tetris, 3BPA, SPICE-MACE-OFF, and OC20. Our results show that SpinGTP achieves accuracies comparable to full CGTP. Notably, by explicitly capturing antisymmetric paths, SpinGTP exhibits superior performance in tasks involving chiral materials and non-centrosymmetric geometries. This work provides a complete, scalable, and mathematically rigorous path toward high-order equivariance in large-scale 3D atomistic system simulations.
zh_title: 自旋加权球谐函数实现完整且可扩展的 E(3)-等变网络
translation: E(3)-等变网络在 3D 原子系统建模方面极具前景，但其可扩展性受到 Clebsch-Gordan 张量积（CGTP）O(L^6) 复杂度的限制。最近提出的 Gaunt 张量积（GTP）降低了复杂度，但无法捕捉反对称路径，导致表达能力不完整。在这项工作中，我们提出了 SpinGTP，这是一种通过将标量函数推广到自旋加权球谐函数（SWSH）来克服 GTP 不完整性的方法。通过利用 SWSH 的代数特性，SpinGTP 在保持 GTP 渐近效率的同时恢复了缺失的反对称交互。它还允许使用更具表达能力的等变基，自然地考虑了张量积的奇宇称分量。我们在包括 Tetris、3BPA、SPICE-MACE-OFF 和 OC20 在内的多种基准测试中评估了 SpinGTP。结果表明，SpinGTP 达到了与全 CGTP 相当的精度。值得注意的是，通过明确捕捉反对称路径，SpinGTP 在涉及手性材料和非中心对称几何的任务中表现出卓越的性能。这项工作为大规模 3D 原子系统模拟中的高阶等变性提供了一条完整、可扩展且数学上严谨的途径。
tldr: SpinGTP 通过利用自旋加权球谐函数，在保持高效计算的同时，补全了等变网络中缺失的反对称交互，显著提升了对复杂原子系统的建模能力。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入自旋加权球谐函数（SWSH）巧妙地解决了高效张量积（GTP）在表达能力上的缺失问题。这种方法不仅保持了计算的高效性，还通过数学上的严谨性补全了反对称交互，对于处理手性材料和非中心对称几何结构具有重要意义。这是一个在保证计算可扩展性的同时提升模型表达能力的优秀范例。
motivation: 现有的 E(3)-等变网络在处理 3D 原子系统时，全 Clebsch-Gordan 张量积（CGTP）计算成本过高（O(L^6)），而现有的高效方案 Gaunt 张量积（GTP）又因无法捕捉反对称路径导致表达能力不完整。
method: 提出了 SpinGTP 方法，通过将标量函数推广到自旋加权球谐函数（SWSH），利用其代数特性恢复了缺失的反对称交互，同时维持了 GTP 的渐近计算效率。
results: 在 Tetris、3BPA、SPICE-MACE-OFF 和 OC20 等多个基准测试中，SpinGTP 的准确性达到了与全 CGTP 相当的水平，且在处理手性材料和非中心对称几何任务中表现出显著优势。
conclusion: SpinGTP 成功实现了在保持高效计算的同时，对 E(3)-等变网络进行完整且具有高表达能力的扩展，为大规模 3D 原子系统模拟提供了一种强大的新工具。

title: Conditional Inference Trees and Forests for Feature Selection
authors: Robert Milletich, Justin Downes, Steve Goley, Newel Hirst
abstract: Conditional inference trees (CIT) and conditional inference forests (CIF) reduce split-selection bias by testing features before choosing split thresholds, but repeated permutation tests and threshold searches can make these methods computationally expensive. We study CIT and CIF as top-$k$ feature-ranking methods for downstream prediction using real-data benchmarks, runtime ablations, and synthetic feature-recovery experiments. At a fixed node, if the features and permutation budget do not depend on the node responses, Bonferroni-corrected $+1$ Monte Carlo permutation $p$-values control nodewise rejection under the complete permutation null. CIF ranks 4th among 17 classification methods on 22 datasets and 3rd among 18 regression methods on 8 datasets. With Bonferroni correction held fixed, the CIF runtime ablations indicate that adaptive stopping and the number of thresholds searched have the largest measured effect on runtime: turning off adaptive stopping and using exact threshold search increase fitting time by 4.0--8.4$\times$ and 1.9--10.8$\times$, respectively, while downstream score changes are at most 0.011. Sparse high-$p$ simulations indicate that forest feature sampling can leave informative features out of many split decisions. Overall, the results support CIF as a top-$k$ feature-ranking method in the evaluated downstream prediction benchmarks.
zh_title: 用于特征选择的条件推理树与森林
translation: 条件推理树（CIT）和条件推理森林（CIF）通过在选择分裂阈值之前对特征进行检验来减少分裂选择偏差，但重复的置换检验和阈值搜索可能使这些方法计算成本高昂。我们通过真实数据基准、运行时间消融实验和合成特征恢复实验，研究了CIT和CIF作为下游预测的top-k特征排序方法。在固定节点处，如果特征和置换预算不依赖于节点响应，则经Bonferroni校正的+1蒙特卡洛置换p值可以在完全置换零假设下控制节点级的拒绝率。CIF在22个数据集的17种分类方法中排名第4，在8个数据集的18种回归方法中排名第3。在保持Bonferroni校正不变的情况下，CIF运行时间消融实验表明，自适应停止和搜索的阈值数量对运行时间影响最大：关闭自适应停止和使用精确阈值搜索分别使拟合时间增加了4.0-8.4倍和1.9-10.8倍，而下游得分变化最多仅为0.011。稀疏高p模拟表明，森林特征采样可能会在许多分裂决策中遗漏信息丰富的特征。总体而言，研究结果支持CIF作为评估下游预测基准中的top-k特征排序方法。
tldr: 本文评估了条件推理森林（CIF）在特征选择中的表现，证明其作为特征排序方法非常有效，并指出通过调整参数可显著降低计算成本且不影响预测精度。
ai_comments: 该论文通过实证研究探讨了条件推理森林（CIF）在特征选择中的有效性和计算效率。其创新之处在于对CIF作为特征排序工具的性能进行了系统性评估，并量化了不同参数设置（如自适应停止和阈值搜索）对计算成本与预测性能的影响，为实际应用提供了重要的配置指南。
motivation: 条件推理树（CIT）和条件推理森林（CIF）虽然能减少分裂选择偏差，但由于其重复的置换检验和阈值搜索过程，计算成本较高，需要对其作为特征排序方法的效用进行深入评估。
method: 通过在多个真实数据集和合成数据集上进行基准测试、运行时间消融实验和特征恢复实验，评估CIT和CIF作为top-k特征排序方法的表现，并分析Bonferroni校正、自适应停止和阈值搜索对性能的影响。
results: CIF在分类和回归任务的基准测试中均名列前茅。实验表明，关闭自适应停止和使用精确阈值搜索会大幅增加运行时间（分别增加4.0-8.4倍和1.9-10.8倍），但对下游任务的预测得分影响极小（最大变化为0.011）。此外，森林的特征采样机制可能导致部分信息特征在分裂决策中被遗漏。
conclusion: CIF是一种有效的top-k特征排序方法，其性能在多种基准测试中表现优异。尽管计算成本较高，但通过调整参数（如自适应停止和阈值搜索空间）可以在几乎不损失预测精度的情况下显著提升运行效率。

title: Beyond Heatmaps: Unsupervised Concept-Graph Reasoning for Interpretable Visual Explanation
authors: Md Mohasin Hossain, Anar Amirli, Robert Leist, Md Abdul Kadir, Daniel Sonntag
abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) provide an intrinsically interpretable alternative to post-hoc explanations. However, existing CBMs often rely on predefined concept vocabularies or supervised annotations, lack explicit concept grounding, and summarize each concept with a single image-level score -- discarding spatial recurrence and inter-concept dependencies. We propose a Graph-based Concept Bottleneck Model (G-CBM), an intrinsically interpretable framework that performs unsupervised concept discovery via Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) and represents the discovered concepts as nodes in a per-image concept-graph representation. G-CBM matches region-level features to these concept nodes -- providing concept grounding and capturing concept recurrence across the image -- and applies a \emph{tunable concept filtering threshold} $τ$ to suppress weak region-level features. A Graph Attention Network (GAT) then performs concept-level reasoning by modeling nonlinear dependencies across nodes. Across ImageNet, HAM10000, PH2, and Derm7pt, G-CBM achieves an average relative AUC improvement of 3.7\% over a ResNet-50 baseline. Concept filtering frequently improves predictive performance while inducing selective concept use, achieving peak AUC of $0.96$ on PH2 with only 2 of 10 concepts and 0.92 on HAM10000 with 3.8 of 9 concepts. On dermoscopy benchmarks, G-CBM is competitive with supervised approaches requiring external annotations. Deletion/insertion analyses with random ablation controls show that the learned concept ranking faithfully reflects model predictions.
comment: Accepted at the IJCAI-ECAI 2026 Workshop on Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI), Bremen, Germany. 7 pages, 4 figures
zh_title: 超越热力图：用于可解释视觉解释的无监督概念图推理
translation: 概念瓶颈模型（CBM）提供了一种比事后解释更具内在可解释性的替代方案。然而，现有的 CBM 通常依赖于预定义的词汇表或监督注释，缺乏明确的概念基础，并且仅用单个图像级分数来总结每个概念——从而丢弃了空间重复性和概念间的依赖关系。我们提出了一种基于图的概念瓶颈模型（G-CBM），这是一个内在可解释的框架，通过非负矩阵分解（NMF）执行无监督概念发现，并将发现的概念表示为每张图像概念图中的节点。G-CBM 将区域级特征与这些概念节点匹配，从而提供概念基础并捕捉图像中的概念重复性，并应用可调的概念过滤阈值 $\tau$ 来抑制弱区域级特征。随后，图注意力网络（GAT）通过建模节点间的非线性依赖关系来执行概念级推理。在 ImageNet、HAM10000、PH2 和 Derm7pt 数据集上，G-CBM 相比 ResNet-50 基线实现了 3.7% 的平均相对 AUC 提升。概念过滤在诱导选择性概念使用的同时，经常能提高预测性能，在 PH2 上仅使用 10 个概念中的 2 个即可达到 0.96 的峰值 AUC，在 HAM10000 上使用 9 个概念中的 3.8 个即可达到 0.92。在皮肤镜检查基准测试中，G-CBM 与需要外部注释的监督方法具有竞争力。结合随机消融控制的删除/插入分析表明，学习到的概念排名忠实地反映了模型预测。
tldr: 提出一种无需人工标注的 G-CBM 模型，通过无监督概念发现和图推理实现高性能的图像分类与可解释性。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入图神经网络和无监督概念发现，成功克服了传统概念瓶颈模型（CBM）过度依赖人工标注和缺乏空间依赖建模的局限性。其最大的创新点在于将空间概念映射为图结构，不仅增强了可解释性，还在多个医学影像数据集上达到了与监督学习方法相当的性能，具有很高的临床应用价值。
motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型（CBM）高度依赖预定义词汇或人工标注，且往往忽略了概念的空间分布特性及概念间的复杂依赖关系，导致解释性与性能受限。
method: 提出一种基于图的概念瓶颈模型（G-CBM），利用非负矩阵分解（NMF）进行无监督概念发现，将图像表示为概念图，并通过图注意力网络（GAT）对概念间的非线性依赖关系进行推理，同时引入可调阈值进行概念过滤。
results: 在 ImageNet 及多个医学数据集（HAM10000, PH2, Derm7pt）上，G-CBM 相比 ResNet-50 基线平均 AUC 提升 3.7%，且在仅使用少量概念的情况下即可达到极高的预测准确率，展现了优于或等同于监督学习方法的性能。
conclusion: G-CBM 框架证明了无需人工标注即可通过无监督概念发现和图推理实现高性能且具备可解释性的图像分类，为可解释 AI 提供了一种高效的替代方案。

title: On Reconstructing a Convex Polygon from Partial Information
authors: Alexander Baumann, Therese Biedl, Mahmoud Elashmawi, Simon D. Fink, Maria Saumell, André Schulz
abstract: The reconstruction problem asks to construct a (convex) polygon that has a specified set of features, such as an ordered set of edge-lengths or an ordered set of polygon-angles. In this paper, we do a systematic exploration of the reconstruction problem in all scenarios where one or two sets of features have been specified. Some of these scenarios were well-studied already, for some we develop testing-algorithms and/or hardness results, and many give rise to interesting open problems for future study.
zh_title: 关于从部分信息重构凸多边形的研究
translation: 重构问题要求构建一个具有指定特征集（如一组有序的边长或一组有序的多边形角）的（凸）多边形。在本文中，我们对所有指定了一或两个特征集的场景下的重构问题进行了系统性探索。其中一些场景已被深入研究，对于另一些场景，我们开发了测试算法和/或硬度结果，且许多场景为未来的研究提供了有趣的开放性问题。
tldr: 本文系统地分析了根据特定边长或角度特征重构凸多边形的问题，涵盖了多种特征组合场景，并提供了算法与复杂度分析。
ai_comments: 该论文对凸多边形重构问题进行了系统性的分类研究，涵盖了多种特征组合场景，既有对已知问题的梳理，也提供了新的算法测试和计算复杂度分析，为几何重构领域提供了清晰的研究框架，但部分场景仍处于开放研究阶段。
motivation: 旨在系统地解决给定特定特征集（如边长或角）时，如何重构凸多边形的问题，并填补现有研究在某些特征组合场景下的空白。
method: 系统性分类探索法，结合已有的研究结论，开发新的测试算法，并分析相关问题的计算硬度。
results: 论文梳理了所有涉及一或两个特征集的重构场景，针对部分场景提出了测试算法，针对另一些场景证明了计算硬度，并提出了多个值得未来研究的开放性问题。
conclusion: 论文对凸多边形重构问题进行了全面的系统性探索，明确了不同特征组合下的可解性与计算复杂性，并指出了未来研究的方向。

title: Adoption and Impact of Command-Line AI Coding Agents: A Study of Microsoft's Early 2026 Rollout of Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI
authors: Emerson Murphy-Hill, Jenna Butler, Alexandra Savelieva
abstract: Organizations rolling out agentic command line tools like Anthropic's Claude Code and GitHub's Copilot CLI need to know who will try them, who will keep using them, and whether the tools produce enough output to justify their cost. At organizational scale, token spend can run into millions of dollars annually, so misreading adoption, retention, or impact can make a rollout expensive without changing engineering velocity. Studying tens of thousands of engineers at Microsoft over its early-2026 rollout, we find that first use spread primarily through social networks, retention was associated more with engineers' coding activity than with demographics, and adopters merged roughly 24% more pull requests than they would have otherwise. We use merged pull requests as our proxy for output -- acknowledging that a merged PR is not the same as the value it delivers -- and the lift persists across our four-month window. These results suggest that CLI coding agents are neither uniformly adopted nor mere novelty effects and that organizations should treat visible peer use as central to rollout strategy.
zh_title: 命令行AI编程代理的采纳与影响：以微软2026年初部署Claude Code和GitHub Copilot CLI为例的研究
translation: 组织在推广Anthropic的Claude Code和GitHub Copilot CLI等代理式命令行工具时，需要了解哪些人会尝试、哪些人会持续使用，以及这些工具产生的产出是否足以抵消成本。在组织规模下，Token消耗每年可能高达数百万美元，因此如果对采纳率、留存率或影响评估失误，可能会导致部署成本高昂且无法提升工程速度。通过研究微软2026年初大规模部署期间的数万名工程师，我们发现工具的使用主要是通过社交网络传播的；留存率更多地与工程师的编码活动相关，而非人口统计学特征；采纳者合并的Pull Request数量比原本预期增加了约24%。我们将合并的Pull Request作为产出代理（尽管承认合并的PR不等同于其交付的价值），并发现这种提升在四个月的观察期内持续存在。这些结果表明，命令行编程代理既不是统一被采纳的，也不是仅仅昙花一现，组织应将可见的同行使用作为推广策略的核心。
tldr: 通过分析微软数万名工程师的数据，研究发现命令行AI编程代理能显著提升24%的Pull Request合并量，且其采纳主要由社交网络驱动。
ai_comments: 该研究通过大规模实证分析，为理解AI编程代理在企业环境中的实际价值提供了重要证据。其创新点在于将社交网络作为采纳驱动因素的量化研究，并针对企业级部署的成本效益进行了实证评估。局限性在于仅使用合并Pull Request作为生产力代理指标，可能无法完全反映代码质量或业务价值。
motivation: 组织在部署昂贵的AI代理工具时，缺乏关于谁会采纳、谁会留存以及投资回报率的实证依据，大规模部署的成本风险极高。
method: 基于微软2026年初大规模部署Claude Code和GitHub Copilot CLI的数据，通过对数万名工程师的观察，分析了工具的采纳路径、留存因素以及对合并Pull Request数量（作为生产力代理）的影响。
results: 研究发现，工具采纳主要通过社交网络传播；留存率与工程师的编码活跃度强相关，而非人口统计学特征；使用该工具的工程师合并的Pull Request数量比对照组增加了约24%，且这种提升在四个月的观察期内持续存在。
conclusion: 命令行AI编程代理并非昙花一现的“新鲜事物”，它们能显著提升工程产出。企业在部署此类工具时，应重点利用内部社交网络的影响力来推动采纳。

title: Risk Architecture for AI-Native Engineering Teams: An Organizational Framework for Agentic System Governance
authors: Laxmipriya Ganesh Iyer
abstract: Engineering management research has produced mature frameworks for software risk: ownership by feature, escalation by severity, and assurance by test coverage. These frameworks implicitly assume deterministic behavior, discrete and auditable change events, and clear component-to-owner mappings. Teams that build and operate agentic AI systems violate all three assumptions at once: outputs are probabilistic, systems take autonomous multi-step actions, and the risk surface mutates silently between deployments. Existing AI risk literature addresses this from above (policy frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001) or below (threat taxonomies such as OWASP's agentic AI guidance), but not at the layer where an engineering manager (EM) operates: roles, decision rights, and escalation structures. This paper contributes (i) a seven-dimension profile distinguishing pure software-engineering, hybrid, and AI-native teams; (ii) a six-cluster failure-mode taxonomy including a previously unarticulated cluster, dependency-boundary determinism mismatch; and (iii) a synthetic framework-adequacy methodology scoring how well each profile's risk architecture detects, contains, and escalates a defined scenario set. Because the object of study is framework adequacy rather than human behavior, the evaluation yields derived rather than observed coverage claims. Coverage degrades as teams move from pure software engineering to AI-native operation, monotonically in the median and abruptly in the count of uncovered, high-consequence failures appearing only at the AI-native step. The degradation concentrates in specific failure-mode categories, and the most severe, least-covered failures arise not inside AI-native teams but at the organizational boundary where their probabilistic outputs are consumed by determinism-assuming dependencies.
zh_title: AI原生工程团队的风险架构：一种代理系统治理的组织框架
translation: 工程管理研究已经产生了成熟的软件风险框架：按功能划分所有权、按严重程度升级、以及按测试覆盖率进行保障。这些框架隐含地假设了确定性行为、离散且可审计的变更事件，以及清晰的组件到所有者的映射。构建和操作代理AI系统的团队同时违反了这三个假设：输出是概率性的，系统采取自主的多步操作，风险面在部署之间悄无声息地发生变异。现有的AI风险文献从上层（如NIST AI RMF和ISO/IEC 42001等政策框架）或下层（如OWASP的代理AI指南等威胁分类学）解决了这个问题，但没有解决工程经理（EM）操作层面的问题：角色、决策权和升级结构。本文贡献了（i）一个区分纯软件工程、混合和AI原生团队的七维度配置；（ii）一个包含此前未被明确阐述的“依赖边界确定性不匹配”集群在内的六类故障模式分类法；以及（iii）一种合成框架充分性评估方法，用于评分每个配置文件的风险架构在检测、遏制和升级定义场景集方面的表现。由于研究对象是框架充分性而非人类行为，评估产生的是推导性而非观察性的覆盖声明。随着团队从纯软件工程向AI原生操作迁移，覆盖率呈单调下降，且在AI原生步骤中才出现的未覆盖、高后果故障数量急剧增加。这种降级集中在特定的故障模式类别中，最严重、覆盖率最低的故障并非出现在AI原生团队内部，而是出现在其概率输出被依赖于确定性的下游系统所消费的组织边界上。
tldr: 传统软件风险框架不适用于AI代理系统；本文提出了新的评估框架，发现随着团队转向AI原生，风险覆盖能力会显著下降，且高危风险多发于系统间的边界交互。
ai_comments: 该论文填补了工程管理层面上AI代理系统治理的空白，创新性地提出了适用于工程经理的组织架构框架。其局限在于基于推导而非实证观察，且主要关注架构充分性。
motivation: 现有的软件风险管理框架基于确定性假设，无法适配具有概率输出、自主行动和隐性风险演变的AI原生工程团队，且缺乏针对工程经理操作层面的治理结构研究。
method: 1. 提出七维度团队配置文件；2. 构建六类故障模式分类法；3. 开发合成框架充分性评估方法，量化风险检测、遏制和升级能力。
results: 研究发现，从传统软件工程向AI原生工程转型过程中，风险覆盖率显著下降；AI原生系统在处理边界交互时的风险未得到充分覆盖，导致严重的、未被发现的故障。
conclusion: 研究表明，随着团队向AI原生转型，风险覆盖率会单调下降，且最严重的风险往往出现在AI原生团队与依赖其输出的确定性系统之间的组织边界上。

title: Agent4cs: A Multi-agent System for Code Summarization in Large Hierarchical Codebases
authors: Yongjian Tang, Ezgi Sarikayak, Doruk Tuncel, Jie M. Zhang, Thomas Runkler
abstract: Understanding large, complex codebases, especially those with obfuscated structures and incomplete documentation, remains a significant challenge. Existing code summarization solutions often rely on a single language model or coding assistant like Claude Code, and treat source code as flat text, underutilizing the rich interdependencies and hierarchical information within a repository. To address these shortcomings, we propose Agent4cs - a multi-agent framework that summarizes large codebases in a bottom-up fashion, where a summarization agent focuses on producing robust summaries; a keyword-extraction agent proactively identifies critical information from subfolders; and a quality-assurance agent iteratively refines the outputs for readability, coherence, and completeness. Evaluated on 7 frontier models, Agent4cs improves semantic consistency across all folder levels by average 8% compared to two structured prompting baselines with code segments. Furthermore, extensive evaluation on real-world datasets demonstrates up to 38% gains in normalized keyword coverage rate over the same baselines.
comment: Accepted to the main track of the 23rd European Conference on Multi-Agent Systems (EUMAS 2026)
zh_title: Agent4cs：一种用于大规模分层代码库代码总结的多智能体系统
translation: 理解大型、复杂的代码库，尤其是那些结构混淆且文档不全的代码库，仍然是一个重大挑战。现有的代码总结解决方案通常依赖于单一语言模型或代码助手（如 Claude Code），并将源代码视为扁平文本，未能充分利用代码库中丰富的相互依赖关系和层级信息。为了解决这些缺陷，我们提出了 Agent4cs，这是一个以自下而上方式总结大型代码库的多智能体框架，其中总结智能体专注于生成稳健的摘要；关键词提取智能体主动从子文件夹中识别关键信息；质量保证智能体则迭代优化输出的可读性、连贯性和完整性。在7个前沿模型上的评估表明，与两种基于代码片段的结构化提示基准相比，Agent4cs 将所有文件夹层级的语义一致性平均提高了8%。此外，在真实数据集上的广泛评估表明，其标准化关键词覆盖率比相同基准提高了高达38%。
tldr: Agent4cs 通过多智能体分层协作机制，解决了传统单模型处理大规模代码库时忽略层级结构的问题，显著提升了代码总结的准确性和语义一致性。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了多智能体协作机制来解决大规模代码库总结问题，摆脱了传统单一模型处理代码时的局限性。通过分层协作（总结、关键词提取、质量保证），它能更好地捕捉代码库中的层级依赖关系。其局限性可能在于多智能体框架带来的较高计算开销和推理成本。
motivation: 现有代码总结工具多将代码视为扁平文本，忽略了代码库中丰富的层级结构和相互依赖关系，导致在大规模复杂代码库中理解效果不佳。
method: 提出了一种名为 Agent4cs 的多智能体框架，采用自下而上的总结策略：包含负责生成总结的总结智能体、负责识别子文件夹关键信息的关键词提取智能体，以及负责迭代优化输出质量的质量保证智能体。
results: 在7个前沿模型上的评估显示，Agent4cs 在文件夹层级的语义一致性上平均提升了8%，在真实数据集上的标准化关键词覆盖率最高提升了38%。
conclusion: Agent4cs 通过多智能体分层处理机制，显著提升了大规模代码库总结的语义一致性和关键词覆盖率，为理解复杂工程代码库提供了一种高效的自动化方案。

title: MultAttnAttrib: Training-Free Multimodal Attribution in Long Document Question Answering
authors: Dang Quang Thien Tran, Quang V. Dang, Vinamra Tyagi, Sai Soorya Rao Veeravalli, Trang Nguyen, Ryan A. Rossi, Franck Dernoncourt, Nedim Lipka, Koustava Goswami, Samyadeep Basu
abstract: As grounded QA systems are increasingly deployed in AI assistants, accurately attributing generated answers to evidence is critical for user trust and model safety. While unimodal attributions have been explored in depth, the multimodal setting remains relatively under-researched. As a result, we introduce MultAttnAttrib, a training-free attribution-generation method that leverages a model's prefill pass, selected attention heads, and calibrated thresholds to locate source evidence within a document. To establish baseline results for the method, we introduce MultAttrEval, a complementary benchmark dataset annotated with fine-grained, ground-truth attributions for answer components grounded in multimodal source documents. To our knowledge, this is the first evaluation dataset designed specifically for multimodal attribution in long-form documents. Experimental results show that MultAttnAttrib consistently outperforms a variety of attribution-generation methods, including several strong prompting-based approaches and matches the latest frontier models such as GPT 5.4. Our method not only substantially improves attribution accuracy for both unimodal and multimodal attribution types, but also produces attributions at up to one-seventh of the direct inference latency compared to prompting on the same base model.
comment: 25 pages (8 main, 17 references + appendix), 15 figures, Submitted to EMNLP 2026 Conference (Long Paper)
zh_title: MultAttnAttrib：长文档问答中无需训练的多模态归因
translation: 随着基于证据的问答系统越来越多地部署在人工智能助手中，将生成的答案准确归因于证据对于用户信任和模型安全至关重要。虽然单模态归因已被深入研究，但多模态设置仍然相对研究不足。因此，我们引入了 MultAttnAttrib，这是一种无需训练的归因生成方法，利用模型的预填充阶段、选定的注意力头和校准阈值来定位文档中的源证据。为了建立该方法的基准结果，我们引入了 MultAttrEval，这是一个互补的基准数据集，标注了基于多模态源文档中答案组件的细粒度基础真值归因。据我们所知，这是第一个专门为长文档中的多模态归因设计的评估数据集。实验结果表明，MultAttnAttrib 在各种归因生成方法中始终表现出色，包括几种强大的基于提示的方法，并与 GPT-5.4 等最新前沿模型相媲美。我们的方法不仅大幅提高了单模态和多模态归因类型的归因准确性，而且与在同一基础模型上进行提示相比，产生的归因延迟最高可降低至直接推理延迟的七分之一。
tldr: 提出了一种高效的无需训练多模态归因方法 MultAttnAttrib，通过分析模型注意力机制，在长文档问答中实现了比传统提示法更高且更快的归因效果。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种无需训练（training-free）的多模态归因方法，并引入了专门针对长文档多模态归因的基准测试集。这不仅提高了归因的准确性，还显著降低了计算延迟，对于提升AI助手的可信度和安全性具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有问答系统在多模态长文档场景下的归因研究不足，而准确的证据归因对提升用户信任和模型安全性至关重要。
method: 提出 MultAttnAttrib 方法，利用模型的预填充阶段（prefill pass）、选定的注意力头以及校准阈值来定位文档中的源证据；同时引入 MultAttrEval 基准数据集用于评估。
results: MultAttnAttrib 在归因准确性上优于多种基于提示的方法，并能达到与 GPT-5.4 等前沿模型相当的水平，同时将推理延迟降低至直接提示法的七分之一。
conclusion: MultAttnAttrib 为长文档多模态问答提供了一种高效且准确的归因方案，通过利用模型预填充阶段的注意力机制，在无需额外训练的情况下实现了优于现有提示工程方法的效果，并降低了推理延迟。

title: When Should Service Agents Reconsider? Difficulty-Routed Control in Customer-Service Operations
authors: Qian Chen, Chengyuan Liu, Xin Yu
abstract: Autonomous customer-service agents are shifting from conversational interfaces toward operational execution roles: they retrieve firm records, apply service policies, and execute backend writes such as refunds, cancellations, exchanges, order modifications, and reservation changes. This shift creates a service-control problem: firms must keep routine service fast and low-friction while preventing operational errors on requests where customer instructions, policy constraints, firm records, and backend writes interact. We propose a difficulty-routed service-control architecture that asks when service agents should reconsider before acting. A lightweight router keeps routine sessions on a low-cost baseline path and routes operationally coupled sessions to an escalated workflow. The escalated path uses conflict-aware communication and write-triggered reconsideration to concentrate deliberation and safeguards before consequential backend writes, rather than applying additional control uniformly across all service sessions. We evaluate the architecture on human-verified retail and airline tasks from $τ^{2}$-bench. In retail, the method improves reliability consistently on service requests with operational conflict. Routing evidence shows that stronger control is directed toward conflicted requests rather than broadly applied to routine ones. Dialogue and tool-use profiles suggest that gains do not come from indiscriminate interaction expansion or broader tool chains; instead, added turns and tool calls support evidence gathering, write separation, and pre-write reconsideration. Case-level evidence shows that the escalated workflow preserves fallback plans, binds retrieved records to the correct action, sequences writes, and decomposes multi-entity requests. Airline results extend the same service-control logic to reservation operations.
zh_title: 服务代理何时应重新考虑？客户服务运营中的难度路由控制
translation: 自主客户服务代理正从对话界面转向操作执行角色：它们检索公司记录、应用服务政策并执行后端写入，如退款、取消、换货、订单修改和预订变更。这种转变带来了服务控制问题：企业必须保持常规服务的快速和低摩擦，同时防止在客户指令、政策约束、公司记录和后端写入相互作用的请求中出现操作错误。我们提出了一种难度路由服务控制架构，探讨服务代理何时应在行动前重新考虑。轻量级路由器将常规会话保持在低成本基准路径上，并将操作耦合的会话路由至升级工作流。升级路径使用冲突感知通信和写触发的重新考虑，在进行重要的后端写入之前集中审议和保障，而不是在所有服务会话中统一应用额外的控制。我们在来自 $τ^{2}$-bench 的人工验证零售和航空任务上评估了该架构。在零售方面，该方法在存在操作冲突的服务请求上持续提高了可靠性。路由证据表明，更强的控制被导向冲突请求，而不是广泛应用于常规请求。对话和工具使用概况表明，收益并非来自不加区别的交互扩展或更广泛的工具链；相反，增加的轮次和工具调用支持了证据收集、写入分离和写前重新考虑。案例级证据表明，升级后的工作流保留了后备计划，将检索到的记录绑定到正确的操作，对写入进行排序，并分解多实体请求。航空结果将相同的服务控制逻辑扩展到了预订操作。
tldr: 提出了一种能够动态识别任务难度并为复杂操作提供额外安全保障的路由架构，有效提升了AI代理处理客户请求的准确性。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的“难度路由”架构，解决了自主服务代理在执行操作性任务时面临的准确性与效率之间的平衡问题。其核心贡献在于证明了无需对所有请求进行统一的严格控制，通过识别任务难度并动态分配算力，可以在保持低摩擦的同时显著提升复杂操作的可靠性。
motivation: 随着自主服务代理从对话转向执行退款、修改订单等后端操作，如何在保持快速服务的同时防止因指令、策略与系统记录冲突而产生的操作错误，成为亟待解决的问题。
method: 提出了一种难度路由服务控制架构：利用轻量级路由将常规会话保持在低成本路径，并将存在操作冲突的会话路由至升级工作流；升级路径采用冲突感知通信和“写前重审”机制，专注于信息收集、冲突解决及操作验证。
results: 在零售和航空任务的实验中，该方法显著提升了存在操作冲突请求的可靠性；路由证据表明控制资源被精准分配到了高冲突任务上，而非盲目增加所有会话的交互成本。
conclusion: 通过难度路由机制，该架构能够有效地将复杂的控制资源集中在关键的冲突请求上，从而在保证操作准确性的同时维持了常规任务的高效性。

title: Robustifying Sparse Matrix Multiplication
authors: Karl Bringmann, Nick Fischer, Vasileios Nakos
abstract:
In the seminal sparse matrix multiplication problem the goal is to compute the product of two $n \times n$ matrices when the matrices are sparse, i.e., when the number of nonzeros in the input matrices $m_{in}$ and/or the number of nonzeros in the output matrix $m_{out}$ are much smaller than $n^2$. In this paper, we explore the generalized problem of (approximately) computing the $k$ largest output entries, with an approximation error dependent solely on the smaller entries -- from the viewpoint of sparse recovery, this can be seen as a robust variant of sparse matrix multiplication. Despite the substantial research dedicated to sparse matrix multiplication, almost no existing algorithms are robust in this sense. The one exception is Pagh's algorithm in time $\widetilde O(m_{in} + nk)$ [ITCS'12], and it remained open whether other algorithms can be similarly made robust.
  Our principal contribution is a black-box reduction from robust sparse matrix multiplication to conventional sparse matrix multiplication with only polylogarithmic overhead. Specifically, we show that any sparse matrix multiplication algorithm with running time $T(n, m_{in}, m_{out})$ can be transformed into a robust algorithm running in time $\widetilde O(T(n, m_{in}, k))$. This reduction leverages an extensive toolkit from sparse recovery, and intriguingly, also involves solving a knapsack-type problem.
  By plugging in the state-of-the-art algorithm for sparse matrix multiplication by Abboud, Bringmann, Fischer, and Künnemann [SODA'24], we achieve significantly improved bounds such as $O((m_{in} + k)^{1.346})$. Notably, in the regime where $k \geq m_{in}^{1.762}$, our reduction culminates in an almost-optimal $k^{1+o(1)}$-time algorithm.
zh_title: 稀疏矩阵乘法的鲁棒化
translation: 在经典的稀疏矩阵乘法问题中，目标是在矩阵稀疏（即输入非零元 $m_{in}$ 或输出非零元 $m_{out}$ 远小于 $n^2$）时计算两个 $n \times n$ 矩阵的乘积。在本文中，我们探讨了计算 $k$ 个最大输出项的广义（近似）问题，其中近似误差仅取决于较小的项——从稀疏恢复的角度来看，这可以被视为稀疏矩阵乘法的一种鲁棒变体。尽管稀疏矩阵乘法研究丰富，但几乎没有任何现有算法具备这种意义上的鲁棒性。唯一的例外是 Pagh 在 ITCS'12 提出的时间复杂度为 $\widetilde O(m_{in} + nk)$ 的算法，而其他算法是否能同样实现鲁棒性仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们的主要贡献是一个将鲁棒稀疏矩阵乘法归约为传统稀疏矩阵乘法的黑盒归约方法，且仅有 polylog 级别的开销。具体而言，我们证明了任何时间复杂度为 $T(n, m_{in}, m_{out})$ 的稀疏矩阵乘法算法都可以转化为时间复杂度为 $\widetilde O(T(n, m_{in}, k))$ 的鲁棒算法。该归约利用了稀疏恢复的广泛工具集，并且有趣地涉及到了背包问题的求解。通过代入 Abboud 等人（SODA'24）关于稀疏矩阵乘法的最先进算法，我们获得了显著提升的界，例如 $O((m_{in} + k)^{1.346})$。值得注意的是，在 $k \geq m_{in}^{1.762}$ 的情况下，我们的归约最终得到了几乎最优的 $k^{1+o(1)}$ 时间算法。
tldr: 通过黑盒归约，将稀疏矩阵乘法的鲁棒问题转化为传统问题，实现了计算效率的显著提升。
ai_comments: 该研究通过黑盒归约技术，巧妙地将鲁棒性问题转化为传统的稀疏矩阵乘法问题，不仅统一了现有的算法框架，还利用最新的SODA'24算法实现了显著的性能提升。这种方法论上的创新为解决矩阵计算中的噪声和近似问题提供了新思路。
motivation: 传统的稀疏矩阵乘法算法缺乏鲁棒性（即在计算大项时无法有效处理小项带来的误差），仅Pagh (2012) 的算法具备此特性，作者旨在探索如何使其他算法也具备鲁棒性。
method: 提出了一种黑盒归约（black-box reduction）方法，利用稀疏恢复工具包和背包问题求解技术，将鲁棒稀疏矩阵乘法转化为传统稀疏矩阵乘法，仅产生多对数因子开销。
results: 实现了鲁棒稀疏矩阵乘法，时间复杂度为 $\widetilde O(T(n, m_{in}, k))$。结合最新算法，达到了 $O((m_{in} + k)^{1.346})$ 的界，在特定条件下实现了 $k^{1+o(1)}$ 的几乎最优复杂度。
conclusion: 该论文成功证明了鲁棒稀疏矩阵乘法可以通过黑盒归约转化为传统稀疏矩阵乘法，并实现了几乎最优的计算复杂度，填补了该领域的理论空白。

title: FUSE: A Partitioned Field-Exchange Framework for Coupling Physics Simulations in FEBio
authors: Steve A. Maas, Farhan Muhib, Jeffrey A. Weiss
abstract: Computational biomechanics increasingly requires models that combine mechanics, transport, chemistry, and biological regulation across different spatial and temporal scales. The FEBio simulation software provides extensive open-source capabilities for modeling these processes using monolithic approaches. However, assembling independently developed physics models into reproducible coupled workflows remains challenging. Existing approaches often require custom scripts or external software pipelines, which can limit model reuse and complicate development. We present FUSE, the FEBio Unified Simulation and Exchange framework, a partitioned coupling plugin that enables separately defined FEBio models to communicate through structured field exchange. FUSE is designed for problems that are best solved independently, particularly when fast mechanical responses influence slower biological or chemical evolution. The framework uses a time-decoupled strategy in which a primary model advances on the longer time scale, while one or more secondary models are repeatedly initialized, supplied with updated fields, solved over shorter time horizons, with results returned to the primary model. Field exchange utilizes existing FEBio data maps, output fields, and user-specified filters, allowing coupled workflows to be constructed without modifying the underlying solvers. The framework was able to reproduce reference coupled solutions while handling bidirectional transfer, spatial field mapping, and filtered exchange of model variables. Example applications demonstrated coupling between mechanical loading and chemical degradation in injured cartilage and interaction between biological tissue formation and mechanical feedback during bone healing. By separating coupling logic from physics implementation, FUSE provides a practical mechanism for building maintainable multiphysics workflows within FEBio.
zh_title: FUSE：一种用于FEBio中耦合物理仿真的分区场交换框架
translation: 计算生物力学日益要求模型能够跨越不同的空间和时间尺度，结合力学、传输、化学和生物调节。FEBio仿真软件通过单体方法为建模这些过程提供了广泛的开源功能。然而，将独立开发的物理模型组装成可重复的耦合工作流仍然具有挑战性。现有的方法通常需要自定义脚本或外部软件管道，这可能会限制模型的重用并使开发复杂化。我们提出了FUSE（FEBio统一模拟与交换框架），这是一种分区耦合插件，使单独定义的FEBio模型能够通过结构化场交换进行通信。FUSE专为最好独立解决的问题而设计，特别是当快速机械响应影响较慢的生物或化学演化时。该框架使用时间解耦策略，其中主模型在较长的时间尺度上推进，而一个或多个次级模型被重复初始化，提供更新的字段，在较短的时间范围内求解，并将结果返回给主模型。场交换利用现有的FEBio数据映射、输出字段和用户指定的过滤器，允许在不修改底层求解器的情况下构建耦合工作流。该框架能够在处理双向传输、空间场映射和模型变量过滤交换的同时，重现参考耦合解。示例应用展示了受伤软骨中机械载荷与化学降解之间的耦合，以及骨愈合过程中组织形成与机械反馈之间的相互作用。通过将耦合逻辑与物理实现分离，FUSE为在FEBio内构建可维护的多物理场工作流提供了一种实用的机制。
tldr: FUSE是一个FEBio插件，通过分区和时间解耦策略，实现了不同物理模型间的模块化耦合，无需修改底层求解器即可构建复杂的多物理场生物力学工作流。
ai_comments: FUSE通过将耦合逻辑从物理求解器中解耦，有效解决了FEBio中多物理场仿真难以模块化和复用的问题。其基于分区和时间解耦的策略非常适合多尺度生物力学问题，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 解决计算生物力学中不同物理模型（力学、传输、化学等）难以集成、复用性差且开发复杂的问题。
method: 开发了名为FUSE的插件框架，采用分区耦合和时间解耦策略；利用FEBio现有的数据映射、输出字段和用户定义过滤器实现模型间的信息交换，无需修改底层求解器。
results: 成功复现了参考耦合解，支持双向数据传输、空间映射和变量过滤；在软骨损伤化学降解和骨愈合机械反馈仿真中验证了其有效性。
conclusion: FUSE框架成功实现了FEBio内不同物理模型的高效、模块化耦合，为复杂多物理场生物力学仿真提供了一个可维护且灵活的解决方案。

title: Physically-Aware Preemptive Virtual Channels for Deadlock-Free AXI Networks-on-Chip
authors: Lorenzo Leone, Luca Colagrande, Luca Benini
abstract: As many-core Systems-on-Chip (SoCs) continue to scale, Networks-on-Chip (NoCs) must sustain increasingly high memory bandwidth while preserving deadlock freedom. In AXI4 systems, protocol-level dependencies between read and write traffic can create circular waits at the network endpoints, even when the routing algorithm itself is deadlock-free. Decoupling these traffic classes avoids such dependencies, but exposes a key implementation trade-off: multiplane NoCs duplicate wide physical links and increase routing pressure, whereas conventional Virtual Channel (VC) routers add substantial control complexity, area, and timing overhead. This work revisits this trade-off for modern wide-link NoCs. We evaluate four deadlock-free AXI4 traffic-class separation schemes: a multiplane baseline and three lightweight VC-based designs. Among these designs, we propose Preemptive VCs, a physically-aware architecture that can save up to 76% of link resources with comparable frequency and only 3% router area overhead relative to the multiplane design.
zh_title: ERROR

title: IsoSci: A Benchmark of Isomorphic Cross-Domain Science Problems for Evaluating Reasoning versus Knowledge Retrieval in LLMs
authors: Samir Abdaljalil, Erchin Serpedin, Hasan Kurban
abstract: We introduce ISOSCI, a benchmark of isomorphic cross-domain science problem pairs that separates reasoning ability from domain knowledge retrieval in LLM evaluation. Each pair shares identical logical structure but requires different domain-specific knowledge, enabling controlled attribution of reasoning-mode gains. Across five model pairs spanning four model families, we find that 91.3% of reasoning-mode gains are knowledge-dependent rather than structure-invariant (63/69 gains; Wilson 95% CI [82.3%, 96.0%]), directly challenging the assumption that chain-of-thought reasoning improves short-horizon procedural scientific problem-solving. Reasoning toggles on highly capable models provide less than 5 percentage points accuracy gain across all domains, and a reasoning-specialized model (o3-mini) that outperforms its standard counterpart on GPQA Diamond (+19.2 percentage points) underperforms on ISOSCI (-24.7 percentage points), showing that benchmark choice determines conclusions about reasoning utility. We release ISOSCI at https://huggingface.co/datasets/isosci/isosci
zh_title: IsoSci：用于评估大语言模型推理与知识检索能力的同构跨领域科学问题基准测试
translation: 我们介绍了 ISOSCI，这是一个由同构跨领域科学问题对组成的基准测试，旨在在评估大语言模型时将推理能力与领域知识检索分离开来。每一对问题共享相同的逻辑结构，但需要不同的领域特定知识，从而能够对推理模式带来的收益进行受控归因。在跨越四个模型系列的五个模型对中，我们发现 91.3% 的推理模式收益是知识依赖的，而非结构不变的（63/69 个收益；Wilson 95% 置信区间 [82.3%, 96.0%]），这直接挑战了思维链推理能改善短程程序化科学问题解决的假设。在所有领域中，高能力模型上的推理切换提供的准确率提升不到 5 个百分点，且一个在 GPQA Diamond 上优于其标准对应的推理专用模型（o3-mini，+19.2 个百分点）在 ISOSCI 上表现不佳（-24.7 个百分点），这表明基准测试的选择决定了关于推理效用的结论。我们已在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/isosci/isosci 发布了 ISOSCI。
tldr: 研究发现大模型在科学任务中的推理表现主要源于知识记忆而非真正的逻辑推理，且基准测试的选择会显著影响对模型推理能力的评估结论。
ai_comments: 该研究通过构建同构问题集，巧妙地将推理能力与知识检索分离开来，揭示了当前大模型在科学推理任务中对知识的过度依赖，对评估方法论提出了重要挑战。
motivation: 旨在解决现有科学推理基准测试难以区分大模型的推理能力与知识检索能力的问题，从而探究推理链（Chain-of-Thought）在科学问题解决中的真实有效性。
method: 构建包含同构科学问题对的基准测试 ISOSCI，通过对比模型在结构相同但领域知识要求不同的任务表现，评估推理能力与知识检索的贡献。
results: 91.3%的推理能力提升归因于知识检索而非逻辑推理；推理增强在科学任务中的准确率提升不足5个百分点；特定推理模型在不同基准测试上的表现差异巨大，证明了基准测试选择对结论的决定性影响。
conclusion: 大模型在科学问题解决中的表现高度依赖于特定领域知识，而非通用的逻辑推理能力，当前的推理增强技术在科学领域的效果被高估。

title: CreativityNeuro: Steering Language Model Weights to Improve Divergent Thinking and Reduce Mode Collapse
authors: Samuel Schapiro, Core Francisco Park, Felix Sosa, Lav R. Varshney
abstract: Divergent thinking is a crucial aspect of creativity, yet large language models (LLMs) tend to consistently generate similar responses to open-ended questions, in what has been termed the artificial hivemind effect. Here, we introduce CreativityNeuro, a data-free method for enhancing divergent thinking in LLMs via contrastive weight steering. We evaluate our method across multiple creativity assessments and report several main findings. On the Divergent Association Task (DAT), a vocabulary-space creativity test, CreativityNeuro improves performance by up to 14 human percentile points. Next, in a large-scale human evaluation (N=720) on the Alternative Uses Test (AUT) and the Task Task, CreativityNeuro achieves significant improvements in originality, surprise, and creativity, transferring to longer-form and more open-ended tasks. Importantly, we find that across all three tasks, CreativityNeuro demonstrably reduces measures of mode collapse. Moreover, activation steering achieves comparable performance to CreativityNeuro on the DAT, but it does not transfer to the AUT and Task Task, demonstrating the effectiveness of weight-space steering in generalizing to unseen tasks. In conclusion, CreativityNeuro improves divergent thinking and reduces mode collapse without requiring behavioral data, re-training, or gradient-based fine-tuning, providing a straightforward way to enhance LLM performance in creative domains.

title: Discrete Diffusion Language Models for Interactive Radiology Report Drafting
authors: Max Van Puyvelde, Halil Ibrahim Gulluk, Wim Van Criekinge, Olivier Gevaert
abstract: Diffusion language models, which generate text by denoising a token canvas bidirectionally instead of emitting tokens left to right, have become competitive with autoregressive (AR) generation. Medical foundation models, however, remain almost entirely autoregressive. We adapt a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model, DiffusionGemma-26B, and benchmark it against its same-size AR sibling Gemma-4-26B under an identical LoRA recipe on medical visual question answering datasets, scored by a verbosity-robust LLM judge. Diffusion matches or exceeds AR on all of them, and the finetuned model (3.8B active) is competitive with frontier vision-language models; its decoding is also 3.5-4.4x faster. Beyond this parity, the diffusion model offers a drafting capability AR lacks: any-order infill. Because the canvas is denoised bidirectionally, a radiologist can fix report fragments and have the model fill the text between them, an operation inherent to diffusion but not to autoregression, which is subpar at it. This suits real reports, which are often terse or inconsistent across clinicians and institutions.
zh_title: 用于交互式放射学报告撰写的离散扩散语言模型
translation: 扩散语言模型通过双向去噪标记画布而非从左到右逐字生成文本，已在文本生成领域展现出与自回归（AR）生成相当的竞争力。然而，目前的医学基础模型几乎仍完全采用自回归方式。我们适配了一个混合专家扩散语言模型 DiffusionGemma-26B，并在相同的 LoRA 微调配置下，与同规模的自回归模型 Gemma-4-26B 在医疗视觉问答数据集上进行了基准测试，并由 verbosity-robust LLM judge 进行评分。结果显示，扩散模型在所有数据集上的表现均持平或优于自回归模型，且微调后的模型（3.8B 活跃参数）可与前沿视觉语言模型相媲美，同时解码速度快 3.5-4.4 倍。此外，扩散模型还提供了一种自回归模型所缺乏的草拟能力：任意顺序填充。由于画布是双向去噪的，放射科医生可以修正报告片段，并让模型填充其间的文本，这种操作是扩散模型的固有优势，而自回归模型在此方面表现较差。这非常契合实际工作中往往简洁或在不同临床医生和机构间表现不一致的放射学报告需求。
tldr: 扩散语言模型在医学报告生成中不仅性能媲美自回归模型，推理速度更快，还支持放射科医生进行报告片段的交互式填充。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将扩散模型应用于医学报告撰写，不仅在性能上追平或超越了自回归模型，还通过“任意顺序填充”功能解决了医学报告撰写中非线性编辑的痛点，展示了扩散模型在长文本生成任务中的巨大潜力。
motivation: 目前的医学基础模型几乎全部采用自回归生成模式，而扩散语言模型在通用文本生成中已展现出竞争力，作者旨在探索扩散模型在医学报告撰写中的应用潜力及其特有的交互式编辑优势。
method: 采用混合专家（MoE）扩散语言模型 DiffusionGemma-26B，并与同规模的自回归模型 Gemma-4-26B 在相同的 LoRA 微调配置下进行对比，利用 verbosity-robust LLM judge 进行评估。
results: 扩散模型在医疗视觉问答任务中表现与自回归模型持平或更优，推理速度快 3.5-4.4 倍，并支持独特的“任意顺序填充”功能，便于放射科医生进行报告片段的修正与补全。
conclusion: 扩散语言模型在医学报告撰写任务中表现出与自回归模型相当甚至更优的性能，且具备更快的推理速度和独特的交互式编辑优势。

title: How Much Future Helps? A Controlled Study of Future-Privileged Supervision for Causal Egocentric Gaze Estimation
authors: Jia Li, Wenjie Zhao, Fnu Atisri, Sanskriti Aripineni, Shijian Deng, Jon E. Froehlich, Yuhang Zhao, Yapeng Tian
abstract: Egocentric gaze estimation is commonly studied using models that process the full video with access to future frames, while real-world applications require strictly causal, online prediction. This discrepancy raises key questions: Does future context inherently provide valuable signals for gaze estimation? If so, how much future look-ahead optimally supervises a causal model during training? To investigate, we propose a controlled framework featuring a future-aware branch that accesses a tunable look-ahead horizon during training but is discarded at inference. This design isolates the impact of future context while keeping the inference architecture fixed and strictly causal. Across EGTEA Gaze+ and Ego4D, we find that future-privileged supervision consistently improves causal gaze prediction, confirming its utility. However, performance gains do not increase monotonically with longer look-ahead, but rather peak within a bounded temporal regime. Specifically, optimal performance corresponds to roughly 1.7--3.3 seconds of future context ($H{\in}[5, 10]$) on EGTEA Gaze+ and 2.7 seconds ($H{=}10$) on Ego4D. Our results demonstrate that lightweight causal models can effectively absorb future-aware signals, providing practical guidance for real-time egocentric gaze modeling.

title: FaithMed: Training LLMs For Faithful Evidence-Based Medical Reasoning
authors: Zhiyun Zhang, Liwen Sun, Xiang Qian, Chenyan Xiong
abstract: Faithful reasoning is essential in medicine, where clinical decisions require transparent justification grounded in reliable evidence. Current medical LLMs either lack active access to evidence or use retrieved evidence without supervising how it should be appraised and applied during reasoning. To address this, we formalize evidence-based medicine principles as process-level criteria and introduce FaithMed, a framework that combines clinician-designed, automatically refined rubrics with reinforcement learning using step-level process reward assignment and advantage grouping. Across seven medical benchmarks, FaithMed improves over agentic-search baselines (+9% on average) and outcome-only RL (+5.8%), while raising average evidence-based medicine rubric scores over agentic-search Qwen3 baselines (+15.5%). This work demonstrates that explicit step-level supervision can improve both task success and the faithfulness of the reasoning process. Code is available at https://github.com/cxcscmu/FaithMed.
zh_title: FaithMed：训练用于忠实循证医学推理的大语言模型
translation: 忠实推理在医学领域至关重要，因为临床决策需要基于可靠证据的透明论证。目前的医学大模型要么缺乏对证据的主动访问，要么在使用检索到的证据时，缺乏对其在推理过程中如何被评估和应用的监督。为了解决这一问题，我们将循证医学原则形式化为过程级准则，并引入了FaithMed框架。该框架结合了临床医生设计、自动优化的评价准则，并利用步骤级过程奖励分配和优势分组技术进行强化学习。在七个医学基准测试中，FaithMed的表现优于代理搜索基线（平均提升9%）和仅基于结果的强化学习（提升5.8%），同时将循证医学评价准则得分较代理搜索Qwen3基线提高了15.5%。这项工作表明，显式的步骤级监督可以同时提高任务成功率和推理过程的忠实度。代码地址：https://github.com/cxcscmu/FaithMed。
tldr: FaithMed通过引入步骤级的强化学习和循证医学评价准则，显著提升了医学大模型在推理过程中的忠实度和准确性。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将循证医学原则转化为过程级准则，通过强化学习监督推理的每一步，而非仅仅关注最终结果。这对于医疗AI的可靠性至关重要，弥补了现有模型在医学推理中缺乏透明度和证据应用监督的不足，具有很高的临床应用潜力。
motivation: 现有的医学大模型要么缺乏对外部证据的实时访问，要么在使用检索到的证据时缺乏对证据评估和应用过程的有效监督，导致医疗推理缺乏透明度和可靠性。
method: 提出FaithMed框架，结合临床医生设计的自动优化评价准则（rubrics），利用步骤级过程奖励分配和优势分组（advantage grouping）技术对模型进行强化学习训练。
results: 在七个医学基准测试中，FaithMed表现优于代理搜索基线（平均提升9%）及仅基于结果的强化学习（提升5.8%），且循证医学评价准则得分较代理搜索Qwen3基线提升了15.5%。
conclusion: 通过在推理过程中引入显式的、基于循证医学原则的步骤级奖励机制，能够显著提升医疗大模型的任务成功率以及推理过程的忠实度。

title: Sign in the Air to Unlock: An Interface for authentication in Virtual and Augmented Reality Powered by Point-Voxel Cross-Attention Network
authors: Neda Abdolrahimi, Thiru Siddharth, Frank Sicongchen, Vir V Phoha
abstract: Significant advancement of immersive technologies such as Virtual and Augmented Reality (VR/AR) and their integration into diverse aspects of modern life need authentication interfaces that are secure, intuitive, and compatible with embodied interaction. Traditional methods such as passwords, PINs, and device-based logins, break immersion and rely on external hardware. Recent 3D-specific behavioral approaches, such as hand-gesture, eye-tracking, and electroencephalography (EEG)-based methods, offer promising alternatives but often require specialized sensors or constrain natural movement, limiting usability in dynamic environments. We present Sign in the Air to Unlock, an in-air signature interface that enables users to authenticate by signing naturally in 3D space which is a familiar, personal, and reproducible gesture. To realize this interface, we design a point-voxel Cross-Attention Network (PV-Net) that jointly models local motion dynamics and global spatial structure from 3D trajectories. The model is evaluated on two datasets: the public DeepAirSig dataset (1,800 signatures from 40 users) and ImmAirsig, a new dataset collected using Meta Quest 2 in immersive VR (880 samples from 22 users). PV-Net achieves an Equal Error Rate of 2.5% on DeepAirSig and 76% classification accuracy on ImmAirSig. These findings highlight the potential of 3D behavioral interfaces for seamless, user-centric authentication that merges security with natural interaction in immersive environments.
zh_title: 空中签名解锁：一种基于点-体素交叉注意力网络的虚拟和增强现实身份验证界面
translation: 沉浸式技术（如VR/AR）在现代生活中的广泛应用，需要安全、直观且兼容具身交互的身份验证界面。传统的密码、PIN码和基于设备的登录方式会破坏沉浸感，且依赖外部硬件。近年来，基于3D行为的方法（如手势、眼动追踪和脑电图）提供了有前景的替代方案，但通常需要专用传感器或限制自然运动，限制了在动态环境下的可用性。我们提出了“空中签名解锁”，这是一种空中签名界面，允许用户通过在3D空间中自然地书写签名来进行身份验证，这是一种熟悉、个人化且可重复的手势。为了实现该界面，我们设计了一种点-体素交叉注意力网络（PV-Net），从3D轨迹中联合建模局部运动动态和全局空间结构。该模型在两个数据集上进行了评估：公开的DeepAirSig数据集（来自40名用户的1,800个签名）和ImmAirSig（使用Meta Quest 2在沉浸式VR中收集的新数据集，来自22名用户的880个样本）。PV-Net在DeepAirSig上实现了2.5%的等错误率，在ImmAirSig上实现了76%的分类准确率。这些发现突显了3D行为界面在沉浸式环境中实现无缝、以用户为中心的身份验证的潜力，将安全性与自然交互融合在一起。
keywords: 点-体素交叉注意力网络
tldr: 通过捕捉用户在空中书写的3D签名轨迹，利用深度学习模型实现自然且安全的VR/AR设备解锁。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将空中签名引入VR/AR身份验证，不仅提升了交互的自然度，还通过PV-Net有效解决了3D轨迹的时空特征提取难题。其优势在于无需额外专用传感器，但该方法在复杂动态环境下的鲁棒性及大规模实际应用的可扩展性仍需进一步验证。
motivation: 现有VR/AR身份验证方法（如密码或专用传感器）破坏了沉浸感且限制了自然移动，亟需一种既安全又符合沉浸式交互习惯的验证方式。
method: 提出了一种名为PV-Net（点-体素交叉注意力网络）的模型，通过联合建模3D轨迹的局部运动动态和全局空间结构来实现身份识别。
results: PV-Net在DeepAirSig数据集上达到了2.5%的等错误率（EER），在ImmAirSig数据集上实现了76%的分类准确率。
conclusion: 研究证明了基于空中签名的3D行为认证在VR/AR环境中是可行且有效的，能够平衡安全性和沉浸式交互体验。

title: Hamm-Grams: An Algorithm for Mining Regular Expressions of Bytes
authors: Derek Everett, Edward Raff, James Holt
abstract: Malware poses a critical and ever-evolving threat, and robust and effective systems for detecting and classifying malware are of essential importance. $n$-grams features are among the common static features used in effective machine learning systems for malware, but these features are inherently brittle. We propose an algorithm for constructing more robust features, hamm-grams, which are a special class of regular expressions having a fixed length and single-character wildcards. We devise an efficient algorithm for finding common hamm-grams using a new locality-sensitive hash designed to produce collisions among pairs of small Hamming distance and a clustering within hash buckets to place wildcards. We then demonstrate the advantages of these features in malware classification and detection tasks.

title: From Forgeries to Foundation Models: A Systematic Survey of Identity Document Attack and Detection
authors: Gourab Das, Pavan Kumar C, Raghavendra Ramachandra
abstract: Identity document forgery has undergone a fundamental capability shift: generative AI tools now enable high-fidelity document synthesis and field-level manipulation with minimal technical expertise, while detection methods remain constrained by benchmarks that do not reflect this threat. The resulting attack surface spans physical presentation, digital injection, and fully generative synthesis, introducing distinct forensic failure modes that require a unified threat model and evaluation framework. This survey provides, to our knowledge, the first unified treatment of Presentation Attacks, Digital Injection Attacks, and GenAI-driven synthesis within a single identity verification threat model. We trace detection methodologies from rule-based heuristics through forensic localisation, injection-aware pipelines, foundation models, and few-shot frameworks. A systematic audit of public datasets from 2019--2025 exposes a persistent Reality Gap between benchmark conditions and operational deployment. We further analyse large multimodal models for identity document manipulation, identifying Script-Dependent Generative Instability (SDGI) as a recurring typographic failure mode in non-Latin script inpainting. Finally, zero-shot benchmarking on unseen synthesised ID cards shows that even the strongest publicly available models achieve APCER values above 25% under security-oriented operating conditions, highlighting substantial limits in cross-domain generalisation. We conclude by outlining future directions toward forensically grounded, privacy-preserving, and legally accountable identity verification systems.
zh_title: 从伪造到基础模型：身份文档攻击与检测的系统综述
translation: 身份文档伪造已经发生了根本性的能力转变：生成式AI工具现在能够以极低的技术门槛实现高保真文档合成和字段级操纵，而检测方法却受限于无法反映这一威胁的基准测试。由此产生的攻击面跨越了物理呈现、数字注入和完全生成式合成，引入了需要统一威胁模型和评估框架的独特取证失效模式。据我们所知，本综述首次将呈现攻击、数字注入攻击和生成式AI驱动的合成纳入单一身份验证威胁模型中进行统一处理。我们追踪了从基于规则的启发式方法到取证定位、注入感知流水线、基础模型和少样本框架的检测方法论。对2019-2025年公共数据集的系统审计揭示了基准测试条件与操作部署之间持续存在的现实差距。我们进一步分析了用于身份文档操纵的大型多模态模型，确定了脚本依赖生成不稳定性（SDGI）作为非拉丁脚本重绘中一种反复出现的排版失效模式。最后，对未见过的合成身份证进行的零样本基准测试表明，即使是最强大的公开模型在安全导向的操作条件下，其APCER值也超过25%，突显了跨域泛化能力的实质性局限。最后，我们概述了朝着基于取证基础、保护隐私且具有法律问责制的身份验证系统发展的未来方向。
tldr: 本文统一了身份文档的威胁模型，揭示了生成式AI时代下现有检测技术的局限性，指出即使是顶级模型在面对新型伪造时也表现出明显的泛化能力不足。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将传统的身份伪造（物理攻击）与现代生成式AI攻击（数字注入与全合成）统一在一个威胁模型下，并揭示了现有基准测试与实际部署之间的严重现实差距。其发现的“脚本依赖生成不稳定性（SDGI）”为未来研究提供了具体的切入点，对于提升身份验证系统的鲁棒性具有重要指导意义。
motivation: 生成式AI工具降低了高保真文档伪造的门槛，而现有的检测基准未能反映这一新的威胁，导致攻击面扩大，亟需一个统一的威胁模型和评估框架。
method: 通过对2019-2025年间的公开数据集进行系统审计，对比分析了从基于规则的启发式方法到基础模型和少样本学习等多种检测技术，并对大型多模态模型在身份文档处理中的表现进行了零样本基准测试。
results: 研究发现现有公开模型在面对未见过的合成ID卡时，APCER值超过25%，且识别出非拉丁字符重绘中存在的“脚本依赖生成不稳定性（SDGI）”缺陷。
conclusion: 当前身份验证技术在面对生成式AI攻击时表现脆弱，跨域泛化能力严重不足。未来需构建基于取证基础、保护隐私且具备法律问责机制的身份验证系统。

title: On the Utility and Factual Reliability of Pruned Mixture-of-Experts Models in the Biomedical Domain
authors: Atsuki Yamaguchi, Szymon Palucha, Léo Bijar, Aline Villavicencio, Nikolaos Aletras
abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer inference speedups via selective activation but impose substantial memory requirements because the whole network must remain loaded. Structured expert pruning is a practical approach for reducing deployment costs in resource-constrained settings. However, prior studies primarily evaluate benchmark utility, leaving the effect of pruning on factual reliability underexplored, particularly in high-stakes domains such as biomedicine. In this paper, we investigate how domain-specific expert pruning affects both utility and reliability. We assess four MoE models, six pruning methods, and multiple pruning ratios across generation and classification tasks under in-domain (biomedical) and cross-domain settings. Results reveal that moderate pruning preserves in-domain utility without immediate reliability decline, although hallucination risks increase at extreme pruning ratios. When shifting to the general domain, both utility and reliability degrade rapidly. These findings indicate that safe compression depends heavily on the task and domain. Evaluating pruned MoE models solely on utility is inadequate for high-stakes deployment without reliability assessment.
zh_title: 关于生物医学领域中修剪后的混合专家模型的效用与事实可靠性研究
translation: 混合专家（MoE）模型通过选择性激活提供了推理加速，但由于整个网络必须保持加载，因此带来了巨大的内存需求。结构化专家修剪是降低资源受限环境下部署成本的一种实用方法。然而，先前的研究主要评估基准效用，使得修剪对事实可靠性的影响未得到充分探索，特别是在生物医学等高风险领域。在本文中，我们研究了特定领域的专家修剪如何影响效用和可靠性。我们评估了四种 MoE 模型、六种修剪方法以及在领域内（生物医学）和跨领域设置下多种修剪比例的生成和分类任务。结果表明，适度修剪可以在不立即降低可靠性的情况下保持领域内效用，尽管在极端的修剪比例下幻觉风险会增加。当转向通用领域时，效用和可靠性都会迅速下降。这些发现表明，安全的压缩在很大程度上取决于任务和领域。在没有可靠性评估的情况下，仅根据效用评估修剪后的 MoE 模型对于高风险部署是不够的。
tldr: 在生物医学领域，MoE模型的过度修剪会显著增加幻觉风险，因此在评估压缩模型时，必须将事实可靠性与效用指标同等看待。
ai_comments: 该研究通过实证分析揭示了模型压缩在高性能领域（如生物医学）的潜在风险，强调了在评估模型压缩技术时，除了关注性能指标外，必须将事实可靠性（幻觉问题）纳入核心考量，这对部署高风险场景的AI模型具有重要的指导意义。
motivation: 混合专家模型（MoE）虽然提升了推理速度，但内存占用高；现有研究多关注修剪后的模型效用，缺乏对高风险领域（如生物医学）中事实可靠性影响的深入探讨。
method: 评估了四种 MoE 模型、六种修剪方法，并在多种修剪比例下，对生成和分类任务进行了领域内（生物医学）和跨领域设置的测试。
results: 适度修剪能保持领域内效用且不立即降低可靠性；极端修剪会导致幻觉风险增加；在跨领域场景下，模型效用和可靠性均会迅速下降。
conclusion: 适度修剪可以在生物医学领域保持效用，但极端的修剪会增加幻觉风险；仅依靠效用评估模型压缩是不充分的，必须同时进行可靠性评估。

title: Geometry-Aware R-Structured Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
authors: Sergei Kucherenko, Nilay Shah
abstract:
We propose a novel hybrid neural architecture, the Geometry-aware R-Structured Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (GRS-KAN), which integrates V.L.Rvachev's R-functions into the Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) framework. The proposed approach combines two complementary modeling mechanisms: smooth nonlinear structure is learned by KAN branches, while known geometric or logical constraints are encoded analytically using differentiable R-functions. This enables explicit representation of discontinuities, feasible regions, and implicit geometric boundaries within a trainable neural architecture.
  The framework implements differentiable logical operations through R-conjunctions and R-disjunctions, allowing complex geometric supports to be represented analytically and incorporated directly into regression models. Several GRS-KAN variants are introduced, including additive, multiplicative, and agnostic branch-weighted architectures.
  The method is demonstrated on regression problems involving discontinuities with circular and rectangular supports. Numerical experiments show that explicit geometric encoding substantially improves predictive accuracy and boundary localization compared with standard KANs. In the considered benchmarks, geometry-aware GRS-KAN models reduce test RMSE by up to 67% while simultaneously improving interpretability through explicit analytical representation of the learned geometric structure. The agnostic variant further demonstrates the ability to automatically determine whether geometric priors are beneficial for a given learning task.
zh_title: ERROR

title: SE(2) Navigation Mesh
authors: Shuyang Shi, Kaixian Qu, Changan Chen, Ines Kast, Yuntao Ma, Marco Hutter
abstract: Global navigation for ground robots in complex multi-level environments requires representations that accurately capture traversable regions while enabling efficient path planning. Current approaches present key limitations: Point clouds and volumetric occupancy maps lack explicit surface structure for traversability estimation, whereas direct pathfinding on dense triangle meshes is computationally prohibitive. Navigation meshes mitigate these challenges through polygonal abstraction of the underlying mesh, but assume yaw-invariant traversability, rendering them unsuitable for non-circular robots in constrained spaces. We propose SE(2) Navigation Mesh (SE(2) NavMesh), a polygonal representation of traversable regions that encodes yaw-dependent traversability. Our method evaluates traversability using footprint masks and constructs a graph over yaw-specific layers with explicit translational and rotational connectivity. Grounded in this representation, we develop an A*-String Pulling-A* (ASA) pathfinding strategy that hierarchically optimizes robot position and heading. We also present an online method that incrementally updates the SE(2) NavMesh from streaming point clouds during concurrent geometry reconstruction. In simulation, the SE(2) NavMesh captures over 50% more traversable area than classical NavMeshes, and the SE(2) NavMesh + ASA pipeline consistently outperforms sampling-based baselines in constrained environments. Extensive real-world experiments on a physical robot validate real-time online generation and successful navigation across multiple environments.
zh_title: SE(2) 导航网格
translation: 在复杂多层环境中，地面机器人的全局导航需要能够准确捕捉可通行区域并支持高效路径规划的表示方法。当前方法存在局限性：点云和体素占用图缺乏用于估计遍历性的显式表面结构，而直接在密集三角网格上进行路径搜索计算成本过高。导航网格通过底层网格的多边形抽象缓解了这些挑战，但它们假设遍历性与偏航角无关，这使得它们不适用于受限空间中的非圆形机器人。我们提出了 SE(2) 导航网格（SE(2) NavMesh），这是一种编码偏航依赖遍历性的可通行区域多边形表示。我们的方法使用足迹掩码评估遍历性，并在具有显式平移和旋转连接的偏航特定层上构建图。基于此表示，我们开发了一种 A*-String Pulling-A* (ASA) 路径搜索策略，该策略分层优化机器人的位置和航向。我们还提出了一种在线方法，可以在几何重构的同时，从流式点云中增量更新 SE(2) NavMesh。在仿真中，SE(2) NavMesh 捕获的可通行区域比传统导航网格多 50% 以上，且 SE(2) NavMesh + ASA 流水线在受限环境中始终优于基于采样的基准方法。在物理机器人上的大量现实世界实验验证了其在多种环境下的实时在线生成和成功导航能力。
tldr: 提出一种适用于非圆形机器人的 SE(2) 导航网格，通过编码偏航依赖的遍历性，显著提升了复杂受限环境下的路径规划效率和覆盖能力。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地解决了非圆形机器人（具有偏航依赖性）在复杂环境中导航的难题，通过将SE(2)空间引入导航网格，实现了比传统方法更高效、更精确的路径规划。其局限性可能在于对高动态环境的适应性以及计算复杂度与环境复杂度的具体权衡。
motivation: 现有的导航网格方法假设遍历性与偏航角无关，导致非圆形机器人在受限空间内无法有效导航；而点云和体素图缺乏显式的表面结构，且直接在密集网格上进行路径规划计算成本过高。
method: 提出 SE(2) NavMesh 表示法，通过足迹掩码评估偏航相关的遍历性；构建具有平移和旋转连接的偏航层图结构；开发 ASA（A*-String Pulling-A*）分层路径规划策略；实现基于流式点云的在线增量更新算法。
results: 在仿真中，SE(2) NavMesh 捕获的遍历区域比传统导航网格多 50% 以上；在受限环境中，SE(2) NavMesh + ASA 方案优于采样基准方法；实机实验验证了其在线生成和导航的实时性与有效性。
conclusion: SE(2) NavMesh 成功地将偏航依赖的遍历性编码为多层多边形表示，结合提出的 ASA 算法，实现了复杂环境中机器人高效、鲁棒的路径规划。

title: Token Geometry
authors: Kathan Shah
abstract: Language models learn continuous programs over discrete symbols, with the embedding table and LM-head acting as the read/write interface between them. We show that this interface has gradient geometry distinct from dense hidden weights which can be exploited to improve the Pareto frontier across supervised finetuning, RL, and pretraining, while only utilizing kilobytes of optimizer state. We introduce Ember, a lightweight optimizer for embedding and LM-head matrices that utilizes O(V + D) VRAM, instead of Adam's O(2VD), and forgoes the need to shard both token table optimizer states. We provide empirical evidence that Ember scales effectively across batch size and parameter count. We show that the optimization trajectory of tokens can be well described by a simple 1D ray, counter to the popular belief that neural net parameters navigate a heavily nonconvex landscape. We provide a principled view on the surprisingly narrow space of optimizers that suffice for Transformer training. Finally, we open-source our distributed Ember implementation that merges cleanly with existing ZeRO/FSDP setups to support further research at https://github.com/katop1234/ember
zh_title: Token几何结构
translation: 语言模型在离散符号之上学习连续程序，其中嵌入表和LM-head充当两者之间的读/写接口。我们展示了该接口具有与稠密隐藏层权重不同的梯度几何结构，可以利用这一点在监督微调、强化学习和预训练中改善帕累托边界，同时仅利用数KB的优化器状态。我们引入了Ember，这是一种用于嵌入和LM-head矩阵的轻量级优化器，它利用O(V + D)显存，而不是Adam的O(2VD)，并且无需对两个标记表优化器状态进行分片。我们提供了经验证据，证明Ember在批次大小和参数数量上都能有效扩展。我们展示了标记的优化轨迹可以用一条简单的1D射线来很好地描述，这与神经网络参数在高度非凸景观中导航的普遍看法相反。我们为足以进行Transformer训练的狭窄优化器空间提供了一个原则性的观点。最后，我们开源了我们的分布式Ember实现，它可以与现有的ZeRO/FSDP设置干净地合并，以支持进一步的研究。
tldr: 针对语言模型中巨大且昂贵的嵌入层和LM-head，作者提出了一种名为Ember的轻量级优化器，通过利用其独特的梯度几何特性，大幅降低显存占用并提升了各种训练任务的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文通过揭示嵌入层和LM-head的特殊梯度几何结构，打破了神经网络参数优化遵循复杂非凸景观的传统认知，提出了一种极简且高效的优化策略，对于大规模语言模型的训练效率提升具有重要的工程价值。
motivation: 现有的大规模语言模型优化器（如Adam）在处理巨大的嵌入表和LM-head时显存开销过大，且未能充分利用这些特定参数层的独特梯度几何结构。
method: 提出Ember优化器，专门针对嵌入层（embedding）和LM-head矩阵进行优化；利用其梯度几何特征，仅需O(V+D)显存，避免了Adam中O(2VD)的显存占用，并利用1D射线简化了优化轨迹。
results: Ember在监督微调、强化学习和预训练任务中均提升了帕累托最优边界（Pareto frontier），在参数规模和批次大小上均表现出良好的扩展性，并成功将优化轨迹简化为1D射线。
conclusion: Ember优化器通过利用嵌入层和LM-head的特殊几何特性，实现了在显著降低显存占用的同时保持甚至提升训练效率，证明了Transformer训练中优化器设计的简洁性原则。

title: Grounded Optimization: A Layered Engineering Framework for Reducing LLM Hallucination in Automated Personal Document Rewriting
authors: Shashank Indukuri, Adarsh Agrawal
abstract:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to resume optimization for applicant tracking systems, introducing hallucination failures distinct from general text generation: anachronistic technology injection, cross-domain terminology contamination, structural mutation, and content fabrication. We present Grounded Optimization, a five-layer framework combining temporal context validation, deterministic contamination detection, structural invariant enforcement, prompt-level grounding, and an evaluator agent.
  In ablation experiments across three LLMs, four temperature settings, and six layer configurations on 25 synthetic resumes spanning 14 industries, undefended baselines produce 2.48-5.36 detected hallucinations per resume. Among detectors independent of the active defenses, temporal hallucinations are reduced by 50-95% across all conditions; overall detected hallucination rate falls to 0.04-0.24. Prompt-level grounding alone achieves zero detected hallucinations at low temperature with a capable instruction-following model; higher temperatures and weaker models reveal the need for the deterministic layers as a complement. We release the contamination taxonomy, evaluation code, and raw data.
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure. Equal contribution by both authors. Code and data: https://github.com/shashank-indukuri/grounded-optimization
zh_title: ERROR

title: The Evolution of the Peridynamics Community in Its First Quarter Century
authors: Biraj Dahal, Pablo Seleson
abstract: Peridynamics is a fast growing field of continuum mechanics, especially developed for the modeling and simulation of fracture problems, initiated a quarter century ago. In this study, we analyze the evolution of the peridynamics community since its inception in terms of publication co-authorship. For this purpose, we construct a peridynamics co-authorship network for each year from 2000 to 2024 and perform network analysis based on selected metrics. Nodes represent scientists, and links connect co-authoring scientists with link weights representing the number of co-authorships (based on the total number of co-authors per publication). Network-level metrics are used to quantify the evolution of the field, and node-level metrics are used to identify trends in the most collaborative scientists in peridynamics. We noticed a deviation in network trends that occurred in the years since 2019, and we subsequently performed a country-based analysis with insights about the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the evolution of the peridynamics co-authorship network.
zh_title: 近场动力学社区在第一个四分之一个世纪的演变
translation: 近场动力学是连续介质力学中一个快速发展的领域，特别适用于断裂问题的建模与模拟，始于25年前。在本研究中，我们从发表论文的共作者关系角度分析了近场动力学社区自成立以来的演变。为此，我们构建了2000年至2024年每年的近场动力学共作者网络，并基于选定的指标进行了网络分析。节点代表科学家，连边连接合作的科学家，连边权重代表共作者数量（基于每篇论文的共同作者总数）。我们利用网络级指标量化了该领域的演变，并利用节点级指标识别了近场动力学中最具合作性的科学家趋势。我们注意到2019年以后的网络趋势出现了偏差，随后进行了基于国家的分析，探讨了COVID-19大流行对近场动力学共作者网络演变的影响。
tldr: 通过分析25年间的共作者网络，研究展示了近场动力学领域的发展历程，并揭示了疫情对国际学术合作模式的改变。
ai_comments: 该研究通过文献计量学和网络分析方法，量化了近25年来近场动力学（Peridynamics）领域的发展轨迹。其创新点在于将社交网络分析应用于科研社区演化研究，并成功识别出了COVID-19疫情对国际科研合作模式的潜在干扰，为理解新兴交叉学科的成长机制提供了实证依据。
motivation: 近场动力学作为断裂力学领域新兴且快速发展的分支，其学术社区的形成与演化过程尚缺乏系统性的量化研究，因此需要通过分析共作者网络来揭示该领域的发展趋势。
method: 构建了2000年至2024年逐年的近场动力学共作者网络，通过节点（科学家）和权重连边（合作次数）进行网络指标分析，并结合国家层面的数据对比评估了疫情对科研合作的影响。
results: 研究量化了该领域的社区增长轨迹，识别了最具影响力的合作者，并发现2019年后网络趋势出现偏差，分析表明COVID-19疫情对全球合作网络的演化产生了可量化的干扰。
conclusion: 近场动力学领域在过去25年间经历了显著的社区增长和结构演变，研究揭示了该领域在2019年后合作模式的改变，并证实了疫情对全球协同研究网络结构的具体影响。

title: Comparing Architectures for Supervised Political Scaling
authors: Anna Golub, Sebastian Padó
abstract: Text scaling, the task of positioning political actors on an ideological scale, is a fundamental task in political analysis. To ease the need for manual analysis, various NLP methods have been proposed for this task, including classification- and regression-based approaches, showing successes as well as limitations. The goal of our paper is to consolidate the state of the art in this area. We ask two questions: (a) Can the performance of scaling methods be improved by predicting scales not individually but jointly? (b) Is there a middle ground between classification and regression?
zh_title: 监督式政治缩放架构的比较研究
translation: 文本缩放是将政治行为体置于意识形态尺度上的任务，是政治分析中的一项基础工作。为了减少手动分析的需求，该领域已经提出了多种NLP方法，包括基于分类和回归的方法，这些方法既有成功之处也存在局限性。本文的目标是整合该领域的现有技术。我们提出了两个问题：（a）通过联合预测而非单独预测尺度，能否提高缩放方法的性能？（b）在分类和回归之间是否存在一个折中方案？
tldr: 本文通过比较分类与回归方法，探讨了联合预测和混合架构在政治立场自动缩放任务中的应用潜力。
ai_comments: 该论文旨在对政治文本缩放领域的现有方法进行系统性梳理与评估，通过探讨联合预测与分类-回归折中方案，试图解决当前NLP方法在政治立场定位中的局限性。其意义在于为政治分析提供更高效、更准确的自动化工具。
motivation: 政治文本缩放是政治分析的基础，但现有的分类与回归方法各有利弊，需要通过整合现有技术并探索新的架构组合（如联合预测或混合模型）来提升性能，减少手动分析的需求。
method: 通过比较和评估现有的分类与回归方法，探讨联合预测（joint prediction）架构以及分类与回归之间的中间方法（middle ground approach）。
conclusion: 论文通过比较不同的架构，旨在寻找能够提升政治立场缩放性能的方法，特别关注联合预测与分类-回归混合模型的潜力。

title: From Anatomy to Smells: An Empirical Study of SKILL.md in Agent Skills
authors: David Boram Hong, Aaron Imani, Iftekhar Ahmed
abstract: Agent Skills provide on-demand domain knowledge to LLM agents without requiring model retraining. Each Agent Skill is defined by a mandatory SKILL.md file containing metadata and an unstructured Markdown body whose contents are left entirely to the skill author. Despite the rapid adoption of Agent Skills, little is known about how these files are authored or whether existing authoring guidelines are followed in practice. In this paper, we present the first systematic study of SKILL.md files as a software artifact. We qualitatively analyze 238 real-world skills and derive a taxonomy of 13 higher-level and 44 lower-level semantic components. We then conduct a multivocal literature review of 29 sources to identify best practices for authoring SKILL.md files and introduce skill smells as violations of these practices. Finally, we develop an automated detector and apply it to real-world skills, finding that over 99% of SKILL.md files contain at least one skill smell, and once introduced, skill smells rarely disappear as skills evolve. These findings reveal a substantial gap between recommended and actual authoring practices, motivating the development of automated techniques to remediate skill smells while increasing developer awareness of this emerging quality issue.
zh_title: 从解剖到异味：对智能体技能中SKILL.md的实证研究
translation: 智能体技能（Agent Skills）在无需重新训练模型的情况下为大模型智能体提供按需的领域知识。每个智能体技能都由一个强制性的SKILL.md文件定义，该文件包含元数据和一个内容完全由作者决定的非结构化Markdown主体。尽管智能体技能被迅速采用，但人们对这些文件的编写方式或现有的编写指南是否在实践中得到遵循知之甚少。在本文中，我们首次将SKILL.md文件作为软件工件进行了系统性研究。我们定性分析了238个真实世界的技能，并推导出了一个包含13个高阶和44个低阶语义组件的分类体系。随后，我们对29个来源进行了多声部文献综述，以确定编写SKILL.md文件的最佳实践，并将对这些实践的违背定义为“技能异味（skill smells）”。最后，我们开发了一个自动化检测器并将其应用于真实世界的技能，发现超过99%的SKILL.md文件至少包含一个技能异味，并且一旦引入，技能异味在技能演进过程中很少消失。这些发现揭示了推荐实践与实际编写实践之间的巨大差距，促使我们开发自动化技术来修复技能异味，同时提高开发人员对这一新兴质量问题的认识。
tldr: 本研究发现智能体开发中的技能定义文件（SKILL.md）普遍存在严重的质量缺陷（异味），且在迭代中难以自动修复，亟需引入自动化检测与修复机制。
ai_comments: 该研究首次将软件工程中的“代码异味（code smells）”概念引入到大模型智能体（Agent）的技能定义文件中，具有很强的创新性和实用价值。它揭示了当前智能体开发中存在的质量管理缺失，为未来开发更健壮的智能体系统提供了重要的实证依据和工具支持。
motivation: Agent Skills在智能体开发中被广泛应用，但目前缺乏对其核心定义文件SKILL.md的编写规范及其实际应用质量的系统性研究，导致技能质量难以保证。
method: 1. 选取238个真实世界的Agent Skills进行定性分析，构建了包含13个高阶和44个低阶语义组件的分类体系；2. 通过对29个来源的多声部文献综述，定义了“技能异味（skill smells）”并建立最佳实践指南；3. 开发自动化检测工具，评估真实世界中SKILL.md文件的质量。
results: 研究发现超过99%的SKILL.md文件至少包含一种“技能异味”，且这些异味在技能演进过程中极少被修复，反映了推荐实践与实际开发之间存在巨大鸿沟。
conclusion: 研究表明，当前的SKILL.md文件普遍存在严重的质量问题（异味），且这些问题在技能迭代中具有持续性。必须加强自动化工具的开发和开发者规范意识，以提升智能体技能的质量。

title: Social-Annotate: Self-Healing Browser Extension to Annotate and Collect Social Media Data
authors: Ali Najafi, Ismail Uluturk, Onur Varol
abstract: Human-annotated data remains foundational for machine learning and social media analysis. However, traditional data collection often relies on cumbersome pipelines that isolate content from its original source, compromising ecological validity. To address these challenges, we present Social-Annotate, a flexible browser extension that facilitates direct data collection on online platforms. By injecting customizable forms into webpages, the tool captures annotations while users interact with the native environment. Social-Annotate offers no-code design interface for the survey forms for non-technical users. Since injecting custom elements directly into host platforms creates a brittle dependency on evolving interfaces, we integrate a self-healing agent powered by large language models. This automated pipeline autonomously detects structural changes, regenerates valid target selectors, and validates them within a live browser environment. Our extensible platform readily supports 12 platforms including social media like $\mathbb{X}$, Instagram, TikTok and P2P messaging platforms WhatsApp and Telegram. Social-Annotate significantly reduces data collection overhead and developer maintenance, enabling researchers of all technical backgrounds to focus on data analysis rather than engineering. Moreover, Social-Annotate provides an ecosystem for conducting intervention studies by dynamic content manipulation.
zh_title: Social-Annotate：用于标注与采集社交媒体数据的自愈式浏览器扩展
translation: 人工标注的数据仍然是机器学习和社交媒体分析的基础。然而，传统的数据采集通常依赖于繁琐的流水线，这些流水线将内容从其原始来源中分离出来，从而损害了生态有效性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 Social-Annotate，这是一个灵活的浏览器扩展，有助于在在线平台上直接进行数据采集。通过将可定制的表单注入网页，该工具可以在用户与原生环境交互时捕获标注。Social-Annotate 为非技术用户提供了调查表单的无代码设计界面。由于直接向宿主平台注入自定义元素会产生对不断变化的界面的脆弱依赖，我们集成了一个由大型语言模型驱动的自愈代理。这种自动化流水线可以自主检测结构变化，重新生成有效的目标选择器，并在实时浏览器环境中验证它们。我们的可扩展平台很容易支持 12 个平台，包括 X、Instagram、TikTok 等社交媒体，以及 WhatsApp 和 Telegram 等 P2P 消息平台。Social-Annotate 显著降低了数据采集开销和开发人员维护成本，使所有技术背景的研究人员能够专注于数据分析而不是工程实现。此外，Social-Annotate 还为通过动态内容操作进行干预研究提供了一个生态系统。
tldr: 一款通过大语言模型实现“自愈”功能的浏览器扩展，让研究人员无需编程即可在社交媒体平台进行高效、原生的数据采集与标注。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将大语言模型（LLM）引入了浏览器扩展的维护中，解决了前端页面结构更新导致数据采集工具失效的“脆弱性”问题，实现了“自愈”功能。这对于社交媒体数据采集这一高频变动领域具有重要的工程价值和实用意义。
motivation: 传统数据采集流程往往将内容从原始环境中剥离，导致生态有效性受损；同时，直接在网页注入元素极易因平台界面更新而失效，维护成本高昂。
method: 开发了一个支持无代码设计的浏览器扩展，通过注入自定义表单进行数据标注；并集成了一个基于大语言模型的自愈代理，用于自动检测网页结构变化、重新生成目标选择器并进行在线验证。
results: 该工具支持包括 X、Instagram、TikTok、WhatsApp 和 Telegram 在内的 12 个平台，显著降低了数据采集的开销和开发维护工作量。
conclusion: Social-Annotate 成功通过自愈机制降低了社交媒体数据采集的维护成本，为研究人员提供了一个无需编程即可在原生环境下进行数据标注与干预研究的强大工具。

title: Optimal Reconfiguration of Distributed Battery Networks Under Connectivity and Energy Constraints
authors: Pranay KC, Amin Taghieh, Maria Angel Palacios, Mohammadali Rashidioun, Petras Swissler, SangWoo Park
abstract: Networked battery systems arise in industrial automation, distributed energy applications, and multi-agent systems, where terminals consume energy locally and recharge only when connected to a source. Resource constraints often limit the number of simultaneous connections, requiring networks to be dynamically reconfigured to maintain system functionality. Managing such networks in dynamic environments is challenging, particularly when low-energy terminals must be prioritized for timely replenishment. This paper presents a battery-aware topology optimization algorithm that extends the GeoSteiner framework with a tailored Mixed-Integer Linear Program (MILP) formulation for Full Steiner Tree (FST) aggregation. The formulation minimizes network length while prioritizing low-battery terminals through a weighted objective subject to a global budget constraint, enabling partial network formation under realistic resource limits. An overlap-correction term is introduced that prevents double-counting when selected trees share terminals. To capture the network reconfiguration cost between time steps, a graph-distance metric penalizes frequent topology changes, resulting in 72.2% reduction compared to a baseline without penalty. Simulations on a 20-terminal network demonstrate battery levels are effectively managed as the lowest battery level improved from 2.7% to 68.6% over 30 iterations while maintaining the topology stability and budget utilization (92%). The framework offers a principled approach to designing energy-aware, adaptive connectivity in power-limited multi-agent systems.
zh_title: 受限于连接性与能量约束的分布式电池网络最优重构研究
translation: 网络化电池系统出现在工业自动化、分布式能源应用和多智能体系统中，其中终端在本地消耗能量，仅在连接到源时才进行充电。资源约束通常限制了同时连接的数量，需要动态重构网络以维持系统功能。在动态环境中管理此类网络具有挑战性，特别是当必须优先考虑低能量终端进行及时补给时。本文提出了一种电池感知拓扑优化算法，扩展了GeoSteiner框架，并为全斯坦纳树（FST）聚合量身定制了混合整数线性规划（MILP）公式。该公式在满足全局预算约束的同时，通过加权目标函数最小化网络长度，优先考虑低电量终端，从而在现实资源限制下实现部分网络形成。引入了一个重叠修正项，防止在选定树共享终端时出现重复计算。为了捕获时间步长之间的网络重构成本，引入了图距离度量来惩罚频繁的拓扑变化，与无惩罚的基准相比，减少了72.2%。在20终端网络上的仿真表明，电池水平得到了有效管理，在30次迭代中最低电池水平从2.7%提高到68.6%，同时保持了拓扑稳定性和预算利用率（92%）。该框架为设计功率受限多智能体系统中的能量感知、自适应连接提供了一种原则性的方法。
tldr: 本文开发了一种MILP算法，通过动态优化拓扑结构，在保证预算的前提下，显著提升了分布式电池系统中的最低电池水平并减少了重构开销。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将GeoSteiner框架应用于电池网络拓扑优化，通过MILP公式化处理了能量约束与连接性之间的平衡。其亮点在于引入了重叠修正项和拓扑切换惩罚机制，有效解决了多智能体系统在资源受限环境下的动态重构问题，具有很高的实际工程应用价值。
motivation: 在工业自动化和分布式能源应用中，受限于资源约束，如何动态重构网络以确保低电量终端能及时获得补给，同时平衡网络连接性与能量需求是一个核心挑战。
method: 提出了一种基于GeoSteiner框架的改进型混合整数线性规划（MILP）公式，采用加权目标函数优先考虑低电量终端，引入重叠修正项以避免重复计算，并利用图距离度量来惩罚频繁的拓扑重构。
results: 仿真结果显示，该算法将系统最低电池水平从2.7%提升至68.6%，同时在保持92%预算利用率的前提下，将拓扑切换频率降低了72.2%。
conclusion: 本研究提出的电池感知拓扑优化框架，通过引入重叠修正与切换惩罚机制，成功实现了在资源受限下对分布式电池网络的高效管理，显著提升了系统最低电池水平并保持了拓扑稳定性。

title: Beyond Next-Token Prediction: An RLVR Proof of Concept for Tool-Use Agents on Atlassian Workflows
authors: Karthikeya Aditya Vissa, Sankalp Mane, Ananya Mantravadi, Harshit Rajgarhia, Abhishek Mukherji
abstract: Large language models are trained to predict the next token, not to act inside a specific API. In niche enterprise SaaS workflows -- where success means hitting the right endpoint with the right nested arguments in the right order -- this objective mismatch shows up as silent failures: dropped required fields, hallucinated tools, or early stops after a single read. We ask whether Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), applied directly in the target environment, closes the gap. As a proof of concept we build a suite of five synthetic environments emulating the Jira REST v3 and Confluence v2 APIs at schema fidelity; rewards are computed entirely from the tool-call trace, with no live API, no learned judge, and no human label in the loop. Scoring prompted Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3.5-4B on the same checkers that drive GRPO training, we find that on the four scenarios whose rewards are non-degenerate the RL-trained policy lifts average reward from a 4B-baseline range of 0.35--0.92 to 0.95--1.00, with the largest single gain on Confluence page creation ($0.35 \rightarrow 1.00$). We position this as a preliminary step toward outcome-optimised small models for niche enterprise APIs, and foreground two limitations a workshop reader should weigh: hand-crafting verifiable rewards does not scale beyond the handful of endpoints reported here, and one of our five scenarios (ticket-transition) has a saturating reward shape that the prompted 4B already maxes out.
zh_title: 超越下一个Token预测：面向Atlassian工作流的工具使用代理的RLVR概念验证
translation: 大语言模型被训练用于预测下一个Token，而非在特定API内执行操作。在利基企业SaaS工作流中（成功意味着在正确顺序下以正确的嵌套参数调用正确的端点），这种目标错位表现为静默失败：遗漏必要字段、工具幻觉或在单次读取后提前终止。我们探讨将强化学习与验证性奖励（RLVR）直接应用于目标环境是否能弥合这一差距。作为概念验证，我们构建了五个模拟Jira REST v3和Confluence v2 API的合成环境；奖励完全由工具调用轨迹计算得出，无需实时API、无需学习型判断器、也无人机介入。在与GRPO训练相同的检查器上评估Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3.5-4B后发现，在四个非退化奖励场景中，RL训练策略将平均奖励从4B基线的0.35–0.92提升至0.95–1.00，其中Confluence页面创建任务的增幅最大（0.35 → 1.00）。我们将其定位为迈向针对利基企业API进行结果优化的模型的第一步，并提出两项局限性：手工制作验证性奖励无法扩展到本文报告之外的更多端点；五个场景中的一个（工单转换）具有饱和的奖励形状，提示式4B模型已能达到上限。
tldr: 通过RLVR训练小模型处理企业API任务，在无需人工标注的情况下显著提升了工具调用的成功率。
ai_comments: 该论文通过RLVR解决LLM在特定企业API调用中的任务执行问题，具有很高的实践价值。创新点在于利用完全基于工具调用轨迹的无人工奖励函数，实现了小模型在复杂工作流中的高成功率。局限性在于奖励函数的构建依赖手工设计，难以规模化扩展，且部分简单任务存在奖励饱和现象。
motivation: 大语言模型本质是预测下一个Token，在执行特定企业SaaS工作流时常因参数错误、工具幻觉或逻辑链中断导致失败，缺乏针对任务成功导向的训练。
method: 构建五个模拟Jira和Confluence API的合成环境，在无需人工标注或学习型奖励模型的情况下，仅利用工具调用轨迹作为验证性奖励（RLVR），通过GRPO算法训练Qwen模型。
results: 在四个非退化奖励场景中，RL训练后的模型将平均奖励从基线的0.35–0.92提升至0.95–1.00，其中Confluence页面创建任务表现提升最为显著。
conclusion: RLVR通过直接在目标环境中进行强化学习，能有效弥补大语言模型在特定企业API操作中的成功率缺口，是构建高精度、领域专用小模型的有效途径。

title: CADENZA in Action: Breaking the Monolith with Intent-Dependent Plan Spaces for Semantic Queries
authors: Jaehyun Ha, Yongjoo Park, Wook-Shin Han
abstract: Semantic query processing engines execute semantic operators, whose behavior is specified by natural-language intents, via model inference over multimodal data. Most existing optimizers optimize the operators at the granularity of monolithic implementations -- such as LLMs and embedding models -- forcing a trade-off between expensive model calls and cheaper alternatives that fail to capture intent-dependent semantics.
