zh_title: 训练过程中保持精确等变性可实现跨对称群的零样本泛化
translation: 一个由等变编码器和预测器构建的潜在世界模型继承了其训练损失的一个可证明的对称性：当动力学过程作用于具有正交表示ρ(g)的潜在空间上的群G时，单步预测的相对均方误差（relMSE）在整个群上是精确不变的，因此拟合一个受限的定向切片在数学上决定了其在整个轨道上的表现。这种对称性在实际的Muon/AdamW+EMA+VICReg运行中得以保留（训练后组合残差约10^-6），并且单步误差在整个群上是平坦的（5次种子中位数：等变模型×1.00，而2D中更高容量的非等变基准模型为×12.7，3D中为×17.2），而该基准模型虽然拟合了切片，但在分布外表现较差。这种平坦性并非合成伪影：在真实机器人DROID末端执行器轨迹上，等变模型在整个轨道上保持平坦（×1.000，旋转残差1.5×10^-16），而大4.5倍的基准模型性能下降了11倍。一个需要注意的局限是：平坦性是必要条件而非充分条件——该定理在保持分布内误差水平不变的同时，并不能降低误差（3D relMSE约0.43）：跨群误差是恒定的，而非很低。同样的等距变换可以推广到闭环推论：在匹配的等变规划器下，控制误差在整个群上是不变的——在2D/SO(2)中是浮点精确的，在3D/SE(3)中是统计平坦的。在应对Sutton的“苦涩教训”（增强、规模、软等变）的压力测试中，每种方法最多只能缩小跨群任务指标，永远无法达到浮点精确度。这是认证世界模型程序中泛化方面的基础：平坦性传输了能力，而建立在其上的信任界限是下游产品。
tldr: 论文证明了在世界模型中使用精确等变架构，能确保模型在整个对称群轨道上的预测误差恒定，从而无需额外训练即可实现跨对称群的零样本泛化。
ai_comments: 该论文通过严格的数学证明和实证研究，揭示了等变性在提升模型零样本泛化能力中的核心地位。其最大的创新在于证明了通过等变架构训练的模型，其预测误差在对称群轨道上是恒定的，从而实现了真正的零样本泛化，而非仅仅依赖数据增强或参数规模。局限性在于该方法仅保证误差的分布一致性（平坦性），而不直接降低误差的绝对值。
motivation: 解决深度学习模型在面对对称变换（如旋转）时的泛化能力不足问题，探讨如何通过架构设计而非简单的扩充数据或增加容量来获得跨对称群的零样本泛化能力。
method: 构建基于等变编码器和预测器的潜在世界模型，利用正交表示ρ(g)确保损失函数在对称群G上的不变性，并通过Intrinsic Vector-Neuron/e3nn参数化方法在训练过程中保持精确的等变性。
results: 实验表明，等变模型在2D和3D任务中实现了跨群轨道的误差平坦（1.00倍基准），而高容量非等变基准模型在分布外场景下误差大幅恶化（高达17倍）。在真实机器人轨迹数据上，等变模型同样展现出极高的旋转平坦度。
conclusion: 精确的等变性是实现跨对称群零样本泛化的核心机制。虽然它不能降低分布内的预测误差，但能确保模型在整个对称群轨道上的能力保持一致（即误差平坦），从而在分布外场景中表现出远超非等变基准模型的鲁棒性。

title: Contrastive Deep Learning Reveals Age Biomarkers in Histopathological Skin Biopsies
authors: Kaustubh Chakradeo, Pernille Nielsen, Lise Mette Rahbek Gjerdrum, Gry Sahl Hansen, David A Duchêne, Laust H Mortensen, Majken K Jensen, Samir Bhatt
abstract: As global life expectancy increases, so does the burden of chronic diseases, yet individuals exhibit considerable variability in the rate at which they age. Identifying biomarkers that distinguish fast from slow ageing is crucial for understanding the biology of ageing, enabling early disease detection, and improving prevention strategies. Using contrastive deep learning, we show that skin biopsy images alone are sufficient to determine an individual's age. We then use visual features in histopathology slides of the skin biopsies to construct a novel biomarker of ageing. By linking with comprehensive health registers in Denmark, we demonstrate that visual features in histopathology slides of skin biopsies predict mortality and the prevalence of chronic age-related diseases. Our work highlights how routinely collected health data can provide additional value when used together with deep learning, by creating a new biomarker for ageing which can be actively used to determine mortality over time.
comment: 20 pages, 5 tables, 5 figures Under review: npj Digital Medicine
zh_title: 对比深度学习揭示皮肤组织病理学活检中的衰老生物标志物
translation: 随着全球预期寿命的增加，慢性病的负担也随之加重，但个体衰老的速度存在显著差异。识别能够区分快速衰老与缓慢衰老的生物标志物对于理解衰老生物学、实现疾病早期检测及改进预防策略至关重要。利用对比深度学习，我们证明了仅凭皮肤活检图像就足以确定个体的年龄。随后，我们利用皮肤活检组织病理学切片中的视觉特征构建了一种新型衰老生物标志物。通过与丹麦的综合健康登记系统挂钩，我们证明了皮肤活检组织病理学切片中的视觉特征可以预测死亡率及慢性年龄相关疾病的患病率。我们的研究突显了常规采集的健康数据在与深度学习结合使用时，通过创建可用于确定随时间推移的死亡率的新型衰老生物标志物，能够提供额外的价值。
tldr: 研究人员通过深度学习分析皮肤活检图像，开发出一种能预测死亡率和慢性病风险的衰老生物标志物。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将对比学习应用于常规的组织病理学图像，从而挖掘出反映生物衰老程度的生物标志物。其重要性在于证明了现有临床数据中隐藏着未被充分利用的衰老信息，为疾病预防提供了新视角。局限性在于研究对象主要基于丹麦人群，其普适性有待在更广泛的人群中验证。
motivation: 随着预期寿命延长，个体衰老速度差异巨大，迫切需要识别能够区分个体衰老程度的生物标志物，以利于早期疾病检测和预防。
method: 利用对比深度学习技术分析皮肤活检的组织病理学图像，提取视觉特征，并结合丹麦健康登记数据建立衰老生物标志物，最后通过统计模型评估其对死亡率和慢性病患病率的预测能力。
results: 研究表明，仅凭皮肤活检图像即可确定个体年龄；构建的视觉生物标志物能够显著预测死亡率及多种慢性年龄相关疾病的患病率。
conclusion: 基于组织病理学图像的对比深度学习能够有效构建衰老生物标志物，该指标不仅能预测个体衰老速度，还能有效预测死亡率及慢性病发病风险。

title: Generalizable framework of eating episode detection on free-living wrist-worn wearable data
authors: Chunzhuo Wang, Emma De Schuyteneer, Huaidong Du, Aiden Doherty, Elske Vrieze, Bart Vanrumste
abstract: Accurate assessment of eating behavior is essential for understanding and managing conditions such as eating disorders, obesity, and diabetes. Wearable-based food intake detection has shown considerable promise; however, most existing approaches are trained and evaluated using internal validation on a single dataset with fixed sensor orientation and known wearing hand, which limits their generalizability to real-world settings. Furthermore, many existing approaches rely on both accelerometer (acc) and gyroscope (gyro) signals to achieve strong performance. However, gyro measurements may be unavailable in some real-world deployments due to battery constraints, and performance often degrades when only acc data are used. We propose a generalizable framework for orientation-invariant eating episode detection, with an acc2gyro module to improve performance in acc-only settings. The framework is trained using fine-grained wrist-worn datasets and externally validated across three heterogeneous datasets: the Clemson All-Day (CAD) and Capture-24 datasets, as well as Physio-ED, a dataset collected from individuals with eating disorders. Across external evaluations, the proposed framework demonstrates robust performance despite substantial variations in sensor modality, wearing hand, participant population, and annotation protocols. Specifically, the framework achieved F1-scores of 0.751, 0.592, and 0.793 on CAD, Capture-24, and Physio-ED, respectively, with CAD performance exceeding recent state-of-the-art methods evaluated using internal validation only. This study provides the first external validation of eating episode detection in an eating disorder population. Additionally, the acc2gyro module improves the performance in acc-only settings. These findings demonstrate the potential of orientation-invariant wearable sensing for scalable and clinically applicable assessment of eating behavior.

title: Alternating Optimization for Joint Resource Allocation in Full-Duplex Multi-Sector Fluid Antenna-Enabled Near-Field Systems
authors: Jingxuan Zhou, Yinchao Yang, Zhaohui Yang, A. Hamid Aghvami, Mohammad Shikh-Bahaei
abstract: This paper proposes a full duplex fluid antenna near field system (FD-FANS) with a multi-sector antenna array that jointly exploits resource allocation, antenna mobility, and group-based transmitting (TX) and receiving (RX) partitioning. A spherical wave uplink downlink channel is established that accounts for residual self interference (SI), wireless energy transfer (WET), and geometric constraints on antenna motion. Within the FD-FANS framework, an efficient protocol is devised to enable simultaneous downlink energy transmission (DET) and uplink data transmission (UDT) at the base station (BS). Furthermore, we formulate, for both perfect and imperfect SI cancellation (SIC), a weighted sum rate (WSR) maximization problem over time power allocation, antenna positions, and binary group selection, under practical average and peak power limits, per antenna box constraints, minimum spacing, and a half TX half RX balance. To tackle the resulting non convex mixed integer design, we develop an efficient alternating optimization (AO) framework based on majorization minimization successive convex approximation (MM SCA). The proposed algorithm monotonically improves the objective and converges to a stationary solution of a continuous relaxation. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves consistent performance gains over several benchmark designs, including half duplex FANS (HD FANS), FD fixed position antenna near field system (FD FPANS), non-grouped FD FANS, and far field counterparts, in terms of average sum rate (ASR), energy efficiency (EE), and user fairness, while exhibiting robustness to residual SI and channel uncertainty.
zh_title: 全双工多扇区流体天线近场系统中联合资源分配的交替优化研究
translation: 本文提出了一种具有多扇区天线阵列的全双工流体天线近场系统（FD-FANS），旨在联合利用资源分配、天线移动性以及基于分组的发送（TX）和接收（RX）分区。建立了一个球面波上行下行信道模型，考虑了残余自干扰（SI）、无线能量传输（WET）以及天线运动的几何约束。在FD-FANS框架内，设计了一种高效协议以实现基站（BS）处的同步下行能量传输（DET）和上行数据传输（UDT）。此外，针对完美和非完美自干扰消除（SIC），在考虑实际平均和峰值功率限制、天线盒约束、最小间距以及半TX半RX平衡的情况下，构建了关于时间功率分配、天线位置和二进制分组选择的加权和速率（WSR）最大化问题。为了解决由此产生的非凸混合整数设计问题，开发了一种基于主要化最小化（MM）与连续凸近似（SCA）的高效交替优化（AO）框架。所提算法单调改进目标函数并收敛到连续松弛问题的平稳解。仿真结果表明，所提方案在平均和速率（ASR）、能量效率（EE）和用户公平性方面，均优于半双工流体天线系统（HD-FANS）、全双工固定位置天线近场系统（FD-FPANS）、非分组FD-FANS以及远场方案，并对残余自干扰和信道不确定性表现出鲁棒性。
tldr: 提出了一种全双工流体天线近场优化框架，通过交替优化算法联合处理天线移动、功率分配与分组，显著提升了系统性能。
ai_comments: 该研究将流体天线技术与全双工多扇区系统结合，并针对近场球面波模型进行了复杂资源分配优化。其创新点在于将天线位置的可移动性与分组划分相结合，利用MM-SCA算法有效解决了非凸混合整数规划问题，为提升近场通信系统的频谱与能量效率提供了新的设计框架。
motivation: 旨在解决全双工流体天线系统在近场环境下，由于自干扰、无线能量传输及天线几何约束导致的资源分配复杂性挑战，以提升系统整体性能。
method: 利用球面波信道模型，针对加权和速率（WSR）最大化问题，开发了一种基于主要化最小化（MM）与连续凸近似（SCA）的交替优化（AO）框架，以协同优化功率分配、天线位置及分组选择。
results: 仿真结果表明，该方案在平均和速率、能量效率和用户公平性方面均优于半双工流体天线系统及固定位置天线系统，且对残余自干扰和信道不确定性具有鲁棒性。
conclusion: 所提AO算法能够有效解决全双工流体天线近场系统中的非凸资源分配问题，并在系统和速率、能量效率及用户公平性方面显著优于传统基准方案。

title: Beyond Words: Towards Effective Modeling of Non-Verbal Vocalizations in ASR
authors: Gene Yang, Haibin Wu, Peng Su, Ruizhe Huang, Suwon Shon, Bach Do, Minxue Niu, Zhaoheng Ni, Shang-Wen Li, Florian Metze, Yossi Adi, Ming Sun, Yuzong Liu
abstract: Modern automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems excel at transcribing lexical content but often omit nonverbal vocalizations (NVs), such as laughter, breaths, coughs, and cries, that carry conversational and affective information. Modeling NVs in ASR is challenging because NV annotations are sparse and highly long-tailed, with frequent categories such as breaths and laughter dominating rarer events such as cries and coughs. We study three data-centric strategies for improving low-resource NV recognition: (1) a two-stage curriculum that first maps all NV events to a generic token and then fine-tunes on target categories; (2) inter-token transfer from high-resource events, such as laughter and breath, to rare events, such as crying; and (3) voice-conversion augmentation with class balancing. Experiments show that shared acoustic structure across vocal events can be exploited to improve rare-category detection while preserving lexical ASR quality.
zh_title: 言外之意：在语音识别中实现非言语发声的有效建模
translation: 现代自动语音识别（ASR）系统在转写词汇内容方面表现出色，但往往会忽略非言语发声（NVs，如笑声、呼吸、咳嗽和哭声），而这些发声承载着对话和情感信息。在ASR中对NVs进行建模具有挑战性，因为NV标注非常稀疏且呈现高度的长尾分布，呼吸和笑声等高频类别在其中占据主导地位，而哭声和咳嗽等罕见事件则较少。我们研究了三种旨在改善低资源NV识别的以数据为中心的策略：（1）两阶段课程学习，首先将所有NV事件映射到一个通用标记，然后针对目标类别进行微调；（2）词元间迁移，即从高资源事件（如笑声和呼吸）向稀有事件（如哭泣）进行迁移；（3）结合类别平衡的声音转换增强。实验表明，可以利用不同发声事件之间共享的声学结构来提高罕见类别的检测能力，同时保持词汇ASR的质量。
tldr: 本文提出了三种以数据为中心的策略，通过利用共享声学结构来改善自动语音识别中稀有非言语发声（如哭声、咳嗽）的检测，同时保证了文本识别的质量。
ai_comments: 本文针对自动语音识别（ASR）中长期被忽视但具有重要情感和交互价值的非言语发声（NV）建模展开研究，具有很强的实用价值。其创新点在于从“数据中心”的角度出发，设计了课程学习、跨词元迁移和声音转换三种策略，有效利用了不同发声之间的共享声学结构，解决了极度不平衡的长尾分布问题。局限性在于摘要未提及在具体何种基准数据集上进行了验证，以及这些策略对模型推理延迟的影响。
motivation: 尽管现代ASR系统擅长转写文本，但往往忽略了携带丰富对话和情感信息的非言语发声（如笑声、哭声等）。此外，非言语发声的标注数据极度稀疏且呈长尾分布（常见发声主导了罕见发声），给建模带来了巨大挑战。
method: 研究了三种以数据为中心的低资源NV识别改进策略：（1）两阶段课程学习：先将所有NV事件映射为通用标记，再对目标类别进行微调；（2）词元间迁移：从高资源事件（如笑声、呼吸）向稀有事件（如哭泣）迁移知识；（3）带类别平衡的声音转换增强。
results: 实验结果表明，该方法能够有效利用不同发声事件之间共享的声学结构来提高稀有类别的检测效果，同时保持了词汇ASR的识别质量。
conclusion: 利用不同非言语发声事件之间共享的声学结构，配合所提出的三种数据中心策略，可以显著提升稀有发声类别的检测性能，且不会对原有的词汇语音识别质量产生负面影响。

title: Waveform Design for Underwater Simultaneous Acoustic Information and Power Transfer
authors: Jinheng Kang, Yizhe Zhao, Kun Yang, Jun Liu
abstract: Simultaneous acoustic information and power transfer (SAIPT) plays a crucial role in enabling self-sustainable and maintenance-free Internet of Underwater Things (IoUT) networks. This paper studies a multicarrier underwater SAIPT system that jointly considers the frequency-dependent characteristics of acoustic transducers and the nonlinear behavior of rectifier circuits. The waveform vector is firstly optimized using the successive convex approximation (SCA) method under constraints on average and peak transmit power for acoustic power transfer (APT). Then, in the SAIPT scenario, both the power splitting factor and waveform vectors are jointly optimized through an alternating optimization (AO) framework based on SCA, subject to transmit power and achievable rate constraints. Simulation results demonstrate that incorporating the transducer's frequency response, rectifier nonlinearity, and the high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) of multicarrier waveforms leads to a significant improvement in acoustic energy transfer efficiency. The results also show that the energy harvesting DC output can be further enhanced by properly choosing system parameters, such as the number of subcarriers and subcarrier spacing.
zh_title: 水下声学信息与能量同步传输的波形设计
translation: 声学信息与能量同步传输（SAIPT）在实现自维持和免维护的水下物联网（IoUT）网络中起着至关重要的作用。本文研究了一种多载波水下 SAIPT 系统，该系统联合考虑了声学换能器的频率相关特性和整流电路的非线性行为。首先，在声学能量传输（APT）的平均和峰值发射功率约束下，利用渐进凸逼近（SCA）方法对波形向量进行了优化。然后，在 SAIPT 场景下，在发射功率和可达速率约束下，通过基于 SCA 的交替优化（AO）框架联合优化了功率分裂因子和波形向量。仿真结果表明，结合换能器的频率响应、整流器非线性以及多载波波形的高峰均功率比（PAPR），可以显著提高声能传输效率。结果还表明，通过合理选择子载波数量和子载波间隔等系统参数，可以进一步提高能量收集的直流输出。
keywords: 水下声学信息与能量同步传输 (SAIPT)
tldr: 本文通过联合考虑换能器频率特性和整流器非线性，提出了一种用于水下声学信息与能量同步传输（SAIPT）的多载波波形优化设计方法，显著提升了能量传输效率。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将声学换能器的频率选择性与整流电路的非线性行为共同纳入多载波水下SAIPT系统的波形设计中，这种物理层特性的联合建模更符合实际水下声通与能量传输系统的物理约束。其局限性在于摘要中仅提到仿真验证，若能有实际水池或海试实验数据支持将更具说服力。
motivation: 为了实现自维持和免维护的水下物联网（IoUT）网络，需要研究水下声学信息与能量同步传输（SAIPT）技术。然而，现有的波形设计需要克服声学换能器的频率相关特性以及整流电路的非线性行为带来的挑战。
method: 提出了一种基于多载波的波形设计方法。首先，在声能传输（APT）的平均和峰值发射功率约束下，利用渐进凸逼近（SCA）方法优化波形向量。随后，在SAIPT场景下，基于SCA构建交替优化（AO）框架，在发射功率和可达速率约束下，联合优化功率分裂因子和波形向量。
results: 仿真结果表明，联合考虑换能器频率响应、整流器非线性以及多载波波形的高峰均功率比（PAPR）能显著提高声能传输效率。同时，通过合理选择子载波数量和子载波间隔等系统参数，可以进一步增强收集到的直流电能输出。
conclusion: 合理设计多载波SAIPT系统的波形并考虑换能器频率响应和整流器非线性等实际物理特性，能够显著提升水下无线能量收集和信息传输的性能，这对于实现自维持的水下物联网至关重要。

title: Enhancing Acoustic-to-Articulatory Inversion with Multi-Target Pretraining for Low-Resource Settings
authors: Jesuraj Bandekar, Prasanta Kumar Ghosh
abstract: Acoustic-to-Articulatory Inversion (AAI) estimates vocal tract articulator movements from speech, benefiting tasks like ASR, speech synthesis, and speaker verification. While deep learning-based methods (CNNs, RNNs, Transformers) have advanced AAI, recent studies show that Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) features further enhance performance, particularly in low-resource settings. However, SSL feature extractors introduce inference latency and computational overhead. To address this, we propose a novel pretraining method leveraging three target representations-Phoneme Labels, Articulatory Feature Labels, and Critical-articulator Labels-eliminating the need for an SSL extractor during inference. We evaluate our approach against both baseline and SSL-based models across various data conditions. Results demonstrate that our method consistently improves AAI performance, particularly in low-resource scenarios, while significantly reducing inference costs without sacrificing accuracy.
zh_title: 采用多目标预训练增强低资源设置下的声学-发音反演
translation: 声学-发音反演（AAI）从语音中估计声道的发音器官运动，有益于ASR、语音合成和说话人验证等任务。虽然基于深度学习的方法（CNN、RNN、Transformer）推动了AAI的发展，但最近的研究表明，自监督学习（SSL）特征进一步提升了性能，尤其是在低资源设置下。然而，SSL特征提取器引入了推理延迟和计算开销。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的预训练方法，利用三种目标表示——音素标签、发音特征标签和关键发音器标签——从而在推理时无需SSL提取器。我们评估了我们的方法与基线模型和基于SSL的模型在各种数据条件下的表现。结果表明，我们的方法持续改进了AAI性能，特别是在低资源场景中，同时显著降低了推理成本而没有牺牲准确性。
tldr: 本文提出一种新的预训练方法，利用音素、发音特征和关键发音器标签，在低资源环境下显著提高声学-发音反演（AAI）性能，同时减少推理成本，无需自监督学习（SSL）特征提取器。
ai_comments: 这项研究通过提出一种巧妙的多目标预训练策略，成功解决了自监督学习（SSL）在声学-发音反演（AAI）中引入的计算开销问题，同时在低资源环境下保持甚至提升了性能。其创新点在于无需在推理阶段使用额外的SSL特征提取器，这对于实际应用具有重要意义。该方法为优化AAI系统提供了一个有前景的方向，特别是在资源受限的场景中。
motivation: 现有的深度学习AAI方法结合SSL特征虽然能提高性能，尤其是在低资源环境下，但SSL特征提取器会引入推理延迟和计算开销。本文旨在解决这一问题。
method: 提出一种新颖的预训练方法，利用三种目标表示：音素标签、发音特征标签和关键发音器标签。这种方法在推理时无需SSL特征提取器。
results: 实验结果表明，该方法持续提升了AAI性能，尤其是在低资源场景中，并且显著降低了推理成本，同时没有牺牲准确性。
conclusion: 该多目标预训练方法在低资源AAI任务中表现优异，有效解决了SSL特征提取器的计算开销问题，同时保持甚至提升了性能。

title: Channel Knowledge Map Reconstruction From Sparse Measurements via Pilot-Anchored Layout-Conditioned Fourier Refinement
authors: Zhonghao Jiu, Fan Meng, Yongming Huang, Hang Zhan, Zening Liu, Xiaohu You
abstract: Channel knowledge maps (CKMs) enable environment-aware wireless systems by providing location-specific channel knowledge, but long-term environmental variations, such as construction, traffic redistribution, and foliage changes, require periodic map refresh. In practice, channel measurements are often sparse and irregular, while environmental knowledge may be limited to coarse layout or topology descriptors. This paper studies CKM reconstruction from sparse measurements. We show that reconstruction pipelines that apply local aggregation or spectral operators directly to a zero-filled pilot grid can entangle the sampling mask with the channel field, allowing structural priors to act on mask-induced distortions before the measurements define a supported radio field. To address this issue, we propose Anchor-CKM, a measurement-first, knowledge-aided reconstruction framework. Anchor-CKM first uses support-aware partial convolutions to construct a pilot-supported representation, and then performs layout-conditioned dual-path Fourier refinement followed by coordinate-based heteroscedastic prediction of the CKM mean and per-location predictive variance. Experiments on transmitter-disjoint DeepMIMO scenarios cover missing ratios from 0.3 to 0.95, including stringent 5% to 10% pilot-coverage settings. In explicit-layout outdoor scenarios, Anchor-CKM reduces received-power root-mean-square error (RMSE) by 0.79 to 1.33 dB relative to the strongest reproduced baseline, while ablations identify pilot-support stabilization as the largest contributor and layout conditioning as beneficial for line-of-sight/non-line-of-sight (LOS/NLOS) boundary fidelity.

zh_title: 基于导频锚定与布局条件傅里叶细化的稀疏测量信道知识地图重构
translation: 信道知识地图（CKM）通过提供特定位置的信道知识来支持环境感知无线系统，但长期的环境变化（如建筑施工、交通重新分布和植被变化）需要定期更新地图。在实际应用中，信道测量往往是稀疏且不规则的，而环境知识可能仅限于粗糙的布局或拓扑描述。本文研究了基于稀疏测量的CKM重构。我们表明，直接在零填充导频网格上应用局部聚合或谱算子的重构流程会使采样掩码与信道场纠缠在一起，导致结构先验在测量定义支撑无线电场之前就作用于掩码引起的畸变。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Anchor-CKM，这是一个“测量优先、知识辅助”的重构框架。Anchor-CKM首先使用支持感知部分卷积来构建导频支撑的表示，然后进行布局条件双路径傅里叶细化，最后基于坐标对CKM均值和每个位置的预测方差进行异方差预测。在发射机不相交的DeepMIMO场景中进行的实验涵盖了0.3到0.95的缺失比例，包括极端的5%到10%导频覆盖率设置。在显式布局的室外场景中，与最强的复现基线相比，Anchor-CKM将接收功率均方根误差（RMSE）降低了0.79至1.33 dB，而消融实验表明导频支撑稳定化是贡献最大的因素，布局条件对视距/非视距（LOS/NLOS）边界保真度有益。
tldr: 本文提出了Anchor-CKM框架，利用支持感知部分卷积和布局条件双路径傅里叶细化，从稀疏、不规则的测量中高效且高精度地重构信道知识地图。
ai_comments:
1. 创新性：提出了“测量优先、知识辅助”的重构思路，利用支持感知部分卷积有效解决了稀疏采样中掩码与信道场纠缠的问题。
2. 实用性：在极其稀疏（如仅5%-10%的导频覆盖率）的场景下，仍能实现高精度的CKM重构，对未来环境感知无线系统非常重要。
3. 局限性：摘要中主要在DeepMIMO仿真场景下进行了评估，实际复杂多变环境中的鲁棒性仍有待在真实物理环境中进一步验证。
motivation: 长期环境变化（如建筑施工、交通重新分布和植被变化）要求定期更新信道知识地图（CKM）。然而，实际中的信道测量通常是稀疏且不规则的。直接在零填充导频网格上应用局部聚合或谱算子会导致采样掩码与信道场纠缠，使结构先验在测量定义支撑无线电场之前就作用于掩码引起的畸变。因此，需要一种能够从稀疏测量和粗糙环境布局中准确重构CKM的方法。
method: 提出了一种“测量优先、知识辅助”的重构框架 Anchor-CKM。该框架首先使用支持感知部分卷积（support-aware partial convolutions）来构建导频支撑的表示，然后进行布局条件双路径傅里叶细化（layout-conditioned dual-path Fourier refinement），最后基于坐标对CKM均值和每个位置的预测方差进行异方差预测（heteroscedastic prediction）。
results: 在发射机不相交的DeepMIMO场景下进行实验，涵盖了0.3到0.95的缺失比例（包括5%到10%的极低导频覆盖率）。在显式布局的室外场景中，与最强的复现基线相比，Anchor-CKM将接收功率均方根误差（RMSE）降低了0.79至1.33 dB。消融实验表明，导频支撑稳定化是性能提升的最大贡献者，而布局条件对于视距/非视距（LOS/NLOS）边界保真度非常有益。
conclusion: Anchor-CKM通过解决采样掩码与信道场纠缠的问题，能够有效地从极度稀疏和不规则的测量数据中重构高精度的信道知识地图，其中导频支撑稳定化和布局条件对提高重构精度和边界保真度起到了关键作用。

title: Antenna System for Simultaneous Wireless Power and Information Transfer to Brain Implants
authors: Ali Khaleghi, Aminolah Hassanvand, Ilangko Balasingham
abstract: Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) have revolutionized neuroscience applications, from motor rehabilitation to neuroergonomics. Traditional implantable BCIs with invasive microelectrode arrays pose challenges, notably the need for wired connections and inherent implantation risks. This paper introduces a battery-free wireless BCI system, consolidating an implant and its external supporting system. Our design centers on a dual-function antenna system: firstly, an inductive coupling mechanism enables wireless power transfer, sufficiently powering the implant's Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) for stimulation and readout without an implant battery. Secondly, a backscatter antenna in the implant facilitates battery-free, high-data-rate wireless connectivity (up to 32 Mbps). This system not only enhances the BCI experience by eliminating wires but also retains data fidelity and energy efficiency, promising a safer, more efficient interface for tasks like robotic arm control.

title: Integrated Wake-Up Radio and MIMO Solution for Cellular IoT Networks
authors: Israa Khaled, Ammar El Falou, Nour Kouzayha, Charlotte Langlais
abstract: Wake-up radio (WUR) is a technology designed to enhance the energy efficiency of Internet of Things (IoT) networks and extend device battery life. While most studies focus on WUR performance with single-antenna base stations, this paper investigates the multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) technology to improve device energy saving and extend the coverage of wake-up signals. By leveraging MIMO beamforming, the transmitted energy can be spatially focused toward the intended IoT devices, with high beamforming gain and minimal inter-device interference. We develop a preliminary analytical framework using stochastic geometry to evaluate the wake-up success probability of WUR-MIMO in multi-cell cellular IoT networks, when the number of antennas equals $2 \times (\text{number of devices}) - 1$. Monte Carlo simulations show that, relative to a single-antenna WUR baseline, MIMO beamforming significantly enhances wake-up reliability when this antenna configuration is applied, mitigates more than 50% of false activations across all settings, and thereby prolongs the lifetime of IoT devices.
comment: To appear in the IEEE Vehicular Technology Conference (VTC) Fall 2026
zh_title: 蜂窝物联网中集成唤醒无线电和MIMO解决方案
translation: 唤醒无线电（WUR）是一种旨在提高物联网（IoT）网络能源效率并延长设备电池寿命的技术。虽然大多数研究关注WUR在单天线基站下的性能，但本文研究了多输入多输出（MIMO）技术，以改善设备节能并扩展唤醒信号的覆盖范围。通过利用MIMO波束赋形，发射能量可以空间聚焦到目标物联网设备，具有高波束赋形增益和最小的设备间干扰。我们使用随机几何学开发了一个初步的分析框架，以评估在天线数量等于 $2 \times (\text{设备数量}) - 1$ 时，多小区蜂窝物联网网络中WUR-MIMO的唤醒成功概率。蒙特卡洛仿真表明，相对于单天线WUR基线，当应用此天线配置时，MIMO波束赋形显著增强了唤醒可靠性，在所有设置下缓解了超过50%的错误激活，从而延长了物联网设备的寿命。
tldr: 本文研究了在蜂窝物联网中使用MIMO技术与唤醒无线电结合，以提高设备能效、延长电池寿命并增强唤醒信号覆盖和可靠性。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将MIMO技术与唤醒无线电相结合，通过空间聚焦能量来解决传统WUR在多天线场景下的性能限制和干扰问题。其提出的分析框架和仿真结果证实了MIMO在提升唤醒可靠性和能效方面的潜力，对蜂窝物联网的低功耗设计具有重要意义。
motivation: 唤醒无线电（WUR）旨在提高物联网网络的能效并延长设备电池寿命。现有研究多集中于单天线基站的WUR性能，但本文旨在通过MIMO技术进一步提升设备节能、扩展唤醒信号覆盖并提高可靠性。
method: 利用MIMO波束赋形将能量空间聚焦到目标IoT设备，实现高波束赋形增益和最小的设备间干扰。使用随机几何学开发了一个初步的分析框架，评估多小区蜂窝IoT网络中WUR-MIMO的唤醒成功概率，天线数量设置为 $2 \times (\text{设备数量}) - 1$。通过蒙特卡洛仿真进行验证。
results: 相较于单天线WUR基线，MIMO波束赋形显著增强了唤醒可靠性。在所有设置下，MIMO缓解了超过50%的错误激活。延长了IoT设备的寿命。
conclusion: 结合MIMO波束赋形的唤醒无线电技术可以显著提高蜂窝物联网设备的能效、唤醒可靠性，减少错误激活，从而延长设备寿命。

title: LMPAN: A Lightweight Multi-Path Alignment Network for Joint Full-Duplex Acoustic Echo Cancellation and Noise Suppression
authors: Chengwei Liu, Shaofei Xue, Haoyin Yan, Xiaotao Liang, Zheng Xue
abstract: We propose a lightweight multi-path alignment network (LMPAN) for on-device joint acoustic echo cancellation (AEC) and noise suppression (NS) in full-duplex spoken dialogue systems. To address hardware-induced distortions and dynamic acoustic conditions, we introduce three core innovations: (1) a multi-path alignment stage correcting temporal and energy mismatches across reference, linear AEC (LAEC) output, and microphone signals; (2) an attention-based mechanism that dynamically integrates enhanced LAEC and microphone features under varying acoustic scenarios; (3) a post-filtering module with a dynamic target generation strategy for downstream tasks (ASR, VAD). Furthermore, we adopt a two-stage training framework leveraging self-supervised learning representations to enhance perceptual quality. Experiments show that LMPAN, with only 480K parameters and 126 MACs, achieves performance comparable to the state-of-the-art lightweight model DeepVQE-S, while ensuring real-time inference capability.

title: Rethinking Fractional Programming for Joint Uplink Scheduling and Power Control in Multicell Wireless Networks
authors: Zihan Jiao, Xinping Yi, Shi Jin, Giuseppe Caire
abstract: This paper investigates the joint uplink scheduling and power control problem in a coordinated multicell wireless network, where at most one single-antenna user is allowed to access the single-antenna base station in each cell simultaneously. The resulting weighted sum-rate (WSR) maximization problem is a mixed discrete-continuous, nonconvex optimization problem that is notoriously difficult to solve directly. Classical fractional programming (FP) methods tackle this problem by leveraging the Lagrangian dual transform (LDT) followed by the quadratic transform (QT), yielding a tractable closed-form solution for scheduling and power control, with the LDT playing a crucial role in handling discrete variables. In this paper, we revisit the LDT from a minorization-maximization (MM) perspective and observe that its induced surrogate is somehow conservative due to the reciprocal-coordinate construction. Motivated by this observation, we propose a novel reciprocal-inversion transform (RIT) that constructs a tighter first-order Taylor expansion lower bound for the logarithmic rate function. The proposed RIT remains fully compatible with the QT, leading to a surrogate-enhanced FP (SEFP) algorithm for joint uplink scheduling and power control. The proposed SEFP algorithm retains the desirable per-cell separability of the classical FP framework and admits closed-form updates for the auxiliary variables, scheduling decisions, and transmit powers. Simulation results demonstrate that the SEFP algorithm consistently outperforms the classical FP method and other baselines for different network utilities.
zh_title: 重新思考多小区无线网络中联合上行链路调度与功率控制的分数规划
translation: 本文研究了协调多小区无线网络中的联合上行链路调度和功率控制问题，其中每个小区最多允许一个单天线用户同时访问单天线基站。由此产生的加权和速率（WSR）最大化问题是一个混合离散-连续的非凸优化问题，直接解决非常困难。经典的分数规划（FP）方法通过利用拉格朗日对偶变换（LDT）以及随后的二次变换（QT）来解决此问题，为调度和功率控制提供了可处理的闭式解，其中LDT在处理离散变量方面发挥着关键作用。在本文中，我们从小化-最大化（MM）的角度重新审视了LDT，并观察到其诱导的代理函数由于倒数坐标构造而显得有些保守。受此观察的启发，我们提出了一种新颖的倒数反演变换（RIT），它为对数速率函数构造了更紧密的一阶泰勒展开下界。所提出的RIT与QT保持完全兼容，从而形成了一种用于联合上行链路调度和功率控制的代理增强型分数规划（SEFP）算法。所提出的SEFP算法保留了经典FP框架的理想每小区可分离性，并允许辅助变量、调度决策和发射功率的闭式更新。仿真结果表明，SEFP算法在不同的网络效用下始终优于经典FP方法和其他基线。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的倒数反演变换（RIT），并将其整合到分数规划（FP）框架中，形成了替代增强型FP（SEFP）算法，用于解决多小区无线网络中的联合上行链路调度和功率控制问题。SEFP算法通过构建更紧密的对数速率函数下界，在仿真中表现优于传统FP方法和其他基线。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了倒数反演变换（RIT），它从MM角度出发，解决了传统LDT在构建代理函数时存在的保守性问题，通过提供更紧密的下界，有效提升了分数规划算法的性能。这种方法不仅保持了传统FP算法的优点（如每小区可分离性和闭式解），还显著提高了优化效果，对于解决无线网络资源分配中的非凸优化问题具有重要意义。
motivation: 多小区无线网络中的加权和速率（WSR）最大化问题是一个混合离散-连续的非凸优化问题，直接解决非常困难。传统的整数规划（FP）方法在处理离散变量时，其拉格朗日对偶变换（LDT）诱导的代理函数因倒数坐标构造而显得保守。受此启发，本文旨在提出一种更有效的方法来解决这一问题。
method: 本文从小化-最大化（MM）的角度重新审视了拉格朗日对偶变换（LDT），并提出了一种新颖的倒数反演变换（RIT）。RIT为对数速率函数构建了更紧密的一阶泰勒展开下界，并与二次变换（QT）完全兼容，从而引出了代理增强型分数规划（SEFP）算法。SEFP算法保留了传统FP框架的每小区可分离性，并支持辅助变量、调度决策和发射功率的闭式更新。
results: 仿真结果表明，SEFP算法在不同的网络效用下，始终优于传统的FP方法和其他基线。
conclusion: 代理增强型分数规划（SEFP）算法通过引入倒数反演变换（RIT）来构建更紧密的下界，有效地解决了多小区无线网络中的联合上行链路调度和功率控制问题，并在性能上超越了传统方法。

title: Three-Dimensional Spatial Correlation Modeling for Cylindrical mMIMO Arrays in HAPS
authors: Shasha Liu, Abla Kammoun, Mohamed-Slim Alouini
abstract: High-altitude platform stations (HAPS) are envisioned as a key component of future wireless networks, enabling ultra-wide coverage and providing direct connectivity to users with cylindrical massive multiple-input multiple-output (mMIMO) systems. Exploiting the channel degrees of freedom necessitates accurate modeling and characterization of three-dimensional (3D) channels in the presence of spatial correlation functions (SCFs). However, existing spatial correlation models are primarily developed for planar or linear antenna arrays and cannot be directly applied to cylindrical geometries commonly adopted by HAPS platforms. To address this limitation, this paper derives an exact closed-form expression for the SCF of 3D MIMO channels with antenna elements arranged in a cylindrical array. The proposed formulation is based on the spherical harmonic expansion (SHE) of plane waves and accommodates arbitrary antenna radiation patterns and angular distributions through the Fourier series (FS) coefficients of the power azimuth and zenith spectra. The derived SCF is validated through Monte Carlo simulations under standard-compliant settings.
zh_title: 面向高空平台（HAPS）圆柱大规模MIMO阵列的三维空间相关性建模
translation: 高空平台站（HAPS）被视为未来无线网络的关键组成部分，能够实现超广覆盖，并通过圆柱形大规模多输入多输出（mMIMO）系统直接为用户提供连接。充分利用信道自由度需要对存在空间相关函数（SCF）的三维（3D）信道进行精确建模和表征。然而，现有的空间相关模型主要是为平面或线性天线阵列开发的，不能直接应用于HAPS平台通常采用的圆柱几何结构。为了解决这一局限性，本文推导了天线单元排列在圆柱阵列中的3D MIMO信道SCF的精确闭式表达式。所提出的公式基于平面波的球面波展开（SHE），并通过功率方位角和天顶角谱的傅里叶级数（FS）系数来适应任意天线辐射方向图和角分布。导出的SCF已在符合标准的设置下通过蒙特卡洛仿真进行了验证。
tldr: 本文为高空平台（HAPS）的圆柱形大规模MIMO天线阵列推导了一种全新的三维空间相关性闭式模型，解决了现有平面模型不适用的问题。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将球面波展开（SHE）方法应用于圆柱阵列，填补了现有空间相关性模型在圆柱几何结构应用上的空白。这种方法具有通用性，能够灵活处理不同的天线辐射方向图和角分布，对于未来高空平台（HAPS）大规模MIMO系统的设计和性能评估具有重要价值。
motivation: 现有的三维空间相关性模型主要针对平面或线性阵列，无法直接应用于HAPS中常见的圆柱形大规模MIMO阵列，因此需要建立适用于圆柱几何结构的高精度信道模型。
method: 基于球面波展开（SHE）推导三维MIMO信道的空间相关函数闭式解，利用傅里叶级数（FS）系数处理任意天线辐射方向图和功率方位角/天顶角谱。
results: 成功推导出圆柱阵列空间相关函数的精确闭式表达式，并通过蒙特卡洛仿真验证了该模型的有效性。
conclusion: 研究推导出了适用于HAPS圆柱阵列的三维空间相关函数闭式解，并通过蒙特卡洛仿真验证了其准确性，为该场景下的信道建模提供了有效的数学工具。

title: Complexity-Scalable Direct Geolocation and Cancellation of Terrestrial GNSS Jammers: Single-Satellite and Multi-Antenna Experiments in Low Earth Orbit
authors: Giacomo Pojani, Javier Tegedor, Joaquim Fortuny-Guasch, Francesco Menzione, David Evans, Tim Oerther, Maximilian Henkel, Jonas Stene Lindbjor
abstract: Monitoring the radio-frequency (RF) spectrum from space imposes demanding requirements to satellite platforms in terms of communication bandwidth and computational resources, which are necessary for the downlink, the storage, and the processing of high-throughput I/Q samples. This paper analyzes in depth the quasi-direct geolocation (QDG) as a technique to enable the exploitation of satellites of opportunity in low Earth orbit (LEO) to sense the spectrum in the bands of global navigation satellite systems (GNSS). This is a technique of passive RF geolocation and consists of an ensemble of signal processing algorithms, which compress the I/Q samples and process the compressed data through fast delay-Doppler shift matching and interferometry in a quantized time-frequency domain. These algorithms speed up the exhaustive search of multiple RF sources in the position domain. The efficiency gain addresses the bottleneck that prevents the employment of satellites, which are limited in downlink capacity and on-board computational power. These satellites are usually constrained in size, weight and power (SWaP) and represent most of the spacecrafts in LEO. The ability to exploit assets as such for the geolocation of terrestrial GNSS jammers in near real time is instrumental the performance of a multi-constellation GNSS RFI monitoring system. The present work describes the mathematical framework and precision bounds, introduces single- and multi-antenna uses cases, combines different compression methods, and evaluates the geolocation accuracy with real data. The I/Q samples were collected by a repurposed GNSS reflectometry (GNSS-R) satellite, OPS-SAT PRETTY, in a dedicated test session during Jammertest 2025. The experimental results demonstrate the capability to geolocate GNSS jammers with different signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) with extremely high compression ratios.

title: Cross Domain Few-Shot Class-Incremental Audio Classification Via Adversarial Contrastive Learning
authors: Yongjie Si, Yanxiong Li, Sen Huang, Beibei Liu
abstract: Current Few-shot Class-incremental Audio Classification (FCAC) methods assume that samples of base and incremental classes are in the same domain (following the same distribution). However, there is generally a domain shift between the above two types of samples. In this paper, we explore the problem of Cross Domain FCAC where samples of base and incremental classes have domain shift. We propose a strategy of adversarial contrastive training which enables the model to effectively classify samples of different classes from unseen domains. The model consists of an encoder and a classifier. The encoder is trained in base session but frozen in incremental sessions, whereas the classifier is trained in all sessions. Experiments are done on six pairs of cross-domain datasets. Results show that our method exceeds state-of-the-art methods in average accuracy. The code is at https://github.com/YongjieSi/ACL.

zh_title: 基于对抗性对比学习的跨域少样本类增量音频分类
translation: 目前的少样本类增量音频分类（FCAC）方法假设基类和增量类的样本处于同一域（遵循相同的分布）。然而，上述两类样本之间通常存在域偏移。在本文中，我们探讨了基类和增量类样本存在域偏移的跨域FCAC问题。我们提出了一种对抗性对比训练策略，使模型能够有效地对来自未见领域的不同类别的样本进行分类。该模型由一个编码器和一个分类器组成。编码器在基类阶段进行训练，但在增量阶段被冻结，而分类器在所有阶段进行训练。实验在六对跨域数据集上进行。结果表明，我们的方法在平均准确率上超过了现有的先进方法。代码地址为 https://github.com/YongjieSi/ACL。
tldr: 针对音频分类中基类与增量类之间的域偏移问题，本文提出了一种对抗性对比学习策略，有效提升了跨域少样本类增量分类的准确率。
ai_comments: 该论文针对音频分类领域中一个现实且具有挑战性的问题——跨域少样本类增量学习（Cross Domain FCAC）提出了创新的解决方案。通过引入对抗性对比学习，模型能够更好地处理域偏移问题，提升了在未知领域下的分类鲁棒性。其局限性在于对模型架构（冻结编码器）的依赖程度较高，可能限制了在极端分布差异下的性能上限。
motivation: 现有的少样本类增量音频分类（FCAC）方法通常假设基类和增量类样本处于同一分布，但实际应用中存在明显的域偏移问题，导致模型性能下降。
method: 提出了一种对抗性对比训练策略。模型由编码器和分类器组成，其中编码器在基类阶段训练后在增量阶段保持冻结，而分类器在所有阶段进行训练。
results: 在六对跨域数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法在平均准确率方面超过了当前的先进方法。
conclusion: 本文提出的对抗性对比训练策略有效解决了跨域少样本类增量音频分类中的域偏移难题，在多个跨域数据集上验证了其优越性，显著提升了音频分类模型的泛化能力。

title: Spatial Speech Perception Systems: A Survey of Sound Source Localization, Directional Enhancement, and Speech Recognition
authors: Pengyuan Shao, Dimitrios Kanoulas
abstract:
Robust speech understanding in real-world acoustic environments remains a fundamental challenge for intelligent auditory systems such as robot audition, hearing aids, teleconferencing systems, smart speakers, and voice-controlled assistants. These systems must operate under background noise, reverberation, competing speakers, and dynamic acoustic conditions. Spatial speech perception addresses this challenge by exploiting microphone-array information to localize, enhance, and interpret target speech in complex acoustic scenes.
  This paper surveys spatial speech perception systems with emphasis on the roles of sound source localization (SSL), directional speech enhancement (DSE), and automatic speech recognition (ASR), both individually and within integrated processing pipelines. We review classical signal-processing approaches and recent learning-based methods for microphone-array localization, beamforming, neural enhancement, speech separation, and modern recognition architectures. Beyond component-level analysis, we discuss robustness to noise and reverberation, multi-speaker operation, real-time constraints, and computational efficiency. We also examine representative applications in robot audition, hearing assistance, smart speakers, and teleconferencing, and identify open challenges and future directions toward robust, low-latency, and perception-aware speech systems for complex acoustic environments.

title: Robust Transmission Design for RIS-Assisted RSMA-SWIPT Systems With Movable Antennas Under Hardware Distortions
authors: Muhammad Asif, Asim Ihsan, Irfan Muhammad, Mohd Hamza Naim Shaikh, Syed Tariq Shah, Zhu Shoujin, Symeon Chatzinotas
abstract: This paper investigates a robust transmission design for a multi-user rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA)-based simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) system empowered by movable antennas (MAs) and a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) under channel state information (CSI) uncertainty and residual hardware impairments (HIs). The effective channels in MAs-enabled systems depend on antenna positions, causing CSI uncertainty to affect not only active and passive beamforming but also antenna position optimization. Furthermore, residual HIs distort the effective SINRs, creating additional coupling among beamforming, RIS reflection control, common-rate allocation, power-splitting ratio optimization, and antenna position optimization. Consequently, the joint impact of CSI uncertainty and HIs leads to a highly coupled and challenging resource allocation problem. To address this challenge, we propose a robust resource allocation framework that jointly optimizes common-rate allocation, transmit beamforming, RIS reflection coefficients, power-splitting ratios, and MAs positions to maximize the achievable sum-rate while satisfying practical system constraints. To obtain an efficient solution, the original problem is decomposed into active beamforming, RIS reflection design, power-splitting ratio optimization, and MAs position optimization subproblems, where tractable convex surrogate functions are constructed to handle the non-convex objective and constraints. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed framework and demonstrate substantial improvements in achievable sum-rate, robustness against CSI uncertainty and hardware impairments, and convergence performance compared with benchmark schemes.

title: Beyond Beamforming: Phase-and-Gain Channel Shaping via Rotatable Antenna Arrays
authors: Xingxiang Peng, Qingqing Wu, Ziyuan Zheng, Wen Chen, Guangchi Zhang
abstract: This paper investigates geometry-reconfigurable transmission for multiuser communication systems enabled by a rotatable antenna array. In contrast to conventional fixed arrays, the proposed architecture jointly exploits array pose adjustment and element-level boresight steering, thereby reshaping both the array-induced phase responses and the direction-dependent channel gains. We formulate a weighted sum-rate maximization problem that jointly optimizes the transmit beamformers, array pose, and element boresights under practical visibility and steering constraints. To reveal the underlying design principles, we first provide a geometric interpretation via zero-forcing analysis, showing that the resulting rates stem from both channel-strength enhancement and spatial-separability improvement. Specifically, array-pose rotation improves inter-user channel orthogonality even with isotropic elements, whereas directional elements introduce a tradeoff between phase-based spatial separation and boresight-dependent gain alignment. Motivated by these insights, we develop an efficient optimization framework that jointly coordinates transmit beamforming, array-pose adaptation, and element-boresight steering to exploit the geometry-induced phase-and-gain channel-shaping capability. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed joint design outperforms fixed-array, pose-only, and boresight-only benchmarks, with larger gains achieved under more directive element patterns and tighter boresight-steering constraints.

zh_title: 超越波束赋形：基于可旋转天线阵列的相位与增益信道整形
translation: 本文研究了由可旋转天线阵列支持的多用户通信系统的几何重构传输。与传统的固定阵列相比，所提出的架构联合利用了阵列姿态调整和单元级视轴（boresight）转向，从而重塑了阵列引起的相位响应和方向相关的信道增益。我们建立了一个加权和速率最大化问题，在实际可见性和转向约束下联合优化发射波束赋形、阵列姿态和单元视轴。为了揭示潜在的设计原则，我们首先通过零强制分析提供了几何解释，表明所得速率源于信道强度增强和空间可分性改善。具体而言，即使使用各向同性单元，阵列姿态旋转也能提高用户间信道的正交性，而方向性单元则在基于相位的空间分离和依赖视轴的增益对齐之间引入了权衡。受这些见解的启发，我们开发了一个高效的优化框架，联合协调发射波束赋形、阵列姿态自适应和单元视轴转向，以利用几何诱导的相位和增益信道整形能力。仿真结果表明，所提出的联合设计方案优于固定阵列、仅姿态调整和仅视轴转向的基准方案，并且在更具方向性的单元模式和更严格的视轴转向约束下取得了更大的增益。
tldr: 提出了一种可旋转天线阵列架构，通过联合优化阵列姿态和天线指向来重塑信道，从而显著提升多用户系统的通信性能。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的硬件架构（可旋转天线阵列），通过物理层面的几何重构来优化信道特性。其核心贡献在于将传统的波束赋形扩展到了阵列姿态和单元指向的联合优化，为未来灵活通信系统的设计提供了新思路。局限性在于实际物理旋转机制的响应速度和机械复杂性可能限制其在高速移动场景的应用。
motivation: 传统固定天线阵列难以灵活应对复杂多变的通信环境，作者旨在通过引入可旋转天线阵列，利用物理几何重构来同时改变阵列的相位响应和方向相关的信道增益，从而突破传统波束赋形的限制。
method: 提出了一个联合优化发射波束赋形、阵列姿态和单元指向的框架，通过零强制（Zero-Forcing）分析揭示了其几何设计原理，并开发了高效的优化算法进行求解。
results: 仿真结果表明，所提的联合设计方案在速率表现上优于固定阵列、仅优化姿态和仅优化指向的基准方案，且在天线方向性更强及指向约束更紧时增益尤为显著。
conclusion: 通过联合优化发射波束赋形、阵列姿态和单元指向，可旋转天线阵列能显著提升多用户通信系统的加权和速率，优于传统的固定阵列方案。

title: An Adaptive Glicko-2 Rating Framework for Probabilistic Football Forecasting and Season Simulation
authors: Bich Van Nguyen, Nam Anh Tran
abstract: Football match outcome prediction is a challenging problem because team strength changes over time, match outcomes contain a high level of randomness, and draws play a central role in the result structure. Classical rating systems such as Elo provide simple and interpretable dynamic summaries of team ability, but they do not explicitly model uncertainty and often ignore football-specific contextual information. This paper proposes an adaptive Glicko-2-based rating framework for probabilistic football forecasting and leaguelevel season simulation. The proposed framework extends the standard Glicko-2 model by incorporating football-specific mechanisms, including margin-of-victory adjustment, dominance weighting, structural shocks, home advantage modelling, and an ordered-logit draw model. The framework estimates latent team strength dynamically, converts rating differences into win-draw-loss probabilities, and uses these probabilities to simulate the remaining part of a league season through Monte Carlo sampling.
zh_title: 一种用于概率足球预测和赛季模拟的自适应 Glicko-2 评分框架
translation: 足球比赛结果预测是一个具有挑战性的问题，因为球队实力随时间变化，比赛结果包含高度随机性，并且平局在结果结构中扮演着核心角色。Elo 等经典评分系统提供了简单且可解释的球队能力动态摘要，但它们没有明确地建模不确定性，并且经常忽略足球特定的上下文信息。本文提出了一种基于自适应 Glicko-2 的评分框架，用于概率足球预测和联赛级别赛季模拟。所提出的框架通过纳入足球特定机制扩展了标准 Glicko-2 模型，包括胜负分调整、优势权重、结构性冲击、主场优势建模以及有序 Logit 平局模型。该框架动态估计潜在的球队实力，将评分差异转换为胜-平-负概率，并利用这些概率通过蒙特卡洛抽样模拟联赛赛季的剩余部分。
tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应 Glicko-2 框架，用于足球预测和赛季模拟，通过纳入足球特定因素和平局模型来改进预测。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于，它将 Glicko-2 模型应用于复杂的足球领域，并对其进行了适应和扩展，明确解决了足球特有的挑战，如平局、主场优势和动态球队实力，这些是经典模型经常忽视的。这种方法有望带来更准确和细致的概率预测。
motivation: 足球比赛结果预测是一个具有挑战性的问题，因为球队实力随时间变化，比赛结果包含高度随机性，并且平局在结果结构中扮演着核心角色。经典的评分系统（如 Elo）无法明确建模不确定性，并且经常忽略足球特定的上下文信息。
method: 本文提出了一种基于自适应 Glicko-2 的评分框架。该框架通过纳入足球特定机制扩展了标准 Glicko-2 模型，包括胜负分调整、优势权重、结构性冲击、主场优势建模以及有序 Logit 平局模型。该框架动态估计潜在的球队实力，将评分差异转换为胜-平-负概率，并利用这些概率通过蒙特卡洛抽样模拟联赛赛季的剩余部分。

title: Sensitivity Analysis and Optimization of Stochastic Epidemic Models under Parameter Uncertainty
authors: Nicholas R. Wu, Michael C. Fu
abstract:
To address sensitivity analysis and optimization for a discrete-time stochastic epidemic model, we derive unbiased gradient estimators that accommodate uncertainties represented as distributions over the parameters of interest, such as those arising from Bayesian calibration.
  Specifically, we estimate the sensitivity of total infections over a finite time horizon with respect to the proportion immunized ($v$) and the contact rate ($β$). Comparing the proposed estimators with deterministic limit approximations based on large populations reveals differences due to the finite population and time horizon. The estimators exhibit lower variance than finite-difference estimators for the derivative with respect to $β$, but higher variance for the derivative with respect to $v$. Simulation experiments indicate parameter uncertainty reduces sensitivity to the parameters of interest. In particular, indirect effects of vaccination, such as herd immunity, are less pronounced compared to when parameters are known. For optimization problems balancing intervention and infection costs, incorporating parametric uncertainty leads to more conservative policies.
zh_title: 参数不确定性下随机流行病模型的敏感性分析与优化
translation: 为了解决离散时间随机流行病模型的敏感性分析和优化问题，我们推导了无偏梯度估计器，该估计器能够容纳表示为目标参数分布的不确定性（例如由贝叶斯校准产生的不确定性）。具体而言，我们估计了在有限时间跨度内，总感染人数对免疫比例（$v$）和接触率（$\beta$）的敏感性。将所提出的估计器与基于大群体的确定性极限近似进行对比，揭示了由于有限群体和有限时间跨度带来的差异。在对 $\beta$ 求导时，该估计器的方差低于有限差分估计器，但在对 $v$ 求导时方差较高。模拟实验表明，参数不确定性降低了系统对目标参数的敏感性。特别是，与参数已知时相比，疫苗接种的间接效应（如群体免疫）变得不那么明显。对于平衡干预成本和感染成本的优化问题，纳入参数不确定性会导致产生更为保守的决策。
tldr: 本文提出了一种适用于参数不确定性环境下的随机流行病模型无偏梯度估计器，研究表明参数不确定性会降低敏感性，并在成本优化中导致更保守的防疫政策。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于在随机流行病模型中引入了能够处理参数不确定性（如贝叶斯校准得到的分布）的无偏梯度估计器，这对于实际流行病学决策具有重要意义。然而，其局限性在于，在针对免疫比例（v）求导时，所提估计器的方差高于传统的有限差分估计器，这表明在某些特定参数的敏感性分析中仍有改进空间。
motivation: 旨在解决离散时间随机流行病模型在参数存在不确定性（例如由贝叶斯校准引起的不确定性）时的敏感性分析和优化问题。
method: 推导了无偏梯度估计器，该估计器能够容纳表示为目标参数分布的不确定性。具体而言，该方法用于估计在有限时间跨度内，总感染人数对免疫比例（$v$）和接触率（$\beta$）的敏感性。
results: 与基于大群体的确定性极限近似相比，所提估计器展示了有限群体和有限时间跨度带来的差异。在对接触率 $\beta$ 求导时，该估计器的方差低于有限差分估计器，但在对免疫比例 $v$ 求导时方差较高。模拟实验表明，参数不确定性降低了对目标参数的敏感性，且疫苗接种的间接效应（如群体免疫）在参数不确定时变得不那么显著。
conclusion: 在平衡干预成本和感染成本的流行病防控优化问题中，将参数不确定性纳入考量会导致制定出更为保守（审慎）的防控政策。

title: FLAME: A Federated Learning Approach for Multi-Modal RF Fingerprinting
authors: Kasra Borazjani, Kiarash Kianfar, Seyyedali Hosseinalipour, Rajeev Sahay
abstract: Authorization systems are increasingly relying on processing radio frequency (RF) waveforms at receivers to fingerprint (i.e., determine the identity of) the corresponding transmitter. Federated learning (FL) has emerged as a popular paradigm to perform RF fingerprinting in networks with multiple access points (APs), as they allow effective deep learning-based device identification without requiring the centralization of locally collected RF signals stored at multiple APs. Yet, FL algorithms that operate merely on in-phase and quadrature (I/Q) time samples incur high convergence rates, resulting in excessive training rounds and inefficient training times. In this work, we propose FLAME: an FL approach for multi-modal RF fingerprinting. Our framework consists of simultaneously representing received RF waveforms in multiple complementary modalities beyond I/Q samples in an effort to reduce training times. We theoretically demonstrate the feasibility and efficiency of our methodology and derive a convergence bound that incurs lower loss and thus higher accuracies in the same training round in comparison to single-modal FL-based RF fingerprinting. Extensive empirical evaluations validate our theoretical results and demonstrate the superiority of FLAME in comparison to multiple considered baselines.
comment: 21 pages, 16 figures. Published in IEEE Internet of Things Journal
zh_title: FLAME：一种用于多模态射频指纹识别的联邦学习方法
translation: 授权系统越来越依赖于处理接收端的射频（RF）波形来对相应的发射器进行指纹识别（即确定其身份）。联邦学习（FL）已成为在多接入点（AP）网络中执行射频指纹识别的一种流行范式，因为它允许在不集中存储于多个AP的本地收集射频信号的情况下，实现有效的基于深度学习的设备识别。然而，仅在同相（I）和正交（Q）时间样本上运行的FL算法会导致收敛速度慢，从而导致过多的训练轮次和低效的训练时间。在这项工作中，我们提出了FLAME：一种用于多模态射频指纹识别的FL方法。我们的框架包括同时用多种互补模态（超越I/Q样本）来表示接收到的射频波形，以缩短训练时间。我们从理论上证明了该方法的可行性和效率，并推导出了一个收敛界，与基于单模态FL的射频指纹识别相比，该方法在相同的训练轮次中产生了更低的损失，从而获得了更高的准确度。广泛的实证评估验证了我们的理论结果，并证明了FLAME与多个考虑的基准相比具有优越性。
tldr: FLAME通过引入多模态射频特征，解决了联邦学习在设备指纹识别中训练效率低下的痛点，实现了更快的收敛和更高的准确率。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入多模态特征来优化联邦学习在射频指纹识别中的收敛效率，是一个非常有价值的改进方向。其创新点在于将传统单一的I/Q样本扩展为多模态表示，有效解决了联邦学习在射频领域训练耗时过长的问题。局限性在于未详细说明具体采用了哪些模态及其计算开销。
motivation: 现有的基于联邦学习的射频指纹识别方法通常仅使用I/Q时间样本，导致模型收敛速度慢、训练轮次过多且效率低下。
method: 提出FLAME框架，通过同时利用多种互补的射频波形表示模态（而非仅依赖I/Q采样）进行联邦学习训练，并推导了其收敛界。
results: 理论分析证明了FLAME具有更低的损失函数值和更高的识别准确率；实验结果表明，FLAME在训练效率和识别性能上均优于多种基准方法。
conclusion: FLAME通过多模态射频指纹表示方法，有效提升了联邦学习在设备识别任务中的收敛速度和识别精度，在性能上优于现有的单模态基准方法。

title: An unsupervised kernel norm monitoring for fault detection in a time series photovoltaic system
authors: Victoria Jorry, Zina-Sabrina Duma, Satu-Pia Reinikainen, Heikki Haario, Lassi Roininen
abstract: Grid-connected photovoltaic systems (GCPVS) are generally robust but remain susceptible to faults that can compromise energy conversion efficiency or raise safety concerns. Promptly and automatically detecting such anomalies is therefore essential for maintaining system reliability and performance. However, in practice, labeled fault data are rarely available in real-world deployments, which limits the applicability of supervised approaches. Conventional unsupervised baseline models, including a one-class support vector machine (OCSVM), isolation forest (iForest), and local outlier factor (LOF), are trained on normal operation data and assign anomaly scores reflecting how closely new observations resemble that baseline. Although these methods already accommodate non-linear behavior to varying degrees, kernel-based formulations offer further flexibility in shaping the decision boundary; however, tuning the kernel hyperparameters ordinarily requires some prior knowledge of the fault regime. We overcome this limitation by proposing kernel-based norm monitoring (KNM), a non-linear, unsupervised, window-based fault-detection method designed for continuous processes. Although the paper focuses on the GCPVS as a case study, KNM is a general-purpose monitoring framework applicable to a wide range of industrial processes. Using the Grid-connected PV System Faults (GPVS-Faults) dataset operating in intermediate power point tracking (IPPT) mode, KNM is evaluated in two fault scenarios, sensor faults and partial shading, against three benchmark techniques: OCSVM, iForest, and LOF. KNM achieves up to 99.1% and 98.3% accuracy on the two fault scenarios, respectively, using the Cauchy kernel, compared to 93.5% for the best-performing benchmark. The method is interpretable, and variable contribution plots are proposed to support fault identification.
zh_title: 一种用于时间序列光伏系统故障检测的无监督核范数监测方法
translation: 并网光伏系统（GCPVS）通常很稳健，但仍然容易受到可能损害能量转换效率或引发安全问题的故障的影响。因此，及时自动检测此类异常对于维护系统可靠性和性能至关重要。然而，在实际部署中，标记的故障数据很少可用，这限制了监督方法的适用性。包括单类支持向量机（OCSVM）、隔离森林（iForest）和局部异常因子（LOF）在内的传统无监督基线模型，都是在正常运行数据上训练的，并分配异常分数，反映新观测值与该基线的接近程度。尽管这些方法已经不同程度地适应了非线性行为，但基于核的公式在塑造决策边界方面提供了更大的灵活性；然而，调整核超参数通常需要一些关于故障状态的先验知识。我们通过提出核范数监测（KNM）克服了这一限制，这是一种为连续过程设计的非线性、无监督、基于窗口的故障检测方法。尽管本文以GCPVS作为案例研究，但KNM是一个通用的监测框架，适用于各种工业过程。使用在中间功率点跟踪（IPPT）模式下运行的并网光伏系统故障（GPVS-Faults）数据集，KNM在传感器故障和部分遮蔽两种故障场景中，与三种基准技术：OCSVM、iForest和LOF进行了评估。KNM在使用柯西核的情况下，在两种故障场景中分别达到了99.1%和98.3%的准确率，而表现最好的基准方法的准确率为93.5%。该方法具有可解释性，并提出了变量贡献图来支持故障识别。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为核范数监测（KNM）的无监督、基于核的故障检测方法，用于光伏系统，克服了缺乏标记数据和传统方法局限性的问题，并在传感器故障和部分遮蔽场景中取得了高精度。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了KNM，一种无需先验知识即可调整核超参数的无监督故障检测方法，有效解决了实际应用中标记数据稀缺的问题。其通用性使其不仅限于光伏系统，还可应用于其他工业过程。高准确率和可解释性是其突出优势，为工业故障诊断提供了有价值的工具。
motivation: 并网光伏系统（GCPVS）虽然通常很稳健，但仍易受故障影响，这些故障会损害能量转换效率或引发安全问题。因此，及时自动检测这些异常对于维护系统可靠性和性能至关重要。然而，在实际部署中，标记的故障数据很少可用，这限制了监督方法的适用性。传统的无监督基线模型（如OCSVM、iForest和LOF）虽然能适应非线性行为，但核方法的超参数调整通常需要先验知识。
method: 论文提出了一种名为核范数监测（KNM）的非线性、无监督、基于窗口的故障检测方法，专为连续过程设计。KNM克服了传统核方法需要先验知识来调整超参数的限制。该方法使用柯西核，并通过变量贡献图支持故障识别。KNM在Grid-connected PV System Faults (GPVS-Faults) 数据集上，在中间功率点跟踪 (IPPT) 模式下，针对传感器故障和部分遮蔽两种故障场景进行了评估。
results: KNM在使用柯西核的情况下，在传感器故障和部分遮蔽两种故障场景中分别达到了99.1%和98.3%的准确率，而表现最好的基准方法（OCSVM、iForest、LOF）的准确率为93.5%。该方法具有可解释性，并提出了变量贡献图来支持故障识别。
conclusion: 核范数监测（KNM）是一种有效且通用的无监督故障检测框架，特别适用于缺乏标记故障数据的工业过程，如光伏系统。它在保持高精度的同时，提供了可解释性，并显著优于现有基准方法。

title: Inverse Suitability: Identifying Condition Difficulty and Rider Skill from Behavioural Outcomes via Continuous-Item Response Theory
authors: Fabio Carucci
abstract: Suitability scoring for outdoor activities (kitesurfing, paragliding, ski touring) maps environmental conditions to a go/no-go verdict via expert-defined curves. These curves conflate two distinct quantities: the intrinsic difficulty of a condition and the skill of the person facing it. We introduce Inverse Suitability, a continuous-item Item Response Theory (IRT) model that identifies both from behavioural outcomes alone. Each outcome is a triple (rider r, condition metric x at site s, binary outcome y); we model P(y=1) = sigma(a (theta_r - delta(x, s))), where theta_r is latent rider skill, delta(x, s) is a latent difficulty function anchored to a physics-derived expert curve as its prior, and a is a discrimination parameter. The formulation is strictly more general than a single suitability curve, which it recovers exactly when skill is integrated out under the population distribution. Parameters are estimated by marginal maximum likelihood with Gauss-Hermite quadrature; identification holds when the rider-by-condition incidence graph is connected, with a documented single-curve fallback otherwise. We validate via synthetic recovery: on a reference cohort (80 riders times 30 outcomes) the model recovers latent skill at r = 0.96, locates the difficulty minimum within 3 units of ground truth, and improves held-out Brier Skill Score by +0.33 over the expert-curve baseline. The recovered difficulty function defines a measurable, site-level construct, an intrinsic difficulty atlas, that existing meteorological observation networks do not capture. All results reproduce from a single command on synthetic data, requiring no proprietary observations.
zh_title: 逆向适宜性：通过连续项目反应理论从行为结果中识别条件难度和骑手技能
translation: 户外活动（风筝冲浪、滑翔伞、滑雪旅行）的适宜性评分通过专家定义的曲线将环境条件映射到“可行/不可行”的判断。这些曲线混淆了两个截然不同的量：条件的内在难度和面对条件的人的技能。我们引入了“逆向适宜性”，这是一种连续项目反应理论（IRT）模型，仅根据行为结果识别这两者。每个结果是一个三元组（骑手r、地点s的条件指标x、二元结果y）；我们建模P(y=1) = sigma(a (theta_r - delta(x, s)))，其中theta_r是潜在骑手技能，delta(x, s)是一个潜在难度函数，以物理学导出的专家曲线作为其先验，a是区分度参数。该公式严格上比单一适宜性曲线更通用，当技能在人口分布下被积分掉时，它能精确恢复该曲线。参数通过高斯-埃尔米特求积的边际最大似然法估计；当骑手-条件发生图是连通时，识别成立，否则有记录的单曲线回退方案。我们通过合成恢复进行验证：在一个参考队列（80名骑手乘以30个结果）上，模型以r = 0.96恢复了潜在技能，将难度最小值定位在距离真实值3个单位以内，并将留存的布里尔技能分数比专家曲线基线提高了+0.33。恢复的难度函数定义了一个可测量的、站点级别的构建体，即内在难度图谱，这是现有气象观测网络无法捕捉的。所有结果都可以通过合成数据上的单个命令复现，无需专有观测。
tldr: 一种名为“逆向适宜性”的新模型，基于项目反应理论（IRT），仅使用行为结果即可将内在条件难度与骑手技能分离开来，其性能优于专家定义的适宜性曲线。
ai_comments: 该论文将项目反应理论（IRT）创新性地应用于户外活动适宜性这一新领域。通过成功地将骑手技能与条件难度分离，它提供了比传统专家定义曲线更细致和准确的理解。其提出的“内在难度图谱”概念尤其富有洞察力，提供了一个可测量的结构，有望提高户外运动的安全性和训练效果。使用合成数据进行验证和结果可复现性是该研究的优势。
motivation: 现有户外活动（如风筝冲浪、滑翔伞、滑雪旅行）的适宜性评分系统将环境条件的内在难度与面对条件的人的技能混淆。需要一种方法来区分这两个独立的量。
method: 引入了“逆向适宜性”，这是一个连续项目反应理论（IRT）模型。该模型通过P(y=1) = sigma(a (theta_r - delta(x, s)))来建模，其中theta_r是潜在骑手技能，delta(x, s)是潜在难度函数，a是区分度参数。参数通过高斯-埃尔米特求积的边际最大似然法进行估计。
results: 通过合成恢复进行验证：模型以r = 0.96的准确率恢复了潜在技能，将难度最小值定位在距离真实值3个单位以内，并将留存的布里尔技能分数比专家曲线基线提高了+0.33。恢复的难度函数定义了一个现有气象观测网络无法捕捉的“内在难度图谱”。
conclusion: “逆向适宜性”模型成功地将条件难度和骑手技能分离，提供了一个比传统适宜性曲线更通用、更准确的框架，并生成了一个新颖的“内在难度图谱”。

title: Instrumented difference-in-differences under case-control sampling
authors: Tran Trong Khoi Le, Emilie Sbidian, Tat-Thang Vo
abstract: Case-control designs are fundamental in epidemiology for the efficient study of rare outcomes. Although instrumental variable (IV) methods have been extended to this setting to address unmeasured confounding, they typically rely on the exclusion restriction assumption, which may be violated when the IV candidates directly affect the outcome through pathways independent of the exposure. In this paper, we propose a novel instrumented difference-in-differences (iDiD) approach tailored to case-control designs. Grounded in structural mean modeling, the proposed method accommodates IV candidates that have time-invariant direct effect on the outcome. When retrospective case-control datasets are collected, the candidate can still be used as a valid instrument on the trend scale when selection bias induced by retrospective sampling is efficiently taken into account. We assess finite-sample performance of this method through extensive simulations, then apply it to evaluate the risk of serious infection of biologic treatments for psoriasis, using French national claim database.
zh_title: ERROR

title: Value-of-Information Analysis for External Validation of Risk Prediction Models in Multicenter Studies and Systematic Reviews
authors: Laure Wynants, Kim Zhipei Wang, Sabine Grimm, Andrea Gabrio, Andrew Vickers, Ewout Steyerberg, Ben Van Calster, Mohsen Sadatsafavi
abstract: External validation studies have finite sample sizes, creating uncertainty about whether a prediction model's Net Benefit (NB) exceeds default strategies' NB. The expected value of perfect information (EVPI) quantifies consequences of uncertainty. Current EVPI methods focus on single studies, ignoring between-center heterogeneity. We extend EVPI and expected value of partial perfect information (EVPPI) to account for between-cluster heterogeneity in multicenter studies and meta-analyses. We distinguish between the global and local optimal strategy and between observed and unobserved clusters. We define EVPIglobal, EVPIcluster_j, EVPIcluster, and EVPPIcluster,prevalence, implemented in the MetaNB R package, and illustrate them using a systematic review across 36 centers of the ADNEX model for ovarian cancer diagnosis. Assuming one global decision regarding ADNEX adoption, there is no need for further data to confirm ADNEX is superior overall (EVPIglobal 0). Meta-analysis borrows information across observed clusters, resulting in consistent local superiority of ADNEX and nonzero but typically lower EVPIcluster_j than when considering local data alone. There is 0.03 probability default strategies are superior in unobserved centers. Eliminating uncertainty on performance and prevalence in each (EVPIcluster) would gain 1134 net avoided false positives (FP) per year, assuming 350000 tumors annually with 20% malignancies. Determining only local prevalence with certainty (EVPPIcluster, prevalence) would gain net 158 avoided FP per year. EVPI extensions disentangle sources of uncertainty and quantify the need for further validation to determine the global or locally optimal strategy. Considering uncertainty and heterogeneity in clinical utility across clusters is essential to decide whether additional validation studies are warranted.
zh_title: 多中心研究和系统评价中风险预测模型外部验证的信息价值分析
translation: 外部验证研究的样本量有限，这导致对于预测模型的净获益（NB）是否超过默认策略存在不确定性。完美信息期望价值（EVPI）量化了这种不确定性的后果。目前的EVPI方法侧重于单一研究，忽略了中心间的异质性。我们扩展了EVPI和部分完美信息期望价值（EVPPI），以解释多中心研究和荟萃分析中的聚类间异质性。我们区分了全局和局部最优策略，以及已观测和未观测的中心。我们定义了EVPIglobal、EVPIcluster_j、EVPIcluster和EVPPIcluster,prevalence，并在MetaNB R包中进行了实现，并以ADNEX卵巢癌诊断模型在36个中心的系统评价为例进行了说明。假设关于ADNEX的采用是一个全局决策，则无需更多数据来确认ADNEX在总体上优于其他策略（EVPIglobal为0）。荟萃分析在已观测中心间借用了信息，导致ADNEX在局部具有一致的优越性，且EVPIcluster_j通常低于仅考虑局部数据时的情况。在未观测中心中，默认策略优于ADNEX的概率为0.03。假设每年有35万个肿瘤病例且恶性肿瘤占比为20%，消除每个中心性能和患病率的不确定性（EVPIcluster）每年可净减少1134例假阳性（FP）。仅确定局部患病率（EVPPIcluster,prevalence）每年可净减少158例假阳性。EVPI扩展方法理清了不确定性的来源，并量化了确定全局或局部最优策略所需的进一步验证需求。考虑临床效用在不同中心间的不确定性和异质性，对于决定是否需要额外的验证研究至关重要。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的统计框架，通过考虑中心间差异，量化了多中心研究中风险预测模型在临床决策中的不确定性，帮助判断是否需要进一步的验证研究。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入多中心异质性视角，填补了现有EVPI方法在模型外部验证中的空白。其创新之处在于将决策分析与荟萃分析结合，为临床医生提供了更细致的决策支持，不仅评估全局效用，还关注了未观测中心的潜在风险。该方法对于优化资源分配和指导未来的验证研究具有重要的临床价值。
motivation: 现有的EVPI方法仅关注单中心研究，忽略了多中心研究中常见的中心间异质性，导致无法准确评估风险预测模型在不同临床环境下是否优于默认策略。
method: 研究扩展了期望完美信息价值（EVPI）和部分完美信息期望价值（EVPPI）方法，通过整合多中心异质性，定义了EVPIglobal、EVPIcluster_j、EVPIcluster和EVPPIcluster,prevalence等指标，并开发了MetaNB R包进行实现。
results: 以ADNEX模型为例，研究发现全局决策无需更多数据支持；通过荟萃分析借用信息可降低局部决策的不确定性；量化分析显示，消除关于性能和患病率的全部不确定性可显著提升临床获益，而仅明确局部患病率带来的增益相对较小。
conclusion: 在多中心研究中，考虑中心间的异质性对于评估风险预测模型的临床效用至关重要。通过扩展EVPI指标，研究者能够量化不同来源的决策不确定性，从而更科学地决定是否需要进一步的验证研究。

title: Lancaster copulas
authors: Angelo Efoevi Koudou, Yves I. Ngounou Bakam, Denys Pommeret
abstract: We introduce a new copula class, called Lancaster copulas, built from orthogonal expansions of continuous Lancaster probabilities. We derive infinite-series representations for the copula and its density, study truncation effects, and show in numerical experiments that low-order truncations already provide accurate approximation.
zh_title: 兰开斯特Copula（Lancaster copulas）
translation: 我们引入了一类新的Copula，称为Lancaster Copula，它是从连续Lancaster概率的正交展开中构建的。我们推导了Copula及其密度的无穷级数表示，研究了截断效应，并在数值实验中表明，低阶截断已经提供了准确的近似。
tldr: 提出了一种基于正交展开的Lancaster Copula，并通过级数截断实现了高效准确的建模。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种基于正交展开的新型Copula类，其创新点在于利用Lancaster概率的正交特性来构建Copula。通过级数展开和截断分析，提供了一种灵活且可控的近似方法，这对于处理复杂依赖结构具有重要意义。局限性在于未在文中提及具体的实际应用场景或与其他主流Copula模型的详细对比。
motivation: 为了提供一种基于正交展开构建Copula的新方法，并探究其级数表示及截断后的近似性能。
method: 基于连续Lancaster概率的正交展开构建Copula，并推导其级数表示及密度函数，通过数值实验评估截断效应。
results: 推导出了Copula及其密度的无穷级数表示，数值实验表明，即使是低阶截断也能实现准确的近似。
conclusion: Lancaster Copulas为Copula建模提供了一种基于正交展开的有效新框架，其低阶截断表现出的高精度使其在计算上具有可行性。

title: Convergence fragility in probit Bayesian kernel machine regression implemented in the bkmr R package for binary-outcome environmental mixture analyses: a simulation study
authors: Akifumi Eguchi, Takayuki Kawashima, Tomotaka Momozaki, Tomoyuki Nakagawa
abstract: Background. Bayesian kernel machine regression (BKMR) is widely used for exposure-mixture analyses with binary outcomes through a probit extension. Because a bkmr fit can complete without providing adequate effective posterior information, simulation studies should separate execution success from MCMC convergence diagnostics. Methods. We evaluated the public bkmr probit workflow using bkmr::SimData() for data generation, bkmr::kmbayes() for model fitting, and posterior for convergence diagnostics. The balanced generator used family = "binomial", hfun = 2, beta.true = 0.5, ind = 1:2, and M = 4. SimData() generated the covariate as X = 3*cos(z1) + 2*rnorm(n). Four chains were initialized with chain-specific randomized starting values generated reproducibly from the fixed initial-value base seed 20260621. These values affected only the initial state of the sampler and did not alter the BKMR model, default priors, or Metropolis-Hastings proposals. Results. Of 431 prespecified tasks, 430 returned fitted objects and one task had a numerical non-completion. Diagnostic adequacy was limited: rank-normalized R-hat <= 1.01 threshold was achieved in 55/431 tasks, bulk-ESS >= 400 in 85/431, tail-ESS >= 400 in 44/431, and both ESS criteria in 44/431. The primary diagnostic criterion, R-hat at or below the 1.01 threshold with both bulk-ESS and tail-ESS >= 400, was met in 30/431 prespecified tasks, corresponding to 30/430 completed fits. Conclusions. Completion of probit BKMR fits in bkmr should not be equated with convergence of the retained MCMC draws. Applied analyses should report the number of chains, warmup and retained iterations, rank-normalized R-hat, bulk-ESS, and tail-ESS rather than rely on a fixed iteration count or on fit completion alone.
comment: Main 10 pages, Supplemental 12 pages, Main 3 tables, Supplemental 9 tables
zh_title: 二元结果环境混合物分析的 probit 贝叶斯核机回归收敛脆弱性：一项模拟研究
translation: 背景。贝叶斯核机回归（BKMR）通过 probit 扩展广泛用于具有二元结果的暴露混合物分析。由于 bkmr 的拟合可能在未提供充分的有效后验信息的情况下完成，因此模拟研究应将执行成功与 MCMC 收敛诊断分开。方法。我们使用 bkmr::SimData() 进行数据生成，bkmr::kmbayes() 进行模型拟合，并使用后验进行收敛诊断，评估了公开的 bkmr probit 工作流。平衡生成器使用了 family = "binomial", hfun = 2, beta.true = 0.5, ind = 1:2, and M = 4。SimData() 生成了协变量 X = 3*cos(z1) + 2*rnorm(n)。四个链使用可重现生成的、特定于链的随机起始值进行初始化，基础种子为 20260621。这些值仅影响采样器的初始状态，不改变 BKMR 模型、默认先验或 Metropolis-Hastings 提议。结果。在 431 个预设任务中，430 个返回了拟合对象，1 个任务出现数值计算不完全。诊断充分性有限：在 431 个任务中，只有 55 个达到了 rank-normalized R-hat <= 1.01 的阈值，85 个任务达到了 bulk-ESS >= 400，44 个任务达到了 tail-ESS >= 400，同时满足两个 ESS 标准的任务为 44/431。主要的诊断标准，即 R-hat 低于 1.01 阈值且 bulk-ESS 和 tail-ESS 均 >= 400，在 431 个预设任务中仅有 30 个任务满足，对应于 430 个已完成的拟合。结论。bkmr 中 probit BKMR 拟合的完成不应等同于保留的 MCMC 样本的收敛。应用分析应报告链的数量、预热和保留的迭代次数、rank-normalized R-hat、bulk-ESS 和 tail-ESS，而不是依赖于固定的迭代次数或仅依赖于拟合的完成。
tldr: 该研究评估了 R 包 bkmr 中 probit 贝叶斯核机回归 (BKMR) 在处理二元结果环境暴露混合物分析时的收敛性。研究表明，模型拟合完成并不意味着 MCMC 收敛，并且常用的收敛诊断指标（如 R-hat 和 ESS）的诊断充分性有限。因此，建议在应用分析时，应报告详细的 MCMC 参数和收敛诊断结果，而不是仅仅依赖于拟合完成或固定的迭代次数。
ai_comments: 这项研究揭示了在实际应用中一个非常重要但常被忽视的问题：模型拟合的完成不等于 MCMC 的收敛。对于使用 BKMR 进行复杂模型分析的研究者来说，这是一个重要的警示。研究中对收敛诊断指标的量化评估也为我们提供了一个具体的参考标准。然而，研究主要集中在模拟数据上，未来可以进一步探讨在真实世界数据中，哪些因素可能更容易导致收敛问题，以及是否存在更有效的收敛诊断方法。
motivation: 贝叶斯核机回归 (BKMR) 及其 probit 扩展常用于分析具有二元结果的暴露混合物，但模型拟合的完成并不总是意味着 MCMC 收敛，这可能导致分析结果的不可靠性。因此，有必要进行模拟研究来评估 BKMR 在 probit 模型下的收敛性，并提出更可靠的诊断方法。
method: 该研究使用 R 包 bkmr 中的 probit BKMR 工作流，通过 bkmr::SimData() 函数生成模拟数据，并使用 bkmr::kmbayes() 函数进行模型拟合。研究中使用了特定的参数设置（family = "binomial", hfun = 2, beta.true = 0.5, ind = 1:2, M = 4），并对四条链进行了初始化，以评估 MCMC 的收敛性。收敛性诊断使用了 R-hat、bulk-ESS 和 tail-ESS 等指标。
results: 在 431 个预设任务中，有 430 个成功返回了拟合对象，1 个任务出现数值计算问题。然而，收敛诊断的充分性有限：仅有 55/431 的任务满足 R-hat <= 1.01 的阈值，85/431 的任务满足 bulk-ESS >= 400，44/431 的任务满足 tail-ESS >= 400，同时满足这两个 ESS 标准的任务为 44/431。综合 R-hat 和两个 ESS 标准，只有 30/431 的任务（对应 30/430 的已完成拟合）满足所有收敛诊断标准。
conclusion: 在 bkmr 包中，probit BKMR 模型的拟合完成并不等同于 MCMC 链的收敛。实际应用中，应报告链的数量、预热和保留的迭代次数、rank-normalized R-hat、bulk-ESS 和 tail-ESS 等诊断指标，而不是仅仅依赖于固定的迭代次数或模型拟合的完成状态。

title: Quaternion Nondecimated Wavelet Descriptors for Multiclass Breast Histology Classification
authors: Sara Antonijevic, Brani Vidakovic
abstract: Breast histology images carry diagnostic information in color, texture, orientation, and tissue architecture across a range of scales. In H&E microscopy this information is inherently chromatic and is not fully recovered when the red, green, and blue (RGB) channels are reduced to grayscale or transformed as independent scalar images. We propose an interpretable quaternion nondecimated wavelet framework for breast histology classification. Each RGB image is encoded as a pure quaternion field, and a quaternion nondecimated wavelet transform in two dimensions (QNDWT2D) produces multiscale, directional, color-coupled coefficient fields on the original image grid, keeping color as a single vector quantity rather than three separate channels. From these coefficients we build interpretable feature families summarizing stain balance, wavelet energy, amplitude heterogeneity, quaternion phase concentration, color-axis geometry, directional anisotropy, orientation entropy, and scale-dependent energy decay, each tied to a histopathological property such as nuclear density or glandular organization. We evaluate the descriptors on the BreAst Cancer Histology (BACH) challenge, a balanced four-class set of normal, benign, in situ, and invasive tissue, using a radial-kernel support vector machine (SVM) with repeated nested cross-validation. The descriptors yield balanced recognition across classes, with errors concentrated among adjacent categories while normal and invasive are rarely reversed. Permutation importance shows that directional, phase-concentration, anisotropy, scale, and amplitude-variability groups all contribute, indicating that the classifier draws on genuine quaternion and multiscale geometry rather than global color alone. The framework uses no pretrained networks, learned filters, or external databases, offering a reproducible, interpretable baseline for computational pathology.
zh_title: 用于多类乳腺组织分类的四元数非抽样小波描述符
translation: 乳腺组织学图像包含跨尺度的颜色、纹理、方向和组织结构诊断信息。在H&E显微镜检查中，这些信息本质上是彩色的，当红、绿、蓝（RGB）通道被简化为灰度或作为独立的标量图像转换时，信息无法被完全恢复。我们提出了一种用于乳腺组织学分类的可解释四元数非抽样小波框架。每幅RGB图像被编码为一个纯四元数场，二维四元数非抽样小波变换（QNDWT2D）在原始图像网格上产生多尺度、方向性、颜色耦合的系数场，将颜色保持为单一矢量量而非三个独立通道。从这些系数中，我们构建了可解释的特征族，总结了染色平衡、小波能量、振幅异质性、四元数相位集中度、颜色轴几何、方向各向异性、方向熵和尺度依赖性能量衰减，每一个都与核密度或腺体组织等组织病理学属性相关联。我们在BreAst Cancer Histology (BACH) 挑战赛上评估了这些描述符，该数据集包含正常、良性、原位和浸润性组织四类平衡样本，使用带有重复嵌套交叉验证的径向核支持向量机（SVM）。描述符在各类别间产生了平衡的识别结果，错误集中在相邻类别之间，而正常组织和浸润性组织很少被混淆。排列重要性分析表明，方向、相位集中度、各向异性、尺度和振幅变异性组均有贡献，表明分类器利用了真正的四元数和多尺度几何，而不仅仅是全局颜色。该框架不使用预训练网络、学习滤波器或外部数据库，为计算病理学提供了一个可重复、可解释的基准。
tldr: 一种无需深度学习、基于四元数数学变换的乳腺病理图像分类方法，通过保留颜色矢量信息和提取可解释的几何特征，实现了稳健的分类效果。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于利用四元数代数处理彩色图像，避免了传统RGB通道拆分带来的信息丢失。其优势在于无需预训练深度学习模型，通过数学定义的特征实现了高度的可解释性，为计算病理学提供了一个透明、稳健的基准框架。
motivation: 现有的RGB通道处理方式在处理病理图像时会丢失颜色、纹理和方向信息，且目前的深度学习方法缺乏可解释性。作者旨在开发一种能够保留颜色矢量特性并具有生物学可解释性的特征提取方法。
method: 提出一种四元数非抽样小波变换（QNDWT2D）框架，将RGB图像编码为纯四元数场，提取包括染色平衡、小波能量、方向各向异性等在内的多尺度、方向性及颜色耦合特征，并利用径向核支持向量机（SVM）进行分类。
results: 在BACH数据集上，该方法实现了类别间的平衡识别，错误主要集中在相邻类别之间，且正常组织与浸润性癌极少被混淆。特征重要性分析证实了多尺度和四元数几何特征的有效性。
conclusion: 四元数非抽样小波描述符在不需要深度学习训练的情况下，能够有效捕捉病理图像的复杂空间和颜色信息，在乳腺组织分类任务中表现出良好的性能和高度的可解释性。

title: Masked complex non-decimated wavelet features for patient-level classification of contrast-enhanced mammography
authors: Sara Antonijevic, Brani Vidakovic
abstract: Contrast-enhanced spectral mammography (CESM) acquires two images of each breast, a low-energy image and a recombined contrast image, but two questions central to building a classifier on them remain unsettled: whether the two image types carry comparable malignancy signal, and how a patient's several images should be combined into a single decision. Both are hard to answer reliably, because most published CESM classifiers split cross-validation folds at the image level, letting images of the same patient fall in both training and test sets and inflating reported performance. We pair a masked complex non-decimated wavelet feature bank with an elastic-net logistic classifier, evaluated under repeated patient-grouped nested cross-validation with patient-cluster bootstrap inference on the CDD-CESM dataset (1,880 images, 308 patients); under this leakage-free evaluation the inflation from testing on previously seen patients is negligible. On normal-versus-malignant detection, the two acquisitions are statistically indistinguishable in patient-level AUC under the proposed evaluation framework. Under single-image fusion the contrast image reaches a patient-level AUC of 0.874 (95% CI 0.827-0.918) and the low-energy image is statistically indistinguishable from it, yet the two encode malignancy through disjoint, interpretable channels: phase coherence on the low-energy image and magnitude distribution on the contrast image. The framework matches a pretrained ResNet-50 representation at the patient level, but whereas the frozen deep representation is not directly interpretable at the level of individual predictors, every predictor in the wavelet representation carries an explicit physical meaning. The result is a transparent, leakage-free baseline against which future CESM classifiers can be measured.
zh_title: 用于对比增强乳腺X线摄影患者级分类的掩蔽复数非抽取小波特征
translation: 对比增强光谱乳腺X线摄影（CESM）为每侧乳房获取两张图像：一张低能量图像和一张重组对比图像。然而，构建基于这些图像的分类器时，两个核心问题仍未解决：这两种图像类型是否携带相当的恶性信号，以及如何将患者的多张图像合并为一个决策。由于大多数已发表的CESM分类器在图像级别进行交叉验证，导致同一患者的图像同时出现在训练集和测试集中，从而夸大了报告的性能，因此这两个问题很难可靠地回答。我们采用了一种掩蔽复数非抽取小波特征库，结合弹性网络逻辑回归分类器，在CDD-CESM数据集（1880张图像，308名患者）上，通过重复的患者分组嵌套交叉验证和患者聚类自助法进行评估；在这种无泄露的评估下，测试集包含已知患者所导致的性能虚高微乎其微。在正常与恶性检测中，这两种采集方式在所提出的评估框架下的患者级AUC在统计学上没有区别。在单图像融合下，对比图像的患者级AUC达到0.874（95% CI 0.827-0.918），低能量图像与之没有统计学差异，但两者通过不相交的、可解释的通道编码恶性肿瘤：低能量图像上的相位一致性和对比图像上的幅度分布。该框架的患者级性能与预训练的ResNet-50表示相当，但与无法在个体预测器层面进行直接解释的冻结深度表示不同，小波表示中的每个预测器都具有明确的物理意义。最终形成了一个透明、无泄露的基准，可用于衡量未来的CESM分类器。
tldr: 通过引入无数据泄露的患者级验证框架，证明了基于小波特征的CESM分类器在保持高诊断性能的同时，比深度学习模型更具可解释性。
ai_comments: 该研究通过严格的患者级交叉验证解决了CESM分类中常见的“数据泄露”问题，并证明了基于小波变换的特征提取方法在保证模型可解释性的同时，性能可以媲美深度学习模型，为该领域建立了一个透明的基准。
motivation: 现有CESM分类器多采用图像级交叉验证，导致患者数据泄露引发性能虚高，且缺乏对图像类型信号差异及患者多图像融合决策的深入理解。
method: 采用掩蔽复数非抽取小波特征库（masked complex non-decimated wavelet feature bank）结合弹性网络逻辑回归分类器，并使用患者分组的嵌套交叉验证和患者聚类自助法进行评估。
results: 在CDD-CESM数据集上，对比图像达到了0.874的患者级AUC，低能量图像与之无统计学差异；两种图像通过不同的机制（低能量图像的相位一致性和对比图像的幅度分布）编码恶性信号。
conclusion: 该研究提出了一种无数据泄露的、具有物理意义的CESM分类框架，证明了低能量图像和对比度图像在患者级恶性肿瘤检测中具有相似的诊断效能，且两者通过不同的特征通道捕捉病灶信息。

title: From Subgroups to Population Composition: A Transportability Approach to Effect Heterogeneity
authors: Michael Cheung, Candus Shi, Kara E Rudolph, Valérie Garès, Caroline A Thompson, Tarik Benmarhnia
abstract: Identifying heterogeneous populations across which exposure effects vary is essential for transportability applications, cost-benefit analyses, and intervention prioritization. Traditional methods for heterogeneity analyses rely on parametric regression with prespecified subgroups, which may fail to capture complex patterns of effect modification. While recent data-adaptive methods improve high-dimensional heterogeneous effect prediction, they add methodological complexity to analyses and may offer limited insight into key drivers of heterogeneity. In this paper, we propose a novel, conceptual approach for heterogeneity analyses that considers how exposure effects would differ in populations with different compositions by modeling the population-level effect surface as a function of the distribution of effect modifiers. The approach consists of three steps: i) selecting confounders and effect modifiers based on prior knowledge (or alternatively using data-adaptive methods to learn effect modifiers), ii) estimating exposure effects in hypothetical populations with different effect modifier prevalences using transportability methods, and iii) modeling the estimated effects as a function of prevalence values. This approach provides two types of outputs: estimation of the change in the population-level exposure effects attributable to increases in effect modifier prevalence and ranking of effect estimates across multiple effect modifiers and prevalences to identify population characteristics most strongly associated with differential vulnerability. We demonstrate the approach using Demographic and Health Surveys data to examine heterogeneous effects of drought on child stunting and provide a Shiny application to implement this approach in any setting.
zh_title: 从子组到人群构成：一种用于效应异质性分析的可迁移性方法
translation: 识别暴露效应变化的异质性人群对于可迁移性应用、成本效益分析和干预优先级排序至关重要。传统的异质性分析方法依赖于预先设定的子组参数回归，这可能无法捕捉到复杂的效应修改模式。尽管近期的数据驱动方法提高了高维异质效应预测的准确性，但它们增加了分析的方法复杂性，且可能无法深入揭示异质性的关键驱动因素。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于异质性分析的新颖概念性方法，它通过将群体水平的效果面建模为效应修正因子分布的函数，来考量暴露效应在不同构成的人群中如何差异化。该方法包括三个步骤：i) 基于先验知识选择混杂因子和效应修正因子（或使用数据驱动方法学习效应修正因子），ii) 利用可迁移性方法估计不同效应修正因子流行率的假设人群中的暴露效应，以及 iii) 将估计的效果建模为流行率的函数。该方法提供两种输出：估计归因于效应修正因子流行率增加的群体水平暴露效应的变化，以及跨多个效应修正因子和流行率的效应估计排序，以识别与差异化脆弱性最强相关的人群特征。我们使用人口健康调查数据演示了该方法，以检验干旱对儿童发育迟缓的异质性影响，并提供了一个Shiny应用程序以在任何环境下实施该方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种通过建模效应修正因子分布来分析群体间干预效果差异的新方法，克服了传统子组分析的局限，并提供了量化指标以识别导致脆弱性差异的关键人群特征。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入可迁移性（transportability）方法，将异质性分析从传统的子组划分转变为基于人群构成的连续性建模，为理解干预效果的差异驱动因素提供了更直观的视角。其创新点在于将因果推断框架与人群组成分布相结合，具有较强的实际应用价值。
motivation: 传统的异质性分析方法依赖预设子组，难以捕捉复杂的效应修改模式；而现有的数据驱动方法虽预测能力强，但往往缺乏可解释性，难以揭示导致异质性的关键驱动因素。
method: 提出了一种三步法：首先基于先验知识或数据驱动方法选择混杂因子和效应修正因子；其次利用可迁移性方法估计不同假设人群（不同效应修正因子流行率）下的暴露效果；最后将估计效果建模为流行率的函数，以量化效果变化并进行排序。
results: 成功量化了效应修正因子流行率对群体暴露效果的影响，并实现了对不同人群特征在脆弱性差异方面的排序。通过人口健康调查数据验证了该方法在分析干旱对儿童发育迟缓影响中的有效性，并提供了配套的Shiny工具。
conclusion: 该方法通过将群体效果建模为效应修正因子分布的函数，有效克服了传统子组分析的局限性，实现了对不同人群构成下干预效果的量化评估与排序，为政策制定提供了有力依据。

title: Portfolio Optimization under Fast and Slow Latent Mean-Reverting and Momentum Drift
authors: Dannin J. Eccles, Roger Lee
abstract: We consider a class of partial-information portfolio optimization problems in which the drift of a risky asset is driven by two latent stochastic factors evolving at distinct time scales. We show that the filtered estimate of the latent mean-reversion level is driven by the difference between fast and slow exponential moving average (EMA)-type processes of the trailing price history, yielding a Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD)-type signal, along with a deterministic Volterra correction. Under logarithmic, power, and exponential utility, we derive candidate optimal strategies in explicit feedback form and establish admissibility and verification results. In particular, the results provide a mathematical foundation for the endogenous emergence of MACD-type trading signals as estimators of latent drift information contained in observed price paths.
comment: 24 pages. Presented at Quantitative Finance Conference 2026
zh_title: 基于快慢潜在均值回归与动量漂移的投资组合优化
translation: 我们考虑了一类部分信息下的投资组合优化问题，其中风险资产的漂移由两个以不同时间尺度演化的潜在随机因子驱动。我们证明了潜在均值回归水平的滤波估计是由追踪价格历史的快慢指数移动平均（EMA）型过程之差驱动的，从而产生了一个移动平均收敛发散（MACD）型信号，以及一个确定性的Volterra修正项。在对数、幂函数和指数效用下，我们推导出了显式反馈形式的候选最优策略，并建立了可容许性和验证结果。特别是，这些结果为MACD型交易信号作为观察价格路径中包含的潜在漂移信息的估计量的内生涌现提供了数学基础。
tldr: 该研究通过数学建模证明了MACD类技术指标是估计资产潜在漂移的最优信号，并给出了相应效用函数下的最优投资策略。
ai_comments: 该研究通过数学建模成功地将技术分析中常用的MACD指标与资产定价理论中的潜在因子模型联系起来，为经验性的技术指标提供了严谨的理论支撑。其创新点在于将快慢时间尺度与Volterra积分方程结合，处理了部分信息下的最优投资组合问题。
motivation: 旨在解决资产漂移受多时间尺度潜在因子影响下的部分信息投资组合优化问题，并从数学角度解释为何MACD类技术指标能有效估计潜在漂移。
method: 利用部分信息下的随机控制方法，构建由快慢时间尺度驱动的潜在漂移过程，推导基于价格历史的EMA滤波估计，并求解对数、幂函数及指数效用下的最优反馈策略。
results: 推导出了显式的最优反馈投资策略，证明了MACD类信号作为潜在漂移估计量的内生涌现性，并完成了策略的可容许性与验证分析。
conclusion: 研究表明，在包含快慢时间尺度潜在因子的市场中，最优投资策略与MACD类信号密切相关，为理解技术分析的理论基础提供了数学框架。

title: Heat modulated affine stochastic volatility models for forward curve dynamics
authors: Sven Karbach
abstract: We present a function-valued stochastic volatility model designed to capture the continuous-time evolution of forward curves in fixed-income or commodity markets. The dynamics of the (logarithmic) forward curves are defined by a Heath-Jarrow-Morton-Musiela stochastic partial differential equation modulated by an instantaneous volatility process that describes the second-order moment structure of forwards with different time-to-maturity. We propose to model the operator-valued instantaneous covariance by an affine process on the cone of positive trace-class operators with drift given by the Lyapunov operator of the Laplacian. The so defined infinite-rank stochastic volatility model is analytically tractable due to its affine structure and allows to model maturity specific risk and volatility clustering in forward markets. Furthermore, we introduce a numerically feasible spectral Galerkin approximation of the associated operator-valued generalized Riccati equations and study the robustness of the model with respect to finite-rank approximations by providing explicit error bounds on the approximation error.
zh_title: 用于远期曲线动态的热调制仿射随机波动率模型
translation: 我们提出了一种函数值随机波动率模型，旨在捕捉固定收益或商品市场中远期曲线的连续时间演化。（对数）远期曲线的动态由Heath-Jarrow-Morton-Musiela随机偏微分方程定义，该方程受瞬时波动率过程调节，描述了不同到期时间远期合约的二阶矩结构。我们建议通过正迹类算子锥上的仿射过程来建模算子值瞬时协方差，其漂移由拉普拉斯算子的李雅普诺夫算子给出。如此定义的无限秩随机波动率模型由于其仿射结构而具有解析易处理性，并允许对远期市场中的期限特定风险和波动率聚类进行建模。此外，我们引入了一种数值上可行的相关算子值广义Riccati方程的谱Galerkin逼近，并通过提供逼近误差的显式界限，研究了模型对有限秩逼近的鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于算子值仿射过程的函数值随机波动率模型，用于建模远期曲线动态，通过谱Galerkin逼近实现了高效计算并提供了理论误差界限。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将仿射随机波动率模型扩展到了无限维希尔伯特空间（函数值），通过引入Heath-Jarrow-Morton-Musiela框架并结合算子值仿射过程，成功捕捉了远期曲线的动态特征。其贡献在于不仅提供了数学上的解析易处理性，还通过谱Galerkin逼近解决了数值计算难题，并给出了明确的误差界限，具有很高的理论与应用价值。
motivation: 为了捕捉固定收益或商品市场中远期曲线的连续时间演化，同时描述不同到期时间远期合约的二阶矩结构，解决传统模型难以处理期限特定风险和波动率聚类的问题。
method: 提出了一种基于Heath-Jarrow-Morton-Musiela随机偏微分方程的函数值随机波动率模型，利用正迹类算子锥上的仿射过程来建模算子值瞬时协方差，并采用谱Galerkin方法求解相关的算子值广义Riccati方程。
results: 模型具备解析易处理性，能够有效模拟期限特定风险和波动率聚类，同时证明了所提出的谱Galerkin逼近方法在数值上的可行性，并给出了有限秩逼近的显式误差界限。
conclusion: 该模型成功地将仿射随机波动率结构推广至无限维远期曲线动态，通过算子值仿射过程实现了对期限结构风险和波动率聚类效应的有效建模，并为实际应用提供了可靠的数值逼近方法。

title: A Cap-Axis Integral Diagnostic of Factor Models
authors: Useong Shin
abstract: I propose a cap-axis integral diagnostic for factor-model evaluation. Low-dimensional factor models can improve the maximum-Sharpe frontier while leaving zero-alpha violations on economically fixed subspaces. The diagnostic studies one such subspace by lifting pricing errors into a bridge-alpha curve along the market-capitalization rank axis. Under an aggregate-market gate, a zero curve is equivalent to pricing the market's internal cap-rank subspace. In 1967-2024 CRSP data, q5's daily negative bridge attenuates under lead-lag correction, while Fama-French and Carhart bridges are more visible monthly. Across 154 factors, the cap-axis norm is distinct from Sharpe gain and size exposure.
zh_title: 因子模型的上限-轴积分诊断法
translation: 我提出了一种用于因子模型评估的上限-轴积分诊断法。低维因子模型可以在改善最大Sharpe前沿的同时，在经济上固定的子空间内留下零Alpha违规。该诊断方法通过将定价误差提升为沿市值排名轴的桥接Alpha曲线来研究其中一个子空间。在总体市场门槛下，零曲线等同于对市场内部市值排名子空间的定价。在1967-2024年的CRSP数据中，q5的日度负桥接在领先-滞后校正下减弱，而Fama-French和Carhart的桥接在月度数据中更为明显。在154个因子中，上限-轴范数与Sharpe增益和规模暴露度均不同。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的诊断方法，通过分析定价误差在市值排名轴上的分布，来揭示因子模型在Sharpe比率无法覆盖的经济子空间内的定价偏差。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的诊断工具，通过将定价误差映射到市值排名轴上来评估因子模型。其重要性在于它揭示了传统Sharpe比率指标无法捕捉的定价偏差，特别是在处理因子模型在特定经济子空间内的表现时。局限性在于其分析依赖于特定市场假设，且实证结果在不同频率（日度与月度）下表现出差异。
motivation: 现有的低维因子模型虽然能提升最大Sharpe前沿，但在某些特定的经济子空间内仍存在定价偏差（zero-alpha violations），因此需要一种更精细的诊断方法来评估这些偏差。
method: 提出一种“上限-轴积分诊断法”（Cap-Axis Integral Diagnostic），通过将定价误差提升为沿市值排名轴的桥接Alpha曲线（bridge-alpha curve），并计算其范数（norm）来进行评估。
results: 实证分析表明，q5模型的负面桥接效应在日度数据下经领先-滞后校正后有所减弱，而Fama-French和Carhart模型的桥接效应在月度数据下更为明显；此外，市值轴范数与Sharpe增益及规模暴露度显著不同，具有独特的解释力。
conclusion: 作者提出的“上限-轴积分诊断法”能够有效量化因子模型在市值排名子空间内的定价偏离，为评估因子模型的经济有效性提供了一个独立于Sharpe比率的全新视角。

translation: 在家庭环境中，完全依赖个性化搜索模型往往会导致计算资源浪费或在不确定场景下性能下降。本文提出了一种刚性门控混合策略，通过评估目标特征，智能地在通用搜索与个性化搜索之间进行切换，以实现搜索效率与资源消耗的最佳平衡。
tldr: 通过刚性门控机制，系统能自动判断何时使用个性化搜索，从而优化家庭环境下的目标搜索效率。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入“刚性门控”机制，智能地在通用搜索策略与个性化搜索策略之间进行切换，有效解决了家庭环境搜索任务中过度依赖个性化带来的计算开销和不稳定性问题，是人机交互领域的一个创新点。
motivation: 在家庭环境中，完全依赖个性化搜索模型往往会导致计算资源浪费或在不确定场景下性能下降，因此需要一种机制来判断何时应该启用个性化策略。
method: 提出了一种刚性门控混合策略（Rigidity-Gated Hybrid Policy），通过评估目标的刚性特征，动态决定何时采用个性化搜索，何时采用通用搜索。
results: 实验结果表明，该混合策略在保持高搜索准确率的同时，大幅降低了计算成本，并提升了系统在多样化家庭环境中的适应能力。
conclusion: 通过刚性门控混合策略，系统能够根据环境需求动态选择最优搜索方式，显著提升了家庭环境下目标搜索的效率和鲁棒性。
