title: WaterGen: Decoupling Scene and Medium in Underwater Image Generation
authors: Jiayi Wu, Tianfu Wang, Tianyi Xiong, Dehao Yuan, Xiaomin Lin, Md Jahidul Islam, Cornelia Fermuller, Christopher Metzler, Yiannis Aloimonos
abstract: Underwater computer vision tasks, such as detection, restoration, and segmentation, are limited by the scarcity of large-scale and diverse training data. We introduce WaterGen, a method for generating large-scale, realistic, and diverse underwater images that provides independent control of the scene and water medium conditions. Our approach treats underwater image generation as the decoupled control of two factors: realistic and diverse scene content (what is in the image), and accurate and controllable water medium effects (what the water does to the image). Existing methods generally achieve only part of this objective: they either provide controllability with limited realism or diversity, or generate realistic scenes without accurately and independently modeling water-medium effects. Our key insight, that allows us to avoid this compromise, is that scene generation and medium modeling can be decoupled within a latent diffusion framework, enabling diverse scene generation together with accurate and controllable underwater appearance. To do this, we decompose underwater image synthesis into two stages. First, we fine-tune the latent diffusion U-Net using degradation-free underwater images so that it learns to generate diverse and realistic latent embeddings of underwater scene content without medium-induced degradation. Second, we formulate the physically accurate medium degradation synthesis as a conditional decoding process applied to these latent embeddings. This decoupled design allows our model to generate diverse scenes with full control of underwater appearance. We leverage WaterGen to build large-scale synthetic underwater datasets that are diverse in scene structures and accurate in water effects and pseudo-labels. We demonstrate that our synthetic data consistently improve downstream performance in underwater restoration and semantic segmentation.

title: A consistent-splitting generalized scalar auxiliary variable scheme for the perturbed Boussinesq system
authors: M Nader Alhomsi, Jiahong Wu, Xiaoming Zheng
abstract: We propose and analyze a second-order consistent-splitting scheme, based on the generalized scalar auxiliary variable (GSAV) approach, for the two-dimensional perturbed Boussinesq system. The system is obtained by subtracting a stable, linearly stratified hydrostatic equilibrium from the standard Boussinesq system. The time discretization extends the consistent-splitting generalized BDF2 framework of Huang and Shen [17] for the Navier-Stokes equations, treating the nonlinear convection and advection together with the linear buoyancy and stratification couplings explicitly, so that each time step reduces to a small number of decoupled linear systems. We prove an unconditional weak stability theorem for the GSAV scheme and derive optimal second-order error estimates for the velocity, pressure, and temperature. A careful tracing reveals that the error constant depends on the inverse viscosity and inverse thermal diffusivity through a quadruply-nested exponential, so the scheme is not robust as either tends to zero. Numerical experiments confirm the second-order convergence and reproduce the expected internal-wave dynamics and exponential relaxation toward hydrostatic balance in a long-time stratified-flow simulation.

title: GKB Methods for X-Ray Computed Tomography with an Unmatched Back Projector
authors: Abdulmajeed Alsubhi
abstract: In large scale X ray Computed Tomography (CT) inverse problems, the forward and back projectors are often generated using different discretizations. This discrepancy leads to unmatched pairs of projections, resulting in inconsistent normal equations. Consequently, employing the Conjugate Gradient method does not produce a useful solution. For matched operator pairs, the Golub Kahan bidiagonalization (GKB) method provides an efficient solution strategy. It works by projecting the original large-scale problem onto a lower-dimensional subspace, enabling the solution to be computed via a singular value decomposition of a sparse lower bidiagonal matrix. To address unmatched-pair problems in CT, we propose the AB and BA GKB algorithms as preconditioned forms of the GKB. These methods are straightforward to implement and allow for parameter tuning. We provide a discussion on the theoretical computational costs of our proposed algorithms in terms of floating point operations and compare with existing methods. While many Krylov methods tend to amplify noise in solutions, leading to semiconvergence, our proposed algorithms demonstrate greater resilience against this effect. We validate the effectiveness of our approach through numerical examples across various CT problems, showcasing its ability to deliver more stable solutions.

title: PPT-Eval: A Benchmark for Computer-Use Agents on PowerPoint Tasks
authors: Apurva Gandhi, Vishwas Suryanarayanan, Raja Hasnain Anwar, Firoz Shaik, Shubhang Desai, Thong Q. Nguyen, Muhammad Taqi Raza, Vishal Chowdhary, Graham Neubig
abstract: Creating and editing slides is a rich, multimodal activity that is ubiquitous in professional and educational settings, making it an ideal testbed for real-world computer-use agents. Microsoft PowerPoint is among the most widely adopted and feature-rich environments for presentation creation. We introduce PPT-Eval, a benchmark of 120 PowerPoint tasks across 12 files that cover both content creation and presentation editing scenarios, organized by difficulty. A central challenge in this domain is evaluation: tasks are complex, multimodal, and often admit many valid solutions. Moreover, today's agents frequently make only partial progress, which binary success metrics fail to capture. To address this, we design a robust evaluation framework to help create task-specific rubrics for PowerPoint tasks, taking inspiration from and building on past works for rubric-based evaluation. These rubrics award partial credit for intermediate steps, penalize unnecessary changes and poor aesthetics, and provide natural language feedback. This nuanced approach proves highly effective, achieving a Kendall's τ-b correlation of 0.77 with human judgments. We find that existing frontier agents still struggle with solving PowerPoint tasks, with strong models like Claude-4.5-Opus achieving only a 45% success rate and an average partial score of 57%. The benchmark is located at: https://microsoft.github.io/ppteval.

title: One Retrieval to Cover Them All: Co-occurrence-Aware Knowledge Base Reorganization for Session-Level RAG
authors: Shivam Ratnakar, Yixuan Zhu, Cecilia Cheng, Chaya Vijayakumar
abstract: RAG systems retrieve documents optimized for answering one query at a time. Yet enterprise users arrive with sessions, that is, coherent episodes of related questions that span semantically distant parts of the knowledge base. We show that a single retrieval call over a standard knowledge base covers only 41% of a user's session-level information need. To close this gap, we reorganize the KB offline using co-occurrence-aware clustering and expand retrieval candidates through cluster neighborhoods at query time. On WixQA (6,221 enterprise support articles), our method raises single-query session coverage to 58% (+17% absolute; 95% CI: [14.1, 20.4]), reduces retrieval calls to 70% coverage by 34%, and compresses the KB to 20% of its original size, all consistently across four embedding models and six functional domains. We argue that session-level coverage, not single-query recall, should be the primary metric for enterprise RAG evaluation.

title: LLM-Powered Interactive Robotic Action Synthesis from Multimodal Speech, Gestures, and Music
authors: Snehasis Banerjee, Ranjan Dasgupta
abstract: The quest for intuitive and natural human-robot interaction (HRI) remains a significant challenge in robotics. Traditional methods often rely on rigid, pre-programmed commands that limit the robot's expressiveness and adaptability. This paper introduces a novel framework that leverages the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to synthesize complex robotic actions from a rich tapestry of multimodal human inputs: natural speech, hand gestures, and music/sound beats. Our system architecture integrates a speech transcription model, a gesture recognition module, and a signal processing pipeline for beat detection. These processed inputs are contextualized using prompt templates and fed into a LLM. The LLM, informed by a predefined robot action space, reasons over the combined inputs to generate a coherent sequence of actions. This sequence is dispatched to an action queue for execution on a quadruped robot over ROS. The framework has ability to interpret and fuse semantic commands from speech, deictic information from gestures, and rhythmic cues from music. This work represents a step towards creating robots that can interact with humans in a more fluid, creative, and context-aware manner.

title: An Empirical Study of Security Calibration in Large Language Models for Code
authors: Mohammed Latif Siddiq, Md. Nafiu Rahman, Joanna C. S. Santos
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are rapidly transforming software development, yet their use in security-critical contexts raises a key question: do models know when their generated code is insecure? This property, known as calibration, measures whether a model's confidence aligns with the true correctness of its outputs. We present the first large-scale empirical study of security calibration in LLM-generated code. We evaluate GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-2.0-Flash, and Qwen3-Coder-Next across multiple temperature settings on two complementary benchmarks: self-contained security tasks and multi-language repository-level contexts. Our results suggest that overconfidence is prevalent across the evaluated LLMs. Functional calibration is consistently worse than security calibration, suggesting that models estimate security outcomes more reliably than functional correctness, potentially because functional correctness depends on complex execution behavior. We also examine whether calibration-guided automated repair can help remediate vulnerabilities in LLM-generated code, finding only limited improvements while frequently introducing functional regressions. Moreover, we study different mitigation strategies for reducing False Trust, where models assign high confidence to vulnerable code. The results show that although architectural gating improves calibration on controlled benchmarks, calibration deteriorates in realistic repository-level settings, increasing the risk of high-confidence vulnerable outputs.

title: Rethinking Foundation Model Collaboration: Enhancing Specialized Models through Proxy Task Reasoning
authors: Hongyi Lin, Yang Liu, Jinhua Zhao, Xiaobo Qu
abstract: Foundation models are increasingly integrated into embodied intelligence systems, but directly assigning them structured prediction tasks requires precise geometric and numerical estimation, where specialized models often remain stronger. This capability mismatch raises a key question: should foundation models replace task-specific predictors, or should they collaborate through tasks better aligned with their strengths? We propose FAT, a foundation-model-augmented task-specific reasoning framework that treats collaboration as task decomposition rather than model replacement. FAT decomposes structured prediction into specialist prediction, information-space reconstruction, and foundation-model proxy reasoning. The specialist generates geometrically and physically valid hypotheses in the native output space, while the foundation model performs a bounded proxy task, such as selection or verification, over reconstructed multimodal candidates. We instantiate this principle as ProxySelect with a vision--language model. Across 2D object detection, 3D object detection, trajectory prediction, and semantic segmentation, ProxySelect consistently improves specialized baselines and substantially outperforms direct foundation-model regression at lower computational cost. These results suggest a general collaboration principle: specialized models preserve task-specific structure, while foundation models refine their hypotheses through contextual proxy reasoning.

title: TAG-DLM: Diffusion Language Models for Text-Attributed Graph Learning
authors: Lingjie Chen, Yuanchen Bei, Haobo Xu, Yanjun Zhao, Yuzhong Chen, Hanghang Tong
abstract:
Text-attributed graphs (TAGs), where each node carries a natural language description, require models to jointly reason over text and graph topology. Existing approaches often handle the two modalities separately: graph neural networks operate on shallow text features, while hybrids of LLMs and graphs use the language model mainly as a text encoder and delegate structure learning to a separate graph module. We propose method that unifies textual reasoning and graph message passing within a masked diffusion language model, a language model with bidirectional attention and generative decoding. For each graph instance, method linearises a sampled local neighbourhood into a token sequence and injects graph structure through a topology attention mask, which realises message passing over the graph. Because the diffusion language model can both interpret and generate text, the method adapts to different tasks simply by changing the prompt, supporting node classification, link prediction, and cross-dataset transfer with no target-specific fine-tuning.
  Experiments show that method outperforms graph neural networks, graph transformers, and LLM-based baselines on all three TAG benchmarks across two tasks, improving over the strongest baseline by up to 3.9 points.

title: ComplianceGate: Classifier-Gated Multi-Tier LLM Routing for Inference in Regulated Industries
authors: Abhishek Dey
abstract: Large language models deployed in regulated industries operate under two constraints: compliance enforcement and cost efficiency. Personally identifiable information (PII) in user queries can reach model endpoints before the system determines whether that data should leave its jurisdictional boundary. Serving all queries through a single large model consumes full GPU capacity regardless of query complexity while offering no mechanism for geographic routing. Mixture-of-Experts architectures do not address this routing occurs between expert layers within the model after data has already arrived at the endpoint, with all experts loaded in memory regardless of query complexity. We propose a classifier-gated routing architecture that enforces compliance by design. A trained encoder classifier sits before any decoder inference, evaluating each query for complexity and data sensitivity, then routing it to an appropriately sized dense model in the appropriate geographic location. PII-containing queries route to local endpoints before any LLM computation begins, making data residency violations structurally impossible. Simple queries reach small, fast models at a fraction of the cost. Our evaluation on 600 queries demonstrates 39% median latency reduction, 33-52% cost savings depending on query distribution, and generation throughput of 122-200 tokens/second versus 50-64 for the baseline. The encoder classifier achieves 99.2% accuracy with near-perfect PII recall at 7ms inference overhead, establishing pre-inference classification as a practical path to compliance-by-design LLM deployment.

title: Reasoning-aware Speculative Decoding for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models in Autonomous Driving
authors: Anh Dung Dinh, Simon Khan, Flora Salim
abstract: Modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) planners for autonomous driving emit a chain-of-causation (CoC) reasoning step \emph{before} producing a trajectory. The reasoning is autoregressive and dominates inference latency, while the trajectory head is parallel and cheap. Latency is an operational constraint in autonomous driving, so accelerating the reasoning step is the central problem we address. We observe that CoC reasoning has two qualitatively different needs: most tokens continue routine setup that follows naturally from the ego-trajectory history, and a small fraction encode commitments that require fresh visual evidence about an unexpected situation. We split this reasoning into two specialized paths: a \emph{routine reasoner} that handles the predictable continuation by attending to trajectory history, and a \emph{deliberative reasoner} (the unmodified VLA target) that handles novel cases by attending to current visual evidence, using the speculative decoding framework as the architectural template for how the two paths cooperate. Unlike standard speculative decoding, our routine reasoner is not a smaller replica of the target; the two reasoners are deliberately specialized to read different parts of the prompt. We propose two techniques to realize this. First, we introduce \textbf{FlatRoPE}, a 1D rotary positional embedding in the draft that breaks the rotational symmetry of the target's 3D M-RoPE, redirecting attention away from visual tokens and onto trajectory-history tokens. Second, we introduce \textbf{Action-aware RL (AARL)}, a post-training stage that uses an action-quality reward together with a static-reference KL anchor. Together, our two-reasoner system reduces the reasoning-step running time by approximately $4\times$ relative to the original Alpamayo planner.

title: Seeing Through the Weights: Privacy Leakage in Scene Coordinate Regression
authors: Oleksii Nasypanyi, Jaemin Cho, Utku Ozbulak, Byungkon Kang, Francois Rameau
abstract:
Scene Coordinate Regression (SCR) methods are increasingly adopted for visual localization. In these approaches, the scene is implicitly encoded within a neural network that regresses a 3D world coordinate for each image pixel. Because the scene is represented only through the network parameters and not stored explicitly as images or maps, such methods are often assumed to be privacy-preserving. In this work, we show that this assumption is incorrect in practice.
  Specifically, we introduce a query-based attack that reconstructs the 3D geometry of the training environment from an SCR model under different levels of model access. To do so, we repeatedly query the model with batches of proxy images unrelated to the target scene to obtain dense pixel-wise 3D coordinates. Reliable points are identified through their stability under small input perturbations and can be further refined in a white-box setting. These stable points are accumulated across independent query batches to recover the scene geometry. From the recovered 3D representation, we also invert the network features to synthesize images from arbitrary viewpoints, revealing additional appearance information.
  Experiments on indoor and outdoor datasets demonstrate that substantial portions of training environments can be reconstructed with high geometric fidelity. Beyond geometry, we also recover an approximate color appearance, which exposes recognizable layout and potentially sensitive scene elements. This directly contradicts claims in the literature that SCR representations are privacy-preserving by design, and reveals a real risk when such systems are deployed in private or security-critical spaces. The project page is available at https://jaeminch0.github.io/seeing-through-the-weights-privacy-leakage-in-scene-coordinate-regression.

title: MIRTH: Mutual-Information Reasoning with Temporal Hubs for Vision-Language-Action Agents
authors: Hao Sun, Yu Song, Shiyu Teng, Ziwei Niu, Yen-Wei Chen
abstract: VLA models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for transferring semantic knowledge from web-scale data to physical robotic control. However, current single-frame architectures suffer from intrinsic limitations: temporal myopia that discards historical dynamics, reasoning gaps between high-level instructions and low-level motor commands, and inference inefficiency due to autoregressive scalar decoding. In this work, we propose MIRTH, a unified framework designed to address these challenges. MIRTH augments a pretrained VLA backbone with three key innovations: (1) dual-scale temporal memory hubs that compress long-term scene evolution and short-term motion trends into compact embeddings; (2) latent reasoning tokens optimized via a mutual-information objective carving out a semantic plan space to align multimodal context with action trajectories; and (3) a parallel action decoding scheme that replaces autoregressive generation with vector-wise prediction to maximize control throughput. Extensive evaluations on the LIBERO simulation benchmark and a real-world LeRobot platform demonstrate that MIRTH achieves state-of-the-art performance and exhibiting emergent error recovery capabilities. The codes and collected datasets are released at http://github.com/kiva12138/mirth.

zh_title: MIRTH：基于时序枢纽与互信息推理的视觉-语言-动作智能体
translation: VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型已成为将互联网规模数据中的语义知识转移到物理机器人控制中的强大范式。然而，当前的单帧架构存在一些固有的局限性：丢弃历史动态的时序近视、高级指令与低级电机指令之间的推理鸿沟，以及由于自回归标量解码导致的推理低效。在这项工作中，我们提出了 MIRTH，一个旨在解决这些挑战的统一框架。MIRTH 通过以下三个关键创新增强了预训练的 VLA 骨干网络：（1）双尺度时序记忆枢纽，将长期场景演变和短期运动趋势压缩为紧凑的嵌入；（2）通过互信息目标优化的潜在推理标记（tokens），开辟一个语义规划空间，以使多模态上下文与动作轨迹相对齐；（3）一种并行动作解码方案，用向量预测代替自回归生成，以最大化控制吞吐量。在 LIBERO 仿真基准和真实世界 LeRobot 平台上的广泛评估表明，MIRTH 实现了最先进的性能，并展现出涌现的错误恢复能力。代码和收集的数据集已发布在 http://github.com/kiva12138/mirth。

title: Cross-Domain Feature Expansion for Tabular Medical Data via Knowledge Graphs Injection
authors: Mengying Zhou, Yongjie Yin, Haoyan Xin, Guoping Liu, Yang Chen
abstract: Acquiring comprehensive cross-domain biomedical profiles is often costly and time-consuming, resulting in severe data scarcity in medical research. To address this challenge, we propose MedKGTab, a knowledge-injected framework specifically engineered for cross-domain feature expansion in tabular medical data. MedKGTab seeks to infer uncollected biomedical features from available ones by exploiting their inherent statistical dependencies and established medical correlations. By employing a row-column dual-attention mechanism, MedKGTab operates directly on raw structured tabular data, inherently capturing exact numerical distributions without the structural loss caused by tokenization. Crucially, MedKGTab integrates data-driven statistical priors with the SPOKE biomedical knowledge graph, achieving an optimal synergy between the data and knowledge channels. Within this synergy, the representations derived from the data channel are modulated by the injected biomedical knowledge, ensuring the final generated data are grounded in empirical medical research. Experimental results demonstrate that MedKGTab achieves high data fidelity and realistic data representation in cross-domain feature expansion. It outperforms both SOTA medical large models (e.g., Baichuan M3-plus) and specialized tabular models designed for medical data generation. Furthermore, MedKGTab consistently delivers superior performance across various data generation scenarios, whether inferring missing features within the same dataset or generalizing across different medical cohorts.
zh_title: 基于知识图谱注入的表格医学数据跨域特征扩展
translation: 获取全面的跨领域生物医学概况通常成本高昂且耗时，从而导致医学研究中严重的数据稀缺。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 MedKGTab，这是一个专为表格医学数据中的跨域特征扩展而设计的知识注入框架。MedKGTab 旨在通过利用可用生物医学特征之间固有的统计依赖关系和已建立的医学关联，来推断未收集的特征。通过采用行列双重注意力机制，MedKGTab 直接在原始结构化表格数据上运行，从而固有地捕获精确的数值分布，避免了由分词（tokenization）引起的结构损失。至关重要的是，MedKGTab 将数据驱动的统计先验与 SPOKE 生物医学知识图谱相结合，实现了数据通道与知识通道之间的最佳协同。在这种协同作用下，源自数据通道的表征受到注入的生物医学知识的调节，从而确保最终生成的数据立足于实证医学研究。实验结果表明，MedKGTab 在跨域特征扩展中实现了高数据保真度和逼真的数据表征。它的性能优于最先进的（SOTA）医疗大模型（例如 Baichuan M3-plus）以及专为医学数据生成设计的专用表格模型。此外，无论是在同一数据集中推断缺失特征，还是在不同的医学队列中进行泛化，MedKGTab 在各种数据生成场景中都始终提供卓越的性能。
tldr: 本文提出MedKGTab框架，通过行列双重注意力机制与SPOKE医学知识图谱的有机结合，实现了高保真度的表格医学数据跨域特征扩展，性能超越了现有SOTA医疗大模型。
ai_comments: 本论文的创新之处在于将表格数据处理（行列双重注意力机制）与外部医学知识图谱（SPOKE）有机结合，不仅避免了分词带来的数值精度损失，还通过知识注入确保了生成特征的医学合理性。这对于解决医学研究中多中心、跨域数据不完整和稀缺问题具有重要意义。局限性在于，摘要中未提及该方法在面对极度稀疏或超高维表格数据时的计算复杂度，以及对非结构化文本等其他模态数据的兼容性。
motivation: 在医学研究中，获取全面且跨领域的生物医学概况通常成本高昂且耗时，导致严重的医学数据稀缺问题，限制了多源数据的协同分析。
method: 提出MedKGTab框架：1. 采用行列双重注意力机制直接处理原始结构化表格数据，捕获精确的数值分布以避免分词造成的结构损失；2. 将数据驱动的统计先验与SPOKE生物医学知识图谱相结合，利用注入的医学知识调节数据通道的表征，使生成的数据符合实证医学规律。
results: 实验结果表明，MedKGTab在跨域特征扩展中实现了极高的数据保真度和真实的表征。其性能不仅超越了Baichuan M3-plus等最先进的医疗大模型，也优于专门针对医学数据生成设计的专用表格模型。此外，它在同数据集缺失特征推断和跨医学队列泛化等多种场景下均表现出持续优越的性能。
conclusion: MedKGTab通过有机结合数据驱动的统计分布与基于知识图谱的医学先验，成功实现了高保真度的表格医学数据跨域特征扩展，为解决医疗领域的数据稀缺与跨队列泛化问题提供了高效、可靠的解决方案。

title: Probe Choice Changes Canary-Memorization Verdicts: Three Post-Hoc Disagreement Case Studies in a Text-Dominant LoRA-Tuned Autoregressive Testbed
authors: Zhichao Fan, Zexin Zhuang, Yanhang Li
abstract: We audit a fixed prefix-window mean-NLL memorization probe (K=20) on a Qwen2.5-VL-7B canary testbed and report three post-hoc cases where it disagrees with full-span secret NLL or greedy exact-recall. C3 (false negative, window truncation): damage lands on hex tokens outside K=20; the probe stays flat while hit@1 drops. C4 (false positive, non-secret drift): the probe moves, but approximately 99% sits on non-secret preamble; the secret span and hit@1 are unchanged. C5 (ambiguous in-window drop): the probe falls on an undertrained baseline while full-span hex is positive and hit@1=0. Recommendation: report (i) full-span secret NLL, (ii) a span-localised decomposition, (iii) behavioural exact-recall at k>=4, and (iv) decoy probes before asserting secret-specificity. Evidence is on controlled canaries in one backbone; magnitudes are testbed-specific.

zh_title: 探测器选择改变金丝雀记忆判定：在以文本为主的LoRA微调自回归测试平台中的三个事后不一致案例研究
translation: 我们在一个Qwen2.5-VL-7B金丝雀测试平台上，对一个固定的前缀窗口平均负对数似然（mean-NLL）记忆探测器（K=20）进行了审计，并报告了三个事后案例，在这些案例中，该探测器与全跨度秘密NLL或贪婪精确召回（greedy exact-recall）的判定不一致。C3（假阴性，窗口截断）：破坏落在了K=20之外的十六进制标记（hex tokens）上；探测器保持平坦，而hit@1下降。C4（假阳性，非秘密漂移）：探测器发生移动，但大约99%的变化位于非秘密前导码（preamble）上；秘密跨度和hit@1保持不变。C5（窗口内模糊下降）：探测器落在未充分训练的基线上，而全跨度十六进制为正且hit@1=0。建议：在断言秘密特异性（secret-specificity）之前，应报告 (i) 全跨度秘密NLL，(ii) 跨度局部化分解，(iii) k>=4时的行为精确召回，以及 (iv) 诱饵探测器（decoy probes）。相关证据基于单一骨干网络中的受控金丝雀；其影响幅度具有测试平台特异性。
tldr: 研究表明，使用不同的探测器评估大模型对金丝雀数据的记忆会得出截然相反的结论（存在假阴性和假阳性），因此建议结合全跨度NLL、行为召回等多种指标进行综合评估。
ai_comments: 该研究深入探讨了大语言模型隐私和记忆评估（Canary Memorization）中的方法学漏洞，指出了仅依赖单一固定窗口NLL探测器可能导致的误判（如假阴性和假阳性）。其创新性在于通过三个具体的案例（C3、C4、C5）揭示了探测器选择对记忆判定结果的决定性影响，并提出了一套更稳健的多维度评估推荐方案。其局限性在于实验仅在Qwen2.5-VL-7B这一种模型和特定的LoRA微调测试平台上进行，其具体数值和不一致幅度的普适性仍待在更多模型架构上验证。
motivation: 在评估语言模型对敏感/金丝雀数据（canary data）的记忆时，探测器的选择可能会影响评估结果。作者旨在审计常用的固定前缀窗口平均负对数似然（NLL）探测器，揭示其与全跨度秘密NLL或精确召回指标之间的不一致性，以提高记忆评估的准确性。
method: 在以文本为主的LoRA微调Qwen2.5-VL-7B自回归模型测试平台上，对固定前缀窗口平均NLL记忆探测器（K=20）进行审计。通过将该探测器的判定结果与全跨度秘密NLL及贪婪精确召回（greedy exact-recall）进行对比，分析并归纳了三类事后不一致的案例。
results:
研究发现了三个事后不一致的案例：
1. C3（假阴性，窗口截断）：损害发生在K=20之外的十六进制标记上，导致探测器曲线平坦，但实际hit@1下降。
2. C4（假阳性，非秘密漂移）：探测器产生波动，但约99%的变化发生于非秘密前导码上，秘密跨度和hit@1并未改变。
3. C5（窗口内模糊下降）：探测器在未充分训练的基线上下降，而全跨度十六进制表现为正且hit@1=0。
conclusion: 探测器的选择会直接改变金丝雀记忆的判定结果。为了确保评估的准确性和秘密特异性，研究者在得出结论前应综合报告全跨度秘密NLL、跨度局部化分解、特定k值下的行为精确召回以及诱饵探测器结果。

title: Beyond Single Character: Evaluating MLLMs for Sentence-Level Oracle Bone Inscription Understanding
authors: Ziqi Li, Zijian Chen, Tingzhu Chen, Guangtao Zhai
abstract: Existing AI-assisted oracle bone inscription (OBI) visual recognition and understanding studies mainly focus on character-level, ignoring the long-form textual coherence and contextual dependencies embedded in complete divination charges. Recently, the powerful visual perception capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have opened new possibilities for OBI information processing. In this work, we introduce S-OBI, a novel benchmark for evaluating MLLMs in Sentence-level OBI understanding. Instead of using noisy and incomplete rubbings as the visual input, S-OBI synthesizes clear and standardized sentence-level OBI instances through glyph substitution and composition. According to 95 original rubbings with translations that have been identified, corrected, and verified by experts, we replace characters in the original rubbings with corresponding clean glyph samples sourced from existing OBI datasets while preserving the overall inscriptional structure and semantic organization. This mitigates the influence of low-level distortions and enables a more focused evaluation of sentence-level OBI understanding. Based on this, we design semantic matching, semantic slot extraction, and contextual reasoning tasks and obtain 695 question-answer pairs. Experiments reveal the inferiority of contemporary MLLMs on sentence-level OBI understanding. In particular, visual perception errors in unmasked regions propagate through the reasoning chain, leading to erroneous predictions for masked characters, which indicates that sentence-level OBI understanding in current models remains strongly dependent on character-level recognition. Overall, S-OBI provides a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating whether MLLMs can move beyond isolated character recognition toward structured inscription-level understanding.
zh_title: 超越单字：评估多模态大语言模型在句子级甲骨文理解中的表现
translation: 现有的AI辅助甲骨文（OBI）视觉识别和理解研究主要集中在单字层面，忽略了完整卜辞中所蕴含的长篇文本连贯性和上下文依赖性。最近，多模态大语言模型（MLLM）强大的视觉感知能力为甲骨文信息处理开辟了新的可能性。在这项工作中，我们引入了S-OBI，这是一个用于评估多模态大模型在句子级甲骨文理解中表现的新型基准。S-OBI没有使用嘈杂且不完整的拓片作为视觉输入，而是通过字形替换和组合合成了清晰且标准化的句子级甲骨文实例。根据专家已鉴定、校对和验证的95篇原始拓片及其译文，我们用来自现有甲骨文数据集的相应清晰字形样本替换了原始拓片中的字符，同时保留了整体的铭文结构和语义组织。这减轻了低级失真的影响，并使评估能够更专注于句子级的甲骨文理解。在此基础上，我们设计了语义匹配、语义槽提取和上下文推理任务，并获得了695个问答对。实验揭示了当代多模态大模型在句子级甲骨文理解上的不足。特别是，未遮蔽区域的视觉感知错误会沿着推理链传播，导致对遮蔽字符的错误预测，这表明当前模型在句子级甲骨文理解上仍然强烈依赖于单字级别的识别。总的来说，S-OBI提供了一个诊断性基准，用于评估多模态大模型能否超越孤立的单字识别，迈向结构化的铭文级理解。
tldr: 本文提出了S-OBI基准，用于评估多模态大模型在句子级甲骨文理解上的能力。实验表明，现有模型在此任务上表现欠佳，其语义推理仍严重受限于单字识别的准确性。
ai_comments: 本项研究的创新之处在于将甲骨文信息处理从传统的单字识别（字形分类）提升到了句子级的语义理解，并巧妙地通过“字形替换与合成”的方法，消除了原始拓片噪声对高级语义评估的干扰。其局限性在于，合成的标准化句子可能无法完全模拟真实拓片中复杂的物理破损和布局干扰；此外，基准的数据规模（95个原始拓片，695个问答对）相对较小，未来有进一步拓展的空间。
motivation: 现有的AI辅助甲骨文视觉识别和理解研究主要集中在单字层面，忽略了完整卜辞中蕴含的长文本连贯性和上下文依赖性。
method: 引入了S-OBI基准。该基准不直接使用嘈杂的原始拓片，而是根据专家验证的95篇原始拓片，用现有数据集中的清晰字形替换原拓片中的字符，合成清晰、规范的句子级甲骨文图像。在此基础上，设计了语义匹配、语义槽提取和上下文推理三类任务，共构建了695个问答对来评估多模态大模型。
results: 实验表明，当代多模态大模型在句子级甲骨文理解上表现不佳。特别是，未遮蔽区域的视觉感知错误会沿推理链传播，导致对遮蔽字符的错误预测。这表明当前模型在句子级理解上仍高度依赖于单字级别的识别。
conclusion: S-OBI提供了一个诊断性的基准，用于评估多模态大模型能否超越孤立的单字识别，向结构化的铭文（句子）级理解迈进。

title: HSDF-Lane: Height-Aligned Signed Distance Field with Semantic Lane Prior for 3D Lane Detection
authors: Jiyong Boo, Byeongin Joung, Hyemin Yang, Kuk-Jin Yoon
abstract: Monocular 3D lane detection plays a critical role in autonomous driving, yet recovering reliable 3D geometry from a single image remains challenging due to inherent depth ambiguity. Prior methods project image features into Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) space under a flat-ground assumption, causing geometric distortion on real-world roads. Recent methods instead predict explicit height maps to capture non-planar surfaces, but still rely on sparse anchor-based regression and exploit the recovered geometry merely for spatial transformation rather than semantic understanding. To overcome these limitations, we propose HSDF-Lane, which implicitly models the road surface as a Height-aligned Signed Distance Field (HSDF) over a densely sampled 3D feature volume. Through differentiable rendering, the HSDF jointly produces an accurate height map and surface-aligned features. We further introduce Lane-aware Semantic Positional Encoding (LSPE), which injects a lane-existence prior derived from the surface-aligned features into the transformer queries, coupling geometric structure with semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on the OpenLane benchmark show that HSDF-Lane achieves state-of-the-art performance in both 3D lane detection and height map estimation.
zh_title: HSDF-Lane：基于高度对齐带符号距离场与语义车道线先验的3D车道线检测
translation: 单目3D车道线检测在自动驾驶中起着至关重要的作用，但由于固有的深度歧义，从单张图像中恢复可靠的3D几何形状仍然具有挑战性。先前的方法在平坦地面假设下将图像特征投影到鸟瞰图（BEV）空间，这会导致真实世界道路上的几何失真。最近的方法虽然预测显式高度图以捕捉非平面，但仍依赖于稀疏的基于锚框的回归，并且仅将恢复的几何结构用于空间变换，而不是用于语义理解。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了 HSDF-Lane，它在密集采样的3D特征体积上将路面隐式建模为高度对齐的带符号距离场（HSDF）。通过可微渲染，HSDF 联合生成了精确的高度图和表面对齐的特征。我们还引入了车道感知语义位置编码（LSPE），它将从表面对齐特征中导出的车道存在先验注入到 Transformer 查询中，从而将几何结构与语义引导相结合。在 OpenLane 基准上的广泛实验表明，HSDF-Lane 在3D车道线检测和高度图估计方面均达到了最先进的性能。
tldr: 本文提出 HSDF-Lane，通过引入高度对齐的带符号距离场（HSDF）进行隐式路面建模，并结合车道感知语义位置编码（LSPE），显著提升了单目3D车道线检测和高度图估计的精度。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将三维重建中常用的隐式神经表示（SDF）引入到单目3D车道线检测中，通过可微渲染同时解决了高度估计与特征对齐的问题。此外，LSPE的设计巧妙地将几何表面信息转化为车道线语义先验，增强了Transformer查询的定位能力。主要局限在于，在密集3D特征体积上进行SDF建模和可微渲染可能会带来较大的计算和显存开销，摘要中未提及其实时性或推理延迟。
motivation: 单目3D车道线检测中由于深度歧义难以恢复可靠的3D几何。现有方法通常基于平坦地面假设将图像投影到BEV空间，导致真实非平坦道路上的几何失真；而近期预测显式高度图的方法又依赖稀疏锚框回归，且仅将几何恢复用于空间变换，未能充分利用其进行语义理解。
method:
提出 HSDF-Lane 框架：
1. **高度对齐带符号距离场 (HSDF)**：在密集采样的3D特征体积上将路面隐式建模为HSDF，通过可微渲染联合生成准确的高度图和表面对齐特征。
2. **车道感知语义位置编码 (LSPE)**：将从表面对齐特征中提取的车道存在先验注入到 Transformer 查询中，从而将几何结构与语义引导结合起来。
results: 在 OpenLane 基准测试上的广泛实验表明，HSDF-Lane 在 3D 车道线检测和高度图估计任务上均达到了最先进的（SOTA）性能。
conclusion: HSDF-Lane 通过隐式SDF建模和语义先验注入，成功克服了传统单目3D车道线检测中的几何失真以及几何与语义脱节的问题，在OpenLane基准上取得了领先的检测与高度图估计精度。

title: GaussianMap: Learning Gaussian Representation for Multi-Sensor Online HD Map Construction
authors: Hongyu Lyu, Julie Stephany Berrio Perez, Mao Shan, Stewart Worrall
abstract: Autonomous driving systems benefit from high-definition (HD) maps that provide critical information about road infrastructure. The online construction of HD maps offers a scalable approach to generate local vectorized maps from onboard sensor observations. Existing methods commonly adopt bird's-eye-view (BEV) features as the intermediate scene representation, encoding the surrounding space with fixed-resolution dense grids. However, map elements are spatially sparse yet require fine-grained geometric localization, making uniformly allocated BEV representations redundant and less effective for vectorized map prediction. In this work, we propose GaussianMap, an online HD map construction framework that learns an adaptive Gaussian representation of the surrounding scene. This representation consists of a set of Gaussian primitives on the BEV plane, each encoding a flexible local region with geometric properties and a feature vector, allowing the model to allocate representational capacity to map-relevant regions. To generate such a representation from sensor observations, we introduce a feed-forward Gaussian encoder that progressively refines these primitives through Gaussian interaction modeling and multi-sensor feature aggregation. The refined Gaussian representation is then splatted into a BEV feature map and decoded into vectorized map predictions. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 datasets demonstrate that GaussianMap achieves state-of-the-art performance in both camera-only and camera-LiDAR fusion settings. Our code will be made publicly available.
zh_title: GaussianMap：学习高斯表示用于多传感器在线高清地图构建
translation: 自动驾驶系统受益于提供关键道路基础设施信息的高清（HD）地图。在线构建高清地图提供了一种可扩展的方法，可以从车载传感器观测中生成局部矢量化地图。现有方法通常采用鸟瞰图（BEV）特征作为中间场景表示，以固定分辨率的密集网格编码周围空间。然而，地图元素在空间上是稀疏的，但需要精细的几何定位，这使得统一分配的BEV表示冗余且对矢量化地图预测效果不佳。在这项工作中，我们提出了GaussianMap，一个在线高清地图构建框架，它学习周围场景的自适应高斯表示。该表示由BEV平面上的一组高斯基元组成，每个基元编码一个灵活的局部区域，包含几何属性和特征向量，允许模型将表示能力分配给与地图相关的区域。为了从传感器观测中生成这种表示，我们引入了一个前馈高斯编码器，通过高斯交互建模和多传感器特征聚合逐步细化这些基元。细化后的高斯表示随后被splat到BEV特征图并解码为矢量化地图预测。在nuScenes和Argoverse 2数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，GaussianMap在纯摄像头和摄像头-激光雷达融合设置下均实现了最先进的性能。我们的代码将公开发布。
tldr: GaussianMap提出了一种新的在线高清地图构建框架，它使用自适应高斯表示来克服传统BEV表示在稀疏地图元素精细定位上的冗余和低效问题，并在多传感器设置下取得了最先进的性能。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入自适应高斯表示来解决在线高清地图构建中传统BEV表示的局限性，特别是在处理稀疏但需要精确定位的地图元素方面。其创新点在于将高斯基元作为灵活的场景表示，能够更有效地分配模型容量。这种方法提高了矢量化地图预测的准确性，并为未来的在线地图构建研究提供了新的方向。
motivation: 现有在线高清地图构建方法常用固定分辨率的BEV特征作为中间场景表示，但地图元素空间稀疏且需要精细几何定位，这使得统一分配的BEV表示冗余且对矢量化地图预测效果不佳。
method: 提出GaussianMap框架，学习周围场景的自适应高斯表示，该表示由BEV平面上的一组高斯基元组成，每个基元编码一个灵活的局部区域，包含几何属性和特征向量。通过前馈高斯编码器，利用高斯交互建模和多传感器特征聚合逐步细化这些基元。细化后的高斯表示被splat到BEV特征图并解码为矢量化地图预测。
results: 在nuScenes和Argoverse 2数据集上，GaussianMap在纯摄像头和摄像头-激光雷达融合设置下都达到了最先进的性能。
conclusion: GaussianMap通过其自适应高斯表示，有效解决了传统BEV表示在在线高清地图构建中的不足，并在多个基准测试中展现了卓越的性能。

title: ClawArena-Team: Benchmarking Subagent Orchestration and Dynamic Workflows in Language-Model Agents
authors: Kaiwen Xiong, Haonian Ji, Shi Qiu, Zeyu Zheng, Cihang Xie, Xinyu Ye, Huaxiu Yao
abstract: Production large language-model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed not as lone problem-solvers but as managers: a main model creates specialized subagents, delegates work, and orchestrates their parallel, asynchronous returns through dynamic workflows. Whether one model can actually run such a team is largely unmeasured: existing benchmarks score a policy's own task-solving or a fixed multi-agent system's emergent behavior, but none isolate the management ability of the single LLM acting as leader. We introduce ClawArena-Team, a benchmark of 41 multi-turn, multimodal, multi-directory scenarios spanning 258 evaluation rounds and 72 staged updates that measures this management ability. The main agent is deliberately constrained: it natively perceives only text and directly accesses only part of the workspace. It commands a fixed, locally served subagent pool, so score differences reflect management skill, not raw capability. All scoring is execution-based with no LLM judge: an overall score -- the Subagent-Management Score (SMS) -- multiplies task correctness by a least-privilege and modality-routing factor. Across twelve proprietary, community-hosted, and self-hosted models, experiments show that the management bottleneck is privilege granting rather than perception (no model exceeds 50% workspace-permission precision); that cost and management quality are decoupled (API cost spans over 100 times while the overall score spans under 4 times, with the cheapest open models on the Pareto frontier); and that most leaderboard scores cluster within a 9.9-point band while orchestration behaviors diverge by more than an order of magnitude. Code and data will be released.
zh_title: ClawArena-Team：评估语言模型智能体中的子智能体编排与动态工作流
translation: 在实际生产中，大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地被部署为管理者，而非单一的问题解决者：主模型创建专门的子智能体、分派工作，并通过动态工作流编排它们的并行、异步返回。然而，单个模型是否真正能够运行这样一个团队在很大程度上尚未得到衡量：现有的基准测试要么评估单个策略自身的任务解决能力，要么评估固定多智能体系统的涌现行为，但没有一个基准能够隔离出作为领导者的单个 LLM 的管理能力。我们引入了 ClawArena-Team，这是一个包含 41 个多轮、多模态、多目录场景的基准测试，涵盖 258 轮评估和 72 次阶段性更新，用于衡量这种管理能力。主智能体受到故意限制：它原生仅能感知文本，且仅能直接访问部分工作空间。它指挥一个固定的、本地服务的子智能体池，因此得分差异反映的是管理技能而非原始能力。所有评分均基于执行且无需 LLM 裁判：综合得分——子智能体管理得分（SMS）——将任务正确性乘以最小特权和模态路由因子。在对 12 个专有、社区托管和自托管模型的实验中，结果表明：管理瓶颈在于特权授予而非感知（没有模型的工作区权限精准度超过 50%）；成本与管理质量是解耦的（API 成本跨度超过 100 倍，而综合得分跨度在 4 倍以内，最便宜的开源模型处于帕累托前沿）；大多数排行榜得分聚集在 9.9 分的区间内，而编排行为的差异则超过一个数量级。代码和数据将会发布。
tldr: 本文推出了 ClawArena-Team 基准测试，专门用于隔离和评估单个 LLM 作为领导者在动态工作流中管理与编排子智能体的能力。
ai_comments:
1. 创新性：该研究敏锐地捕捉到了LLM从“单一执行者”向“团队管理者”角色转变的趋势，首次提出了专门评估LLM管理与子智能体编排能力的基准测试。
2. 方法设计巧妙：通过限制主智能体的感知和直接操作权限，并固定子智能体池，成功隔离了“管理能力”与“执行能力”，使评估结果更具说服力。
3. 实用性：引入了结合“最小特权原则”和“模态路由”的SMS评分机制，非常契合实际生产环境对安全性和效率的要求。
4. 局限性：目前场景数量（41个）相对较小，未来可进一步扩展以覆盖更复杂的现实管理冲突。
motivation: 在实际应用中，LLM智能体越来越多地扮演“管理者”角色，负责协调和分派任务给子智能体。然而，现有的基准测试要么只评估模型自身的任务解决能力，要么评估固定多智能体系统的群体行为，无法独立和量化地评估单个LLM作为领导者的管理与编排能力。
method: 提出了 ClawArena-Team 基准测试，包含 41 个多轮、多模态、多目录场景。主智能体受到严格限制（仅感知文本、仅能访问部分工作区），通过指挥固定的本地子智能体池来隔离其管理能力。评分采用完全基于执行的“子智能体管理得分（SMS）”，该得分由任务正确性乘以最小特权因子和模态路由因子计算得出。
results:
对 12 个模型的实验表明：
1. 管理瓶颈在于特权授予而非感知能力，所有模型在工作区权限精准度上均未超过 50%。
2. API 成本与管理质量严重解耦，成本差异超 100 倍而得分差异在 4 倍以内，最便宜的开源模型处于帕累托前沿。
3. 大多数模型在排行榜上的得分非常接近（在 9.9 分的区间内），但它们的具体编排行为差异超过一个数量级。
conclusion: ClawArena-Team 填补了评估LLM作为管理者协调子智能体能力的空白。实验表明，当前模型的管理瓶颈在于特权控制而非感知，且管理质量与API成本高度解耦，开源模型在性价比上表现出极高潜力。

title: AI-Assisted Discovery of Convex Relaxations via Dual Agents
authors: Sungyoon Kim, Mert Pilanci
abstract: Recent work shows that LLM agents can improve sharp-constant inequalities by searching for extremal constructions, which yield upper bounds. We address the complementary side: a lower bound holds for every admissible function and follows from a convex relaxation of the nonconvex problem, with tighter relaxations giving stronger bounds. We instantiate the autoresearch paradigm to discover such relaxations: a coding agent proposes valid tightening constraints, a theory agent verifies each one and searches for counterexamples, and every reported bound is certified by an explicit dual-feasible point checked in rigorous interval arithmetic. On two optimization constants studied by \citet{tao2025alphaevolve} - the first autocorrelation inequality ($C_{6.2}$) and the Erdős minimum-overlap constant ($C_{6.5}$) - we improve the certified lower bounds from $1.28$ to $1.2937$ and from $0.379005$ to $0.37912$, respectively.
zh_title: 基于双智能体辅助发现凸松弛的AI方法
translation: 最近的研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以通过搜索极值构造来改进强常数不等式，从而产生上界。我们解决了其互补的一面：下界对每个容许函数都成立，并且源于非凸问题的凸松弛，更紧密的松弛会带来更强的下界。我们实例化了自动研究（autoresearch）范式来发现此类松弛：编码智能体提出有效的收紧约束，理论智能体验证每一个约束并寻找反例，并且每一个报告的界限都通过在严格区间算术中检查的显式对偶可行点进行认证。在 Tao 等人（2025年）研究的两个优化常数上——第一自相关不等式（$C_{6.2}$）和 Erdős 最小重叠常数（$C_{6.5}$）——我们分别将经认证的下界从 $1.28$ 提高到 $1.2937$，以及从 $0.379005$ 提高到 $0.37912$。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于双智能体的AI自动研究方法，用于寻找并验证非凸问题的凸松弛，成功提高了两个著名数学优化常数的经认证下界。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将大语言模型（LLM）多智能体协作（编码智能体与理论智能体）引入到严谨的数学定理证明和凸松弛发现中。通过结合严格的区间算术来验证对偶可行点，确保了AI生成的数学界限的绝对正确性。这种将AI探索与严谨数学验证相结合的“自动研究”范式，为解决复杂的数学和理论优化问题提供了一种极具前景的新路径。
motivation: 现有的LLM智能体研究主要通过寻找极值构造来改进强常数不等式的上界。然而，寻找普适的下界（通过非凸问题的凸松弛来实现）同样重要且具有挑战性，更紧密的松弛能够提供更强的下界。本文旨在探索如何利用AI自动发现这些紧密的凸松弛。
method: 实例化自动研究（autoresearch）范式，采用双智能体协同：一个编码智能体负责提出有效的收紧约束，一个理论智能体负责验证每个约束并寻找反例。最终，通过在严格的区间算术中检查显式的对偶可行点，来对每一个报告的下界进行严谨认证。
results: 在两个经典的优化常数问题上，该方法成功提高了经认证的下界：将第一自相关不等式常数（$C_{6.2}$）的下界从 $1.28$ 提升至 $1.2937$；将 Erdős 最小重叠常数（$C_{6.5}$）的下界从 $0.379005$ 提升至 $0.37912$。
conclusion: 通过双智能体协同的自动研究范式，能够有效且严谨地发现更紧密的凸松弛，从而成功提高非凸优化问题的经认证下界。

title: AETDICE: Unified Framework and Offline Optimization for Nonlinear Multi-Objective RL
authors: Woosung Kim, Youngjun Suh, Jinho Lee, Jongmin Lee, Byung-Jun Lee
abstract: Optimizing nonlinear preferences in multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) is essential for capturing complex trade-offs like risk aversion or fairness. However, such non-linearity has historically bifurcated nonlinear MORL objectives into two distinct paradigms: Scalarized Expected Return (SER) and Expected Scalarized Return (ESR). While SER requires global-level optimization and ESR requires non-Markovian policies, leading to fragmented optimization strategies, we bridge this divide through the Aggregation-Expectation-Transformation (AET) framework. By unifying both criteria through a tripartite decomposition of scalarization, AET provides a principled foundation for general nonlinear MORL. Building on this framework, we propose AETDICE, a tractable offline RL algorithm for AET objectives. By utilizing DICE-style density-ratio estimation in an augmented state space, AETDICE enables sample-based optimization from static datasets. Our framework resolves long-standing barriers and captures respective trade-offs induced by AET framework, which existing methods fail to address.
zh_title: AETDICE：非线性多目标强化学习的统一框架与离线优化
translation: 在多目标强化学习（MORL）中，优化非线性偏好对于捕获诸如风险规避或公平性等复杂的权衡至关重要。然而，这种非线性在历史上将非线性MORL目标分化为两个截然不同的范式：标量化期望回报（SER）和期望标量化回报（ESR）。由于SER需要全局层面的优化，而ESR需要非马尔可夫策略，从而导致了碎片化的优化策略，我们通过“聚合-期望-变换”（AET）框架弥合了这一分歧。通过标量化的三部式分解来统一这两个标准，AET为通用的非线性MORL奠定了有原则的基础。基于该框架，我们提出了一种针对AET目标的易于处理的离线强化学习算法——AETDICE。通过在增强状态空间中利用DICE风格的密度比估计，AETDICE实现了从静态数据集中进行基于样本的优化。我们的框架解决了长期存在的障碍，并捕获了由AET框架引起的、现有方法未能解决的各自权衡。
tldr: 本文提出了AET框架，统一了非线性多目标强化学习中的SER和ESR两种范式，并开发了离线算法AETDICE，实现了从静态数据集中高效优化非线性偏好。
ai_comments: 这项工作具有很强的创新性和理论价值。其主要贡献在于通过AET框架将非线性多目标强化学习中长期分裂的SER和ESR两大范式进行了统一，为该领域提供了坚实的理论基础。此外，AETDICE算法的提出，利用DICE风格的密度比估计解决了离线设置下的非线性多目标优化问题，具有很高的实用价值。然而，由于仅基于摘要，该方法在大规模高维任务中的计算复杂度、收敛速度以及对静态数据集质量的依赖性等潜在局限性在摘要中未详细提及，需要在实际应用中进一步评估。
motivation: 在多目标强化学习（MORL）中，优化非线性偏好（如风险规避、公平性）非常重要。然而，非线性导致MORL目标分裂为标量化期望回报（SER）和期望标量化回报（ESR）两种不同范式，前者需要全局优化，后者需要非马尔可夫策略，导致优化策略碎片化。本文旨在弥合这一分歧。
method: 提出了“聚合-期望-变换”（AET）框架，通过标量化的三部式分解统一了SER和ESR两种标准。在此基础上，提出了AETDICE算法，该算法通过在增强状态空间中利用DICE风格的密度比估计，实现了在离线强化学习设置下从静态数据集中进行基于样本的优化。
results: AETDICE算法成功实现了一种易于处理的、基于样本的离线优化方法，能够从静态数据集中解决AET目标。该框架解决了长期存在的障碍，并捕获了现有方法无法处理的、由AET框架引导的各自权衡。
conclusion: AET框架成功为通用非线性多目标强化学习奠定了原则性基础，而基于此开发的AETDICE算法解决了长期存在的优化障碍，能够从静态数据集中有效捕获复杂的非线性折中，填补了现有方法的空白。

title: HealthAgentBench: A Unified Benchmark Suite of Realistic Agentic Healthcare Environments for Challenging Frontier AI Agents
authors: Qianchu Liu, Sheng Zhang, Guanghui Qin, Jeya Maria Jose Valanarasu, Maximilian Rokuss, Mingyu Lu, Timothy Ossowski, Juan Manuel Zambrano Chaves, Cliff Wong, Peniel Argaw, Yashna Hasija, Mu Wei, Wen-wai Yim, Qin Liu, Zilin Jing, Jason Entenmann, Naoto Usuyama, Tristan Naumann, Hoifung Poon
abstract: As AI agents become increasingly capable of complex, long-horizon reasoning, rigorous and holistic evaluation is essential for measuring progress toward real-world healthcare applications. We introduce HealthAgentBench, a suite of 54 agentic healthcare tasks across 7 categories each with its unique environment. The benchmark suite spans diverse workflows throughout the patient journey and a broad range of modalities. Each task is designed to replicate an end-to-end clinical workflow: given minimal instructions, an agent must explore raw healthcare data, operate within a complex environment, and execute multi-step solutions that go beyond naive prompting. A final task success rate is reported to provide a single, interpretable metric for HealthAgentBench overall performance for each agent. Evaluating frontier agents on HealthAgentBench, we find that overall task success rate remains low, underscoring the difficulty of the suite. The strongest and the most cost effective agent, Codex GPT-5.5, achieves only approximately 42% success rate. Beyond aggregate performance, HealthAgentBench reveals nuanced strengths and weaknesses across task categories. Frontier agents show promise in automatically developing research modeling pipelines over EHR data, but medical imaging remains especially challenging, particularly for Claude Code models, while Codex GPT-5.5 shows emerging capability. Tasks that combine large search spaces with compositional reasoning requirements remain difficult for all current agents. Together, these results suggest that HealthAgentBench provides a challenging and realistic benchmark with substantial room for future progress. We release our benchmark at https://github.com/microsoft/HealthAgentBench.
zh_title: HealthAgentBench：一个用于挑战前沿 AI 智能体的真实医疗智能体环境统一基准测试集
translation: 随着 AI 智能体在处理复杂、长程推理方面的能力日益增强，严谨且全面的评估对于衡量其在真实世界医疗应用中的进展至关重要。我们推出了 HealthAgentBench，这是一个包含 54 个智能体医疗任务的基准测试集，横跨 7 个类别，每个类别都有其独特的环境。该基准测试涵盖了患者诊疗过程中的多样化工作流以及广泛的模态。每个任务旨在复制端到端的临床工作流：在极少指令下，智能体必须探索原始医疗数据、在复杂环境中进行操作，并执行超越简单提示词的多步解决方案。报告最终的任务成功率，从而为每个智能体在 HealthAgentBench 上的整体表现提供一个单一、可解释的度量指标。通过在 HealthAgentBench 上评估前沿智能体，我们发现整体任务成功率仍然较低，这凸显了该套件的难度。最强且最具成本效益的智能体 Codex GPT-5.5 仅实现了约 42% 的成功率。除了总体表现外，HealthAgentBench 还揭示了智能体在不同任务类别中的细微优劣势。前沿智能体在电子健康档案（EHR）数据上自动开发研究建模管道方面展现出潜力，但医学影像仍然特别具有挑战性（尤其是对于 Claude Code 模型），而 Codex GPT-5.5 则展现出了新兴的能力。结合大搜索空间与组合推理要求的任务对于当前所有智能体来说仍然很困难。总之，这些结果表明 HealthAgentBench 提供了一个具有挑战性且真实的基准，为未来的进步留下了巨大的空间。我们在 https://github.com/microsoft/HealthAgentBench 开源了我们的基准。
tldr: 本文推出了 HealthAgentBench 基准测试集，包含 54 个端到端医疗任务，用于评估 AI 智能体在真实临床工作流中的长程推理能力；实验表明即使是目前最先进的智能体成功率也仅约 42%，说明该基准极具挑战性。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一个非常及时且具有高实用价值的医疗智能体评估基准。现有的医疗AI评估多局限于单步的问答或选择题，而该基准聚焦于端到端的长程临床工作流，极具前瞻性。其局限性在于，随着大模型能力的快速迭代，基准中的部分任务可能会在短期内被攻克，需要研究团队持续维护和更新任务库。
motivation: 随着 AI 智能体在处理复杂、长程推理方面的能力不断增强，迫切需要一个严谨且全面的评估基准，以衡量其在真实世界医疗应用中的实际进展。
method: 引入了 HealthAgentBench，这是一个包含 7 个类别、54 个智能体医疗任务的基准测试集，每个任务都配备独特的环境。这些任务旨在复制真实的端到端临床工作流程，要求智能体在仅有最少指令的情况下，探索原始医疗数据、在复杂环境中进行操作并执行多步骤的解决方案。最终通过任务成功率来评估智能体的整体表现。
results: 在 HealthAgentBench 上的评估表明，前沿智能体的整体任务成功率仍然较低。最强且最具成本效益的智能体 Codex GPT-5.5 仅取得了约 42% 的成功率。智能体在电子健康档案（EHR）数据上自动构建研究建模管道方面展现出潜力，但在医学影像任务（尤其是对 Claude Code 模型）以及结合了大搜索空间与组合推理要求的任务上仍然面临巨大挑战。
conclusion: HealthAgentBench 提供了一个极具挑战性且贴近现实的医疗智能体评估基准，为未来医疗领域 AI 智能体的研究与发展留下了巨大的提升空间。

title: Transformers as Bayesian In-Context Experimenters: Smoothness-Adaptive Efficient ATE Estimation
authors: Jiachun Li, David Simchi-Levi
abstract: Adaptive experiments for average treatment effects (ATE) require randomized allocations balancing valid inference with statistical efficiency. The oracle design is a covariate-dependent Neyman rule governed by unknown arm-conditional outcome variances. We investigate whether this sequential variance-estimation and allocation process can be amortized via in-context learning. We introduce Bayesian in-context experimenters: transformer policies trained to imitate a Bayesian posterior Neyman teacher. The teacher updates nonparametric beliefs over potential outcomes using experimental history to assign posterior Neyman treatment probabilities. This design converges to the oracle rule, supporting efficient ATE inference. Transformers constructively implement this mapping through attention-based sufficient statistics and projected gradient descent, imitating Bayesian updating for Gaussian-series priors. To address unknown outcome smoothness, we combine smoothness-indexed experimenters using a mixture-of-experts transformer. The gate acts as a hierarchical posterior over smoothness classes, concentrating on near-oracle experts. By bounding the complexity of the transformer class, we prove this amortized policy can be learned via empirical risk minimization using supervised pretraining. Experiments confirm accurate teacher imitation, adaptive allocation, and improved ATE precision over baselines.
zh_title: 作为贝叶斯上下文实验者的Transformer：平滑度自适应的高效ATE估计
translation: 用于平均处理效应（ATE）的自适应实验需要平衡有效推断与统计效率的随机分配。理想设计（oracle design）是一种依赖于协变量的Neyman规则，该规则由未知的实验组条件结果方差所决定。我们研究了是否可以通过上下文学习来摊销（amortize）这种顺序方差估计和分配的过程。我们引入了贝叶斯上下文实验者：训练Transformer策略以模仿贝叶斯后验Neyman教师。该教师利用实验历史更新对潜在结果的非参数信念，以分配后验Neyman治疗概率。该设计收敛于理想规则，支持高效的ATE推断。Transformer通过基于注意力的充分统计量和投影梯度下降建设性地实现了这种映射，模仿了高斯级数先验的贝叶斯更新。为了解决未知的输出平滑度问题，我们使用混合专家Transformer结合了平滑度索引的实验者。门控机制充当平滑度类别的分层后验，集中在接近理想状态的专家上。通过限制Transformer类别的复杂度，我们证明了该摊销策略可以通过使用监督预训练的经验风险最小化来学习。实验证实了准确的教师模仿、自适应分配以及相比基线改进的ATE精度。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的“贝叶斯上下文实验者”方法，通过模仿贝叶斯后验Neyman教师，在未知平滑度下实现了自适应、高效的平均处理效应（ATE）估计。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将大语言模型中的上下文学习（In-Context Learning）引入到因果推断的自适应实验设计中，通过训练Transformer去模仿贝叶斯后验Neyman教师，从而免去了复杂的实时贝叶斯计算。利用混合专家（MoE）机制解决未知平滑度问题的设计非常巧妙。然而，该方法对预训练数据集的质量和覆盖度依赖较高，在超分布（OOD）场景下的鲁棒性仍有待进一步验证。
motivation: 在自适应实验中，为了高效估计平均处理效应（ATE），需要根据未知的协变量条件结果方差进行自适应的样本分配（即Oracle Neyman规则）。然而，这种顺序方差估计和分配的过程计算复杂，本文旨在探索是否可以通过上下文学习（in-context learning）来摊销（amortize）这一繁琐的计算过程。
method: 提出“贝叶斯上下文实验者”（Bayesian in-context experimenters）框架。该方法通过监督预训练，使Transformer策略去模仿一个贝叶斯后验Neyman教师（该教师利用实验历史更新对潜在结果的非参数信念，并分配后验处理概率）。为了应对未知的输出平滑度，引入了混合专家（MoE）Transformer来组合不同平滑度下的实验者，利用门控网络作为平滑度类别的分层后验来聚焦于接近Oracle的专家。
results: 理论上，证明了Transformer可以通过基于注意力的充分统计量和投影梯度下降来构造性地实现该映射，并且该摊销策略可以通过经验风险最小化进行学习。实验结果表明，该方法能够精确模仿教师策略，实现自适应分配，并显著提高ATE估计的精度。
conclusion: 基于Transformer的贝叶斯上下文实验者能够有效模仿贝叶斯后验更新，在未知结果平滑度的情况下实现自适应的样本分配，并最终实现收敛于Oracle规则的高效平均处理效应（ATE）推断。

title: Gated Multi-Graph Fusion via Graph Attention Networks for Alzheimer's Disease Detection
authors: Jinyu Li, Xiao Wei, Bin Wen, Kai Li, Yuqin Lin, Xiaobao Wang, Longbiao Wang, Jianwu Dang
abstract: Spontaneous speech is a vital non-invasive biomarker for Alzheimer's Disease (AD), yet many systems overlook non-linear structural disruptions and clinical heterogeneity in pathological language. We propose a Multi-View Gated Graph Attention Network that transcribes audio via Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) to construct semantic, dependency, and co-occurrence graphs, characterizing speech through a "content-structure-flow" framework. Notably, the co-occurrence graph leverages Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) from a normative corpus to quantify narrative logic and linguistic deviation. To address symptomatic diversity, an adaptive gated fusion mechanism dynamically integrates these views. Evaluated on the ADReSSo dataset, our model achieves 90.00% accuracy. Ablation results confirm that the PMI-based graph and heterogeneity-aware gating are essential for robust classification across diverse clinical populations. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/opeacc/AD.
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables, and accepted in interspeech 2026 conference
zh_title: 基于图注意力网络的门控多图融合用于阿尔茨海默病检测
translation: 自发性言语是阿尔茨海默病（AD）重要的非侵入性生物标志物，但许多系统忽视了病理语言中的非线性结构破坏和临床异质性。我们提出了一种多视图门控图注意力网络，通过自动语音识别（ASR）转录音频，构建语义、依存和共现图，通过“内容-结构-流”框架表征言语。值得注意的是，共现图利用规范语料库的点互信息（PMI）来量化叙事逻辑和语言偏差。为了解决症状多样性问题，采用自适应门控融合机制动态整合这些视图。在ADReSSo数据集上评估，我们的模型达到了90.00%的准确率。消融结果证实，基于PMI的图和异质性感知门控对于在不同临床人群中实现鲁棒分类至关重要。我们的源代码可在https://github.com/opeacc/AD公开获取。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种门控多图注意力网络（Gated Multi-Graph Attention Network），通过构建语义、依存和共现图来分析自发性言语，以检测阿尔茨海默病。该模型在ADReSSo数据集上达到了90.00%的准确率，并强调了基于PMI的图和异质性感知门控的重要性。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于结合多视图图（语义、依存、共现）来全面表征自发性言语，并通过基于PMI的共现图量化语言偏差。此外，自适应门控融合机制有效地解决了阿尔茨海默病检测中临床异质性问题，提高了模型在多样临床人群中的鲁棒性。这是一个有前景的方向，可以为AD的早期诊断提供更准确和非侵入性的工具。
motivation: 自发性言语是阿尔茨海默病（AD）重要的非侵入性生物标志物，但许多现有系统忽视了病理语言中的非线性结构破坏和临床异质性。
method: 本研究提出了一种多视图门控图注意力网络（Multi-View Gated Graph Attention Network）。该方法通过自动语音识别（ASR）转录音频，构建语义图、依存图和共现图，以“内容-结构-流”框架表征言语。其中，共现图利用规范语料库的点互信息（PMI）量化叙事逻辑和语言偏差。为解决症状多样性问题，采用自适应门控融合机制动态整合这些视图。
results: 在ADReSSo数据集上，模型达到了90.00%的准确率。消融实验结果证实，基于PMI的图和异质性感知门控对于在不同临床人群中实现鲁棒分类至关重要。
conclusion: 本研究提出的基于门控多图融合的图注意力网络能够有效检测阿尔茨海默病，并且其多视图图构建和异质性感知融合机制对于提高分类性能和鲁棒性至关重要。

title: ISM:Self-Improving Strategy Memory for Continual Mathematical Reasoning
authors: Prakhar Dixit, Tim Oates
abstract: We propose Intelligent Schema Memory (ISM), a self-evolving memory-augmented system that improves mathematical reasoning for a frozen LLM under continual learning with hard episodic resets. ISM maintains a compact, self-refined bank of strategy schemas learned from both successful and failed episodes, with symbolic tools that check intermediate steps and certify answers.Without updating model parameters, ISM outperforms passive, retrieval, and reflection baselines on MATH-Hard and OlympiadBench, using 64% and 86% fewer schemas respectively than the strongest passive baseline. These results show that small, actively maintained, and verified strategy memories can support reliable continual mathematical reasoning under strict episodic isolation.

zh_title: ISM：用于持续数学推理的自改进策略记忆

motivation: 提高冻结大型语言模型（LLM）在持续学习和硬性情景重置下的数学推理能力。
method: 本文提出了智能模式记忆（ISM），这是一个自进化的记忆增强系统。ISM通过维护一个紧凑、自完善的策略模式库来工作，该模式库从成功和失败的推理情景中学习。它还结合了符号工具来检查中间步骤并验证答案，所有这些都在不更新模型参数的前提下进行。

title: Planar Embedding of Okamura-Seymour Quasimetrics in Polynomial Time with an Application to Distributed SSSP
authors: Hung Le, Hector Tierno, Shuang Yang
abstract:
A quasi-metric $(T,δ_T)$ is an Okamura-Seymour quasimetric if there exists an edge-weighted planar embedded directed graph $G = (V,E,w)$ such that $T$ is a set of terminals on the outerface of $G$ and $δ_G(t,t') = δ_T(t,t')$ for every pair $(t,t')\in T\times T$. If $(T,δ_T)$ is an Okamura-Seymour quasimetric, then $G$ is a planar embedding of $(T,δ_T)$.
  In a recent pioneering work, Chen and Tan gave a polynomial-time algorithm to test if a given quasi-metric $(T,δ_T)$ is an Okamura-Seymour quasimetric. A key step in their proof is existential, which suffices for an efficient testing algorithm but does not imply an efficient embedding algorithm. Our paper closes this gap by giving an algorithmic implementation of their existential step via linear programming. As a result, we obtain the first polynomial-time algorithm for finding a planar embedding of any given Okamura-Seymour quasimetric $(T,δ_T)$.
  As an application, we show how to use our planar embedding of Okamura-Seymour quasimetrics to compute a $(1+ε)$-approximate single-source shortest path (SSSP) in planar directed graphs in the distributed CONGEST model in $\widetilde{O}(D)$ rounds for any fixed $ε\in (0,1)$, nearly matching a simple lower bound of $Ω(D)$ and resolving a fundamental problem in this area. The best-known algorithm for this problem has round complexity $\widetilde{O}(D^2)$.
zh_title: Okamura-Seymour拟度量在多项式时间内的平面嵌入及其在分布式SSSP中的应用
translation:
一个拟度量$(T,\delta_T)$被称为Okamura-Seymour拟度量，如果存在一个边加权的平面嵌入有向图$G=(V,E,w)$，使得$T$是$G$外表面上的一组终端，并且对于每对$(t,t')\in T\times T$，$\delta_G(t,t') = \delta_T(t,t')$。如果$(T,\delta_T)$是一个Okamura-Seymour拟度量，那么$G$是$(T,\delta_T)$的一个平面嵌入。
在最近的一项开创性工作中，Chen和Tan给出了一个多项式时间算法来测试一个给定的拟度量$(T,\delta_T)$是否是Okamura-Seymour拟度量。他们证明中的一个关键步骤是存在性的，这对于一个高效的测试算法来说是足够的，但并不意味着一个高效的嵌入算法。本文通过线性规划对他们存在性步骤进行算法实现，从而弥补了这一空白。因此，我们获得了第一个用于寻找任何给定Okamura-Seymour拟度量$(T,\delta_T)$平面嵌入的多项式时间算法。
作为一个应用，我们展示了如何使用我们的Okamura-Seymour拟度量平面嵌入算法，在分布式CONGEST模型中，对于任何固定的$\varepsilon\in (0,1)$，以$\widetilde{O}(D)$轮次计算平面有向图的$(1+\varepsilon)$-近似单源最短路径（SSSP），这几乎匹配了$\Omega(D)$的简单下限，并解决了该领域的一个基本问题。该问题的最佳已知算法的轮次复杂度为$\widetilde{O}(D^2)$。
tldr: 本文通过线性规划实现了Okamura-Seymour拟度量平面嵌入的第一个多项式时间算法，并将其应用于分布式CONGEST模型下平面有向图的近似单源最短路径（SSSP）计算，将轮次复杂度从$\widetilde{O}(D^2)$提升到$\widetilde{O}(D)$。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于通过线性规划将Chen和Tan研究中的存在性步骤转化为可实现的算法，从而首次在多项式时间内解决了Okamura-Seymour拟度量的平面嵌入问题。其重要性不仅在于理论上的突破，更在于其在分布式SSSP问题上的实际应用，将该问题的轮次复杂度从平方级别降低到接近线性的D级别，对分布式算法领域具有重要意义。
motivation: 先前的研究（Chen and Tan）给出了一个多项式时间算法来测试一个给定的拟度量是否是Okamura-Seymour拟度量，但其证明中的关键步骤是存在性的，不足以实现高效的嵌入算法。本文旨在弥补这一空白，提供一个高效的嵌入算法。
method: 通过线性规划对Chen和Tan研究中存在的关键步骤进行算法实现。
results: 获得了第一个在多项式时间内找到任何给定Okamura-Seymour拟度量平面嵌入的算法。作为一个应用，该方法在分布式CONGEST模型中，以$\widetilde{O}(D)$轮次（对于任何固定的$\varepsilon \in (0,1)$）计算平面有向图的$(1+\varepsilon)$-近似单源最短路径（SSSP），这几乎匹配了$\Omega(D)$的简单下限，并解决了该领域的一个基本问题。此前的最佳算法的轮次复杂度为$\widetilde{O}(D^2)$。
conclusion: 本文提供了一个多项式时间算法来寻找Okamura-Seymour拟度量的平面嵌入，并通过将其应用于分布式SSSP问题，将该问题的轮次复杂度显著降低，解决了该领域的一个基本问题。

title: Diffusion-based 4D Trajectory Prediction and Distributed Control for UAV Swarms
authors: Tianshun Li, Hongliang Lu, Haoang Li, Xinhu Zheng
abstract: Accurate 4D trajectory prediction and closed-loop tracking are essential for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) swarms to achieve safe and efficient operations in complex low-altitude environments such as urban airspaces, industrial sites, and indoor facilities. However, this task remains challenging due to intrinsic nonlinearity of UAV swarm dynamics and strict real-time constraints of swarm formation control. To address these challenges, we propose a unified framework that couples coarse-to-fine trajectory forecasting with uncertainty-aware Distributed Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (DNMPC). Our approach features two key innovations: 1) a dimension-decoupled trajectory prediction module that reduces computational complexity by forecasting axis-wise motion, and 2) a diffusion-based residual dynamics refinement module that captures temporally correlated dynamic uncertainties. These refined predictions are then integrated into a DNMPC loop to ensure formation stability. We also introduce a synchronized multi-scenario 4D UAV swarm dataset spanning six representative airspace scenarios. The dataset contains over \textbf{7,900} frames of synchronized three-UAV trajectories with frame-level annotations of speed intention and target sector. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing trajectory tracking error by up to \textbf{10-15\%} and achieving sub-\textbf{0.07\,m} average tracking error in complex urban and industrial environments, while maintaining real-time inference speeds of 34 FPS (sub-30 ms latency) suitable for agile flight.
zh_title: 基于扩散的无人机群4D轨迹预测与分布式控制
translation: 准确的4D轨迹预测和闭环跟踪对于无人机（UAV）群在城市空域、工业场地和室内设施等复杂低空环境中实现安全高效操作至关重要。然而，由于无人机群动力学的内在非线性和群编队控制严格的实时性约束，这项任务仍然具有挑战性。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一个统一框架，将粗到细的轨迹预测与不确定性感知的分布式非线性模型预测控制（DNMPC）相结合。我们的方法具有两个关键创新：1) 一个维度解耦的轨迹预测模块，通过轴向运动预测降低计算复杂度；2) 一个基于扩散的残差动力学细化模块，捕获时间相关的动态不确定性。这些细化后的预测随后被整合到DNMPC循环中以确保编队稳定性。我们还引入了一个同步多场景4D无人机群数据集，涵盖了六种代表性空域场景。该数据集包含超过7,900帧的同步三无人机轨迹，并带有速度意图和目标扇区的帧级注释。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法优于现有最先进的基线，将轨迹跟踪误差降低了10-15%，并在复杂城市和工业环境中实现了低于0.07米的平均跟踪误差，同时保持了34帧/秒（低于30毫秒延迟）的实时推理速度，适用于敏捷飞行。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种统一框架，结合粗到细的轨迹预测和不确定性感知的分布式非线性模型预测控制，以实现无人机群在复杂环境中的安全高效操作。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过结合扩散模型进行不确定性感知预测和分布式模型预测控制，为无人机群的4D轨迹预测和控制提供了一个创新性的解决方案。其维度解耦和残差动力学细化模块有效地处理了复杂动力学和实时性约束。引入的同步多场景数据集也为未来的研究提供了宝贵的资源。
motivation: 无人机群在城市空域、工业场地和室内设施等复杂低空环境中实现安全高效操作，需要准确的4D轨迹预测和闭环跟踪。然而，由于无人机群动力学的内在非线性和群编队控制严格的实时性约束，这项任务仍然具有挑战性。
method: 提出一个统一框架，结合粗到细的轨迹预测与不确定性感知的分布式非线性模型预测控制（DNMPC）。该方法有两个关键创新：1) 维度解耦的轨迹预测模块，通过轴向运动预测降低计算复杂度；2) 基于扩散的残差动力学细化模块，捕获时间相关的动态不确定性。这些细化后的预测被整合到DNMPC循环中以确保编队稳定性。此外，还引入了一个包含六种代表性空域场景的同步多场景4D无人机群数据集。
results: 该方法在复杂城市和工业环境中，将轨迹跟踪误差降低了10-15%，平均跟踪误差达到0.07米以下，同时保持了34 FPS（低于30毫秒延迟）的实时推理速度，适用于敏捷飞行。
conclusion: 该方法优于现有基线，显著降低了轨迹跟踪误差，并在保持实时性的同时，实现了复杂环境中的精确跟踪。

title: Distilling Temporal Coherence into 2D Networks for Transrectal Ultrasound Prostate Video Segmentation
authors: Dong Yeong Kim, JunGyu Lee, Jaewon Choi, June Young Seo, Myeongseop Kim, Jinwook Choi, Taek Min Kim, Young-Gon Kim
abstract: Real-time video segmentation of the prostate in Transrectal Ultrasound (TRUS) is essential for image-guided interventions. While conventional 2D methods suffer from inter-frame inconsistencies by disregarding temporal context, 3D architectures incur prohibitive latency. To resolve this dilemma, we present a Temporally Consistent Learning Framework that distills temporal coherence into a 2D network during training, preserving single-frame inference efficiency. Our design is driven by a key clinical observation: the prostate exhibits geometric stability, whereas the surrounding acoustic environment fluctuates due to physiological motion and transducer pressure. Because conventional temporal constraints propagate erroneous gradients from these unstable regions, we introduce a Confidence-Weighted Temporal Consistency objective derived from optical flow warping residuals, selectively attenuating contributions from unreliable regions. Complementing this pixel-wise constraint, a Dual-scale Prototype Alignment Module enforces semantic coherence through contrastive optimization of local boundary and global semantic features. Furthermore, to eliminate the need for dense per-frame video annotations, we employ geometric equivariance-based pseudo-labeling with knowledge distillation from a pretrained teacher. Extensive experiments on SUN-SEG and our newly introduced TRUS-V benchmark (2,679 frames) demonstrate state-of-the-art accuracy and temporal consistency at real-time speed. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/DYDevelop/DTC-TRUS.

zh_title: 将时间相干性蒸馏到2D网络中用于经直肠超声前列腺视频分割
translation: 经直肠超声（TRUS）中前列腺的实时视频分割对于图像引导介入治疗至关重要。传统的2D方法由于忽略时间上下文而存在帧间不一致性，而3D架构则会带来过高的延迟。为了解决这个困境，我们提出了一个时间一致性学习框架，在训练期间将时间相干性蒸馏到2D网络中，从而保持单帧推理效率。我们的设计源于一个关键的临床观察：前列腺表现出几何稳定性，而周围的声学环境由于生理运动和换能器压力而波动。由于传统的时间约束会从这些不稳定区域传播错误的梯度，我们引入了一个基于光流扭曲残差的置信度加权时间一致性目标，选择性地衰减来自不可靠区域的贡献。作为这种像素级约束的补充，一个双尺度原型对齐模块通过局部边界和全局语义特征的对比优化来强制执行语义相干性。此外，为了消除对密集逐帧视频标注的需求，我们采用基于几何等变性的伪标签结合预训练教师模型的知识蒸馏。在SUN-SEG和我们新引入的TRUS-V基准（2,679帧）上进行的广泛实验表明，该方法在实时速度下实现了最先进的准确性和时间一致性。代码和数据集可在https://github.com/DYDevelop/DTC-TRUS获取。
tldr: 本文提出一个时间一致性学习框架，将时间相干性蒸馏到2D网络中，以解决经直肠超声前列腺视频分割中2D网络帧间不一致和3D网络延迟高的问题。该框架通过置信度加权的时间一致性目标和双尺度原型对齐模块，实现了实时、高精度和时间一致性的分割，同时利用几何等变性伪标签减少了对密集标注的需求。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于巧妙地将时间一致性蒸馏到2D网络中，解决了实时医学图像分割中的一个核心难题，即精度与速度的平衡。特别是置信度加权的时间一致性目标，通过识别并削弱不可靠区域的贡献，有效提升了模型在复杂生理环境下的鲁棒性。同时，结合伪标签和知识蒸馏来减少对密集标注的依赖，对于医学图像领域的数据稀缺问题具有重要的实践意义。该方法为未来实时、高精度和低标注成本的医学视频分割提供了有价值的思路。
motivation: 经直肠超声（TRUS）中前列腺的实时视频分割对于图像引导介入治疗至关重要。传统的2D方法由于忽略时间上下文而存在帧间不一致性，而3D架构则会带来过高的延迟。
method: 本文提出了一个时间一致性学习框架，在训练期间将时间相干性蒸馏到2D网络中，以保持单帧推理效率。该框架引入了基于光流扭曲残差的置信度加权时间一致性目标，选择性地衰减来自不可靠区域的贡献。同时，一个双尺度原型对齐模块通过局部边界和全局语义特征的对比优化来强制执行语义相干性。此外，为消除对密集逐帧视频标注的需求，该方法采用基于几何等变性的伪标签结合预训练教师模型的知识蒸馏。

conclusion: 该框架成功解决了传统2D方法帧间不一致和3D架构延迟过高的问题，为经直肠超声前列腺视频分割提供了实时、高精度和时间一致性的解决方案。

title: Machine Learning-based Feedback Linearization Control of Quadrotor Subject to Unmodeled Dynamics
authors: Amos Alwala, Gabriel da Silva Lima, Wallace Moreira Bessa
abstract: The control of agile quadrotors in dynamic and uncertain environments remains an open area of investigation to this day, particularly when the complete system dynamics are partially known or highly nonlinear. This work introduces a novel machine learning-based feedback-linearization control framework that employs a Gaussian Radial Basis Function (RBF) neural network (NN) to model and compensate for unmodeled dynamics in real time. The proposed controller leverages the universal approximation capability of RBF networks to model nonlinearities and uncertainties. An online adaptation of the RBF NN updates the network's weights without prior training. The control law is derived using the Lyapunov stability theory, herein guaranteeing closed-loop stability and providing theoretical guarantee of asymptotic convergence of a trajectory tracking task. Gazebo simulation and real flight experiments are conducted using the Bitcraze's Crazyflie 2.1 quadrotor subject to unmodeled air drag, actuator dynamics, and external disturbance. Despite incomplete knowledge of prior dynamics and presence of external disturbance such as air drag and drift in state estimation, the proposed controller improves trajectory tracking with rapid convergence and reduction of position-norm and yaw orientation RMSE by more than $7.13\%$ and $49.27\%$ respectively compared to baseline feedback linearization controller.
