zh_title: Dilemmadata：关于异构罗马数字数据集的互操作性研究
translation: 近年来，人们在标注和收集用于支持调性和声数据驱动研究的大规模罗马数字分析语料库方面做出了越来越多的努力。我们推出了 dilemmadata，这是首个调和了两个主要数据集——AugmentedNet 数据集（AN）和 Distant Listening 语料库（DLC）——的资源，通过共享的逐音符 TSV 模式使它们能够互操作。这一调和过程面临四类困境：标注标准（两者在词汇量、语法、和弦延伸约定、特殊和弦功能分类方面对同一音乐事实的编码不同）、表示形式（什么算作一行，以及转换后保留了哪些信息）、工具链（围绕 music21 与 ms3+dimcat 构建的不兼容 Python 生态系统）以及文献策展（哪些乐曲应该包含、排除或保留两次）。我们通过有意识地转换、增强和省略信息，形式化这些不匹配，保留音乐语义，并标记可能微妙影响标注保真度的转换来解决这些问题。一致性检查和定性检查对转换后的有效性进行了初步评估，并为批判每个原始标准中嵌入的理论假设提供了基础。在去除重复并合并这两个集合后，最终生成的 dilemmadata（包含 1,621 首乐曲和约 280 万个逐音符标注）是目前可用的最大同质罗马数字语料库，尽管它远非完美。至关重要的是，我们保留了两个语料库中共同拥有的 84 首乐曲，并保留了它们各自的原始分析，从而产生了一个共享的参考集，在此参考集中，可以针对相同的音乐材料对两种同样合理的分析传统进行逐音符的对比。dilemmadata 已在 Zenodo 上发布，支持互操作性、对比和声建模以及未来罗马数字编码标准的精细化。
tldr: 本文推出了 dilemmadata，这是首个通过共享的逐音符 TSV 模式调和并合并了两个主流罗马数字数据集（AN 和 DLC）的开源资源，提供了目前最大的同质化罗马数字语料库。
ai_comments: 该研究具有很高的实用价值，成功地将两个主流但互不兼容的音乐分析数据集进行了深度整合，解决了音乐信息检索（MIR）领域长期存在的数据孤岛和标准不一的问题。其核心创新点在于不仅进行了简单的数据格式转换，还深入探讨并形式化了不同音乐分析流派之间的理论差异，特别是保留了84首共有乐曲的双重分析，为比较音乐学研究提供了宝贵的基准。局限性在于，由于原始标准的异构性，转换过程中不可避免地存在信息主动省略或保真度受损的风险，且作者也承认最终数据集“远非完美”。
motivation: 尽管近年来在收集大规模罗马数字分析语料库以支持数据驱动的调性和声研究方面取得了进展，但现有的主要数据集（如 AN 和 DLC）在标注标准、数据表示、工具链和文献策展上面临严重的不一致，导致它们无法直接互操作。
method: 提出了一种共享的逐音符（note-wise）TSV 模式，通过主动转换、增强和省略信息，形式化不匹配之处，保留音乐语义，并标记可能影响标注保真度的转换，从而调和了两个数据集。此外，还通过一致性检查和定性检查对转换后的有效性进行了评估。
results: 成功合并了 AN 和 DLC 数据集，去除了重复项，生成了包含 1,621 首乐曲和约 280 万个逐音符标注的 dilemmadata 数据集，这是目前最大的同质化罗马数字语料库。此外，还保留了 84 首两数据集共有的乐曲及其各自的原始分析，形成了一个可用于对比研究的共享参考集。该资源已在 Zenodo 上发布。
conclusion: dilemmadata 成功实现了异构罗马数字数据集的互操作性，为比较和声建模、计算音乐学研究以及未来罗马数字编码标准的精细化提供了强有力的支持。

title: Robust Text Watermarking for Large Language Models via Dual Semantic Embeddings
authors: Jonas Schäfer, Cezary Pilaszewicz, Gerhard Wunder
abstract: This work presents Dual-Embedding Watermarking (DEW), a semantic watermarking scheme for large language models (LLMs) that leverages contextual and token-level embeddings to enhance robustness against paraphrasing and translation. DEW utilizes a signal-processing methodology, applying algebraic vector-space operations to \mbox{token and context embeddings to derive a watermark signal that degrades gracefully under semantic shifts. The method obfuscates the watermark by projecting embedding vectors through pseudo-random matrices seeded with a secret key. Relevant distributions derived from the underlying algebra are evaluated and employed for statistical testing and benchmarking of DEW. Experimental results across multiple LLMs indicate that DEW improves post-paraphrase detection while maintaining competitive text quality, and remains detectable after translation, even when prior semantic watermarks degrade significantly. These findings position DEW as a practical and robust solution for safeguarding LLM-generated text and addressing critical issues in responsible AI deployment.
zh_title: 通过双重语义嵌入实现大型语言模型鲁棒文本水印
translation: 这项工作提出了双嵌入水印（DEW），这是一种针对大型语言模型（LLM）的语义水印方案，它利用上下文和token级嵌入来增强对释义和翻译的鲁棒性。DEW采用信号处理方法，将代数向量空间操作应用于token和上下文嵌入，以导出在语义变化下能逐渐退化的水印信号。该方法通过将嵌入向量通过由密钥生成的伪随机矩阵进行投影来混淆水印。对源自底层代数的相关分布进行了评估，并用于DEW的统计测试和基准测试。在多个LLM上的实验结果表明，DEW在保持竞争性文本质量的同时，提高了释义后的检测率，并且在翻译后仍可检测，即使先前的语义水印显著退化。这些发现使DEW成为保护LLM生成文本和解决负责任AI部署中关键问题的实用且鲁棒的解决方案。
tldr: DEW是一种针对大型语言模型的语义水印方案，它利用上下文和token级嵌入来增强对释义和翻译的鲁棒性。
ai_comments: DEW的创新之处在于其结合了上下文和token级嵌入，并采用信号处理方法和代数向量空间操作来创建鲁棒的水印。这种方法使其在面对释义和翻译等语义变化时表现出优越的鲁棒性，这对于LLM生成内容的溯源和负责任的AI部署至关重要。该研究的局限性可能在于其对“竞争性文本质量”的量化标准以及在更广泛、更复杂的语义攻击下的表现。
motivation: 解决大型语言模型生成文本面临的释义和翻译鲁棒性差的问题，以保障LLM生成文本的安全并解决负责任AI部署中的关键问题。
method: DEW利用信号处理方法，对token和上下文嵌入应用代数向量空间操作，以导出在语义变化下能逐渐退化的水印信号。该方法通过将嵌入向量通过由密钥生成的伪随机矩阵进行投影来混淆水印。
results: 实验结果表明，DEW在保持竞争性文本质量的同时，提高了释义后的检测率，并且在翻译后仍可检测，即使先前的语义水印显著退化。
conclusion: DEW是一种实用且鲁棒的解决方案，用于保护LLM生成的文本并解决负责任AI部署中的关键问题。

title: Uncertainty Quantification via Invariant-Measure Conformal Prediction
authors: Mohammadhossein Bakhtiaridoust, Dominik Baumann, Shankar Deka
abstract: Uncertainty quantification for learned stochastic dynamical systems is essential in safety-critical tasks such as control and monitoring. Standard conformal prediction provides finite-sample coverage guarantees under exchangeability, but this assumption is typically violated in dynamical systems because trajectory data are temporally dependent, state distributions evolve, and recursive prediction errors accumulate. This paper proposes an invariant-measure conformal prediction (imCP) framework that calibrates uncertainty using independent samples from an invariant measure of the Markov process induced by the dynamics. This aligns calibration with the stationary operating regime and restores the statistical symmetry needed for rolling one-step split conformal guarantees. For recursive multi-step prediction, imCP combines conformal calibration with Lipschitz error propagation through the learned predictor to obtain explicit horizon-dependent bounds.These pre-deployment uncertainty tubes are suitable for rolling and receding-horizon applications, such as self-triggered control and fault detection, where uncertainty bounds must be computed before future residuals are observed. Numerical experiments show that imCP yields reliable bounds, while non-invariant calibration can become misaligned during deployment.
zh_title: 基于不变测度共形预测的不确定性量化
translation: 不确定性量化对于学习型随机动力系统在控制和监测等安全关键任务中至关重要。标准共形预测在可交换性假设下提供有限样本覆盖保证，但这一假设在动力系统中通常被违反，因为轨迹数据具有时间依赖性，状态分布演变，并且递归预测误差会累积。本文提出了一种不变测度共形预测（imCP）框架，它利用动力系统诱导的马尔可夫过程的不变测度中的独立样本来校准不确定性。这使得校准与平稳运行状态对齐，并恢复了滚动一步分割共形保证所需的统计对称性。对于递归多步预测，imCP将共形校准与通过学习预测器进行的Lipschitz误差传播相结合，以获得明确的依赖于预测范围的边界。这些部署前的不确定性管适用于滚动和后推式应用，例如自触发控制和故障检测，其中不确定性边界必须在观察到未来残差之前计算。数值实验表明，imCP产生了可靠的边界，而非不变性校准在部署过程中可能会出现偏差。
tldr: 本文提出了一种不变测度共形预测（imCP）框架，通过利用动力系统的不变测度样本校准不确定性，并结合Lipschitz误差传播，为学习型随机动力系统提供可靠的预部署不确定性边界，解决了标准共形预测在时间相关数据和递归误差下的局限性。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将共形预测与动力系统的不变测度概念结合，有效解决了标准共形预测在处理时间序列数据和递归预测误差时的挑战。通过引入不变测度校准和Lipschitz误差传播，imCP能够为安全关键的控制和监测任务提供更可靠、更实用的预部署不确定性量化。其对滚动和后推式应用的适用性增强了其实用价值。
motivation: 不确定性量化对于学习型随机动力系统在控制和监测等安全关键任务中至关重要。然而，标准共形预测在动力系统中往往失效，因为轨迹数据具有时间依赖性，状态分布演变，且递归预测误差会累积，这违反了其所需的可交换性假设。
method: 本文提出了一种不变测度共形预测（imCP）框架。该框架利用动力系统诱导的马尔可夫过程的不变测度中的独立样本来校准不确定性，从而使校准与平稳运行状态对齐并恢复统计对称性。对于递归多步预测，imCP将共形校准与通过学习预测器进行的Lipschitz误差传播相结合，以获得明确的、依赖于预测范围的边界。这些预部署的不确定性管适用于滚动和后推式应用。
results: 数值实验表明，imCP产生了可靠的边界，而非不变性校准在部署过程中可能会出现偏差。
conclusion: imCP框架通过利用不变测度校准和Lipschitz误差传播，为学习型随机动力系统提供了可靠的不确定性量化边界，适用于安全关键的滚动和后推式应用，克服了标准共形预测在动力系统中的局限性。

title: Learning Structurally Consistent Representations for Multi-View Radar Semantic Segmentation
authors: Ali Zia, Muhammad Umer Ramzan, Abdelwahed Khamis, Usman Ali, Abdul Rehman
abstract: Radar sensors provide reliable perception under adverse weather and lighting conditions, but their sparse, noisy, and weakly semantic measurements make dense semantic segmentation challenging. Most existing radar segmentation methods rely on grid-based encodings and pairwise interactions, which struggle to capture the higher-order relational structure formed by multiple radar returns from the same physical object. We introduce a unified higher-order structural alignment framework for multi-view radar segmentation. The proposed method refines radar feature representations using learnable hypergraphs to capture higher-order dependencies among spatially related responses. To ensure consistency across heterogeneous radar projections, we further align view-specific features using Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT), enabling correspondence-free alignment under varying measurement densities and partial observations. An adaptive attention mechanism then fuses complementary radar views while emphasising structurally informative responses under sparsity and noise. The resulting architecture learns structurally consistent representations across Range Angle (RA), Range Doppler (RD), and Angle Doppler (AD) views and is trained using supervised segmentation together with cross-view consistency regularisation. Experiments on the CARRADA and RADIal benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong radar-specific baselines, achieving 63.8% mIoU on CARRADA and 83.4% mIoU on RADIal, improving the previous best methods by +1.7 and +2.3 mIoU, respectively. These results highlight the importance of higher-order relational modelling for robust radar perception.
zh_title: 学习多视图雷达语义分割的结构一致性表示
translation: 雷达传感器在恶劣天气和光照条件下提供可靠的感知，但其稀疏、噪声大和语义弱的测量使密集语义分割变得具有挑战性。大多数现有雷达分割方法依赖于基于网格的编码和成对交互，这难以捕获由同一物理对象多个雷达回波形成的高阶关系结构。我们引入了一个统一的多视图雷达分割高阶结构对齐框架。所提出的方法使用可学习的超图细化雷达特征表示，以捕获空间相关响应之间的高阶依赖。为了确保异构雷达投影之间的一致性，我们进一步使用非平衡最优传输（UOT）对视图特定特征进行对齐，从而在不同测量密度和部分观测下实现无对应对齐。然后，自适应注意力机制融合互补雷达视图，同时在稀疏和噪声下强调结构信息丰富的响应。由此产生的架构学习跨距离角度（RA）、距离多普勒（RD）和角度多普勒（AD）视图的结构一致性表示，并使用监督分割以及跨视图一致性正则化进行训练。在CARRADA和RADIal基准上的实验表明，该方法比强大的雷达特定基线持续改进，在CARRADA上达到63.8% mIoU，在RADIal上达到83.4% mIoU，分别比之前最佳方法提高了+1.7和+2.3 mIoU。这些结果突出了高阶关系建模对于鲁棒雷达感知的重要性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于可学习超图和非平衡最优传输的统一高阶结构对齐框架，用于多视图雷达语义分割，以捕获高阶依赖并实现跨视图一致性，在CARRADA和RADIal基准上取得了最先进的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于引入了高阶结构对齐框架，特别是利用可学习超图来建模高阶依赖，以及通过UOT实现异构雷达视图的无对应对齐。这对于处理雷达数据固有的稀疏性和噪声问题非常重要。其在两个主流基准上的显著性能提升，表明了该方法在提升雷达语义分割鲁棒性方面的潜力。
motivation: 雷达传感器在恶劣天气和光照条件下提供可靠感知，但其稀疏、噪声大和语义弱的测量使得密集语义分割具有挑战性。现有方法难以捕获同一物理对象多个雷达回波形成的高阶关系结构。
method: 本文引入了一个统一的高阶结构对齐框架。该方法使用可学习的超图细化雷达特征表示，以捕获空间相关响应之间的高阶依赖。为确保异构雷达投影之间的一致性，使用非平衡最优传输（UOT）对视图特定特征进行对齐，实现不同测量密度和部分观测下的无对应对齐。自适应注意力机制融合互补雷达视图，在稀疏和噪声下强调结构信息丰富的响应。该架构学习跨距离角度（RA）、距离多普勒（RD）和角度多普勒（AD）视图的结构一致性表示，并使用监督分割和跨视图一致性正则化进行训练。
results: 在CARRADA和RADIal基准测试中，该方法比现有雷达特定基线取得了持续改进，在CARRADA上达到63.8% mIoU，在RADIal上达到83.4% mIoU，分别比之前最佳方法提高了+1.7和+2.3 mIoU。
conclusion: 这些结果强调了高阶关系建模对于鲁棒雷达感知的重要性。

title: Preserve the Hard, Regenerate the Rest: Uncertainty-Guided Synthetic Training Data Augmentation with Diffusion Models
authors: Nikolai Röhrich, Julian Gleißner, Ahmed H. A. Ibrahim, Silvan Mertes, Tobias Huber
abstract: Semantic segmentation models struggle with data sparsity and rare or visually diverse regions, e.g., dense regions or small objects in aerial or autonomous mobility data. While synthetic augmentation is an appealing solution, directly generating new labeled data risks misalignment of labels and generated pixels. Existing solutions to this problem often rely on external models, or employ coarse heuristics such as indiscriminately augmenting all foreground objects or entire backgrounds, which wastes capacity on uninformative pixels. To address this, we propose an uncertainty-guided synthetic context augmentation strategy that strictly preserves label validity and efficiently maximizes pixel informativeness per synthetic sample - no external guardrails required. Using a baseline segmenter's predictive entropy, we identify uncertain semantic regions and inpaint only the complementary visual context. When fine-tuning the segmenter on this synthetic data, we compute the loss only over the original pixels, excluding inpainted regions. This focuses learning on the unmodified, uncertain regions while presenting them in novel contexts. We demonstrate substantial mIoU gains on Cityscapes, UAVID, and BDD100K with the largest gains on rare and difficult classes such as buses, trains, or (from the aerial perspective) cars. Our results demonstrate that uncertainty-guided context augmentation is a highly effective lever to improve segmentation performance on complex datasets, with code provided at https://github.com/XITASO/Preserve-the-Hard-Regenerate-the-Rest.
zh_title: 保留困难部分，重新生成其余：基于不确定性引导的扩散模型合成训练数据增强
translation: 语义分割模型在数据稀疏性和罕见或视觉多样性区域（例如航空或自动驾驶数据中的密集区域或小物体）方面表现不佳。虽然合成增强是一种有吸引力的解决方案，但直接生成新的带标签数据存在标签与生成像素错位的风险。现有解决此问题的方法通常依赖于外部模型，或采用粗略的启发式方法，例如不加区分地增强所有前景对象或整个背景，这会浪费容量在无信息像素上。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种不确定性引导的合成上下文增强策略，该策略严格保持标签有效性并高效地最大化每个合成样本的像素信息量——无需外部防护措施。我们使用基线分割器的预测熵来识别不确定的语义区域，并仅修复互补的视觉上下文。在对分割器进行这种合成数据微调时，我们仅对原始像素（不包括修复区域）计算损失。这使得学习专注于未修改的、不确定区域，同时将其呈现在新颖的上下文中。我们在Cityscapes、UAVID和BDD100K上展示了显著的mIoU增益，其中在公交车、火车或（从空中视角看）汽车等稀有和困难类别上取得了最大的增益。我们的结果表明，不确定性引导的上下文增强是提高复杂数据集分割性能的有效手段，代码已在https://github.com/XITASO/Preserve-the-Hard-Regenerate-the-Rest提供。
tldr: 本文提出一种不确定性引导的合成上下文数据增强策略，通过识别不确定语义区域并仅修复互补视觉上下文，以解决语义分割模型在稀疏数据和罕见区域上的性能问题，并在Cityscapes、UAVID和BDD100K数据集上取得了显著的mIoU提升。
ai_comments: 这项工作通过引入“不确定性引导”的概念，为合成数据增强提供了一个新颖且高效的视角。它解决了现有方法中标签一致性差和信息利用率低的问题，特别是通过仅修复不确定区域的上下文并在原始像素上计算损失，巧妙地平衡了数据增强和标签准确性。这种方法避免了对整个图像进行不加区分的增强，从而提高了效率和有效性。其创新点在于将模型的不确定性作为指导，使得合成数据更具针对性，对语义分割领域的数据稀疏性问题提供了有价值的解决方案。
motivation: 语义分割模型在数据稀疏性以及罕见或视觉多样性区域（如密集区域或航空/自动驾驶数据中的小物体）上表现不佳。现有的合成数据增强方法存在标签与生成像素错位、依赖外部模型或浪费计算能力在非信息像素上的问题。
method: 提出一种不确定性引导的合成上下文增强策略。该方法通过基线分割器的预测熵来识别不确定的语义区域，并仅对互补的视觉上下文进行图像修复。在对分割器进行微调时，仅对原始像素（不包括修复区域）计算损失，从而使学习集中在未修改的、不确定区域，同时将其呈现在新颖的上下文中。该方法无需外部模型。
results: 在Cityscapes、UAVID和BDD100K数据集上实现了显著的mIoU增益，尤其是在公交车、火车或（从空中视角看）汽车等稀有和困难类别上取得了最大的提升。
conclusion: 不确定性引导的上下文增强是提高复杂数据集上分割性能的一种高效方法。

title: CLExEval: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for Qualitative Evaluation of LLM Clinical Reasoning
authors: Ajmal M., Abin Roy, Afthab Salam Kanniyan, Jawadh Abdul Kabeer, Jerin James, Preslav Nakov, Zhuohan Xie
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong results on many medical benchmarks, but their clinical reasoning remains difficult to evaluate reliably. A central risk is an evaluation illusion: fluent and well-structured explanations can appear clinically convincing even when the final diagnosis is incorrect. We introduce CLExEval, a human-in-the-loop framework for evaluating LLM clinical reasoning under progressive information masking. CLExEval combines 5,600 expert-physician annotations with 200 clinical reasoning traces derived from 40 rare diagnostic cases. Our analysis identifies three recurring failure patterns: (i) verbosity bias, where GPT-4o-mini's diagnostic accuracy drops from 95.0% to 32.5% under information scarcity; (ii) a hidden knowledge paradox, where a specialist model reaches 92.5% maximum diagnostic potential but fails to retrieve that knowledge reliably in verbose contexts; and (iii) a 68.6% reasoning-to-output mismatch, where correct diagnoses appear in reasoning traces but are not reflected in final answers. We further evaluate the LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm on a human-verified failure set (n = 142). GPT-4o-mini approved 47.9% of clinically incorrect outputs, while HuatuoGPT-o1 approved all validly scored failures and showed a positive self-preference bias. These results suggest that standalone automated clinical evaluations can substantially overestimate clinical reliability without expert-grounded validation.
zh_title: CLExEval：一个用于定性评估大型语言模型临床推理的人机交互框架
translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在许多医学基准测试中取得了显著成果，但其临床推理能力仍然难以可靠评估。一个核心风险是评估错觉：即使最终诊断不正确，流畅且结构良好的解释也可能显得具有临床说服力。我们引入了CLExEval，这是一个在渐进式信息掩蔽下评估LLM临床推理的人机交互框架。CLExEval结合了5600条专家医师注释和来自40个罕见诊断病例的200条临床推理轨迹。我们的分析识别出三种反复出现的失败模式：（i）冗余偏差，即GPT-4o-mini在信息稀缺时诊断准确率从95.0%下降到32.5%；（ii）隐藏知识悖论，即专业模型达到92.5%的最大诊断潜力，但在冗余语境中未能可靠检索该知识；以及（iii）68.6%的推理-输出不匹配，即正确的诊断出现在推理轨迹中，但未反映在最终答案中。我们进一步在人工验证的失败集合（n = 142）上评估了“LLM即评委”范式。GPT-4o-mini批准了47.9%的临床不正确输出，而华佗GPT-o1批准了所有有效评分的失败案例，并表现出积极的自我偏好偏差。这些结果表明，没有专家基础验证的独立自动化临床评估可能会大幅高估临床可靠性。
tldr: CLExEval是一个人机交互框架，用于评估LLM的临床推理能力，发现LLM在信息稀缺、冗余上下文和推理-输出不匹配方面存在问题，并指出自动化评估可能高估LLM的临床可靠性。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入CLExEval框架，有效解决了LLM临床推理评估中的“评估错觉”问题。其创新之处在于结合了大量专家医师注释和罕见病例，并通过“渐进式信息掩蔽”和分析推理轨迹，揭示了LLM在临床决策中的深层缺陷，如冗余偏差和隐藏知识悖论。尤其重要的是，它批判性地评估了“LLM即评委”范式，指出其潜在的不可靠性，强调了人机协作在医疗领域评估中的关键作用。这对于推动LLM在临床应用中的安全性和可靠性具有重要意义。
motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在许多医学基准测试中取得了显著成果，但其临床推理能力仍然难以可靠评估，存在“评估错觉”风险，即流畅的解释可能掩盖错误的诊断。
method: 本文引入了CLExEval，一个在渐进式信息掩蔽下评估LLM临床推理的人机交互框架。该框架结合了5600条专家医师注释和来自40个罕见诊断病例的200条临床推理轨迹。此外，还在人工验证的失败集合（n = 142）上评估了“LLM即评委”范式。
results: 研究识别出三种常见的失败模式：(i) 冗余偏差，即GPT-4o-mini在信息稀缺时诊断准确率从95.0%降至32.5%；(ii) 隐藏知识悖论，即专业模型最大诊断潜力达到92.5%，但在冗余语境中未能可靠检索该知识；以及(iii) 68.6%的推理-输出不匹配，即正确的诊断出现在推理轨迹中但未反映在最终答案中。LLM-as-a-Judge评估显示，GPT-4o-mini批准了47.9%的临床不正确输出，而HuatuoGPT-o1批准了所有有效评分的失败案例并表现出积极的自我偏好偏差。
conclusion: 没有专家基础验证的独立自动化临床评估可能会大幅高估LLM的临床可靠性。

title: What Memory Do GUI Agents Really Need? From Passive Records to Active Task-Driving States
authors: Chen Liu, Ling Chen, Hanzhang Zhou, Xu Zhang, Quyu Kong, Panrong Tong, Wenhao Wang, Xin Yu, Steven Hoi, Yue Wang
abstract: Mobile GUI agents increasingly face long-horizon tasks that require reading, updating, and reusing task-relevant data across pages and applications. Existing memory methods treat memory largely as passive storage, where past observations are accumulated and retrieved when needed. Yet retrieving a value does not reveal its current role in the workflow. The agent must still infer from accumulated records whether the value should be used now, has already been used, or must wait for a later dependency. This implicit reconstruction becomes unreliable in long trajectories with similar fields, repeated values, distractors, and outdated states, causing repeated or missed operations. We propose Active Task Driving Memory (ATMem), which shifts GUI-agent memory from passive storage to an actively maintained execution state. ATMem maintains task-relevant information as a continually updated execution state that links each value to its role and current status, enabling action selection based on the current workflow state. We therefore introduce \textbf{STR-GRPO}, an online reinforcement learning method that learns to use ATMem selectively according to its contribution to task completion. STR-GRPO contrasts memory-on and memory-off rollouts to estimate when memory use improves execution, while memory-cost-aware reward discourages costly memory usage that does not improve execution. To evaluate whether agents can complete all in-scope work while avoiding out-of-scope actions over long-horizon execution, we build a challenging mobile benchmark. From a list of near identical entries, agents must act on every entry that satisfies the instruction and reject entries that violate its constraints.
zh_title: GUI智能体真正需要什么样的记忆？从被动记录到主动任务驱动状态
translation: 移动GUI智能体越来越多地面临长程任务，这些任务需要在不同的页面和应用程序之间读取、更新和重用任务相关的数据。现有的记忆方法在很大程度上将记忆视为被动存储，即在需要时积累和检索过去的观察结果。然而，检索一个值并不能揭示其在工作流中的当前角色。智能体仍必须从积累的记录中推断该值是现在应该使用、已经被使用，还是必须等待后续的依赖关系。在具有相似字段、重复值、干扰项和过期状态的长轨迹中，这种隐式重建变得不可靠，从而导致重复或遗漏操作。我们提出了主动任务驱动记忆（ATMem），将GUI智能体的记忆从被动存储转变为主动维护的执行状态。ATMem将任务相关信息维护为一个持续更新的执行状态，该状态将每个值与其角色和当前状态联系起来，从而能够根据当前的工作流状态进行动作选择。因此，我们引入了STR-GRPO，这是一种在线强化学习方法，它学习根据ATMem对任务完成的贡献来选择性地使用它。STR-GRPO对比了开启记忆和关闭记忆的rollout，以估计何时使用记忆可以改善执行，同时感知记忆成本的奖励可以阻止无法改善执行的高成本记忆使用。为了评估智能体是否能在长程执行中完成所有范围内的工作，同时避免范围外的动作，我们构建了一个具有挑战性的移动端基准测试。智能体必须从一系列几乎相同的条目中，对满足指令的每个条目采取行动，并拒绝违反其约束的条目。
tldr: 本文提出了主动任务驱动记忆（ATMem）和在线强化学习方法STR-GRPO，将GUI智能体的记忆从被动存储转变为主动维护的执行状态，从而显著提升了长程任务中动作选择的准确性。
ai_comments: 该论文切中了当前GUI智能体在处理长程、多步骤任务时的核心痛点——“记忆的被动性”。提出将记忆重构为主动的、带有状态标记的工作流执行状态，是一个非常新颖且符合直觉的思路。结合STR-GRPO强化学习算法来平衡记忆开销与任务收益，设计十分巧妙。局限性在于摘要中未给出具体的量化实验指标，其在真实复杂场景下的泛化能力和实际计算开销仍有待在正文中进一步确认。
motivation: 现有的GUI智能体记忆方法主要将记忆视为被动的存储，智能体必须在长轨迹、相似字段和过期状态中隐式推断数据的当前角色，这容易导致重复或遗漏操作。因此，需要一种能够主动维护任务执行状态的记忆机制。
method: 提出了主动任务驱动记忆（ATMem），将任务相关信息维护为持续更新的执行状态，把每个值与其角色和当前状态联系起来。同时，引入了在线强化学习方法STR-GRPO，通过对比开启和关闭记忆的rollout来估算记忆对执行的改善程度，并利用感知记忆成本的奖励来引导智能体选择性地使用记忆。
results: 构建了一个具有挑战性的移动端基准测试，要求智能体在几乎相同的条目列表中，对符合指令的条目进行操作并拒绝违反约束的条目。实验评估了智能体在长程执行中完成所有范围内工作并避免范围外操作的能力（摘要中未提及具体量化数值结果）。
conclusion: 将GUI智能体的记忆从被动记录转变为主动的任务驱动状态（ATMem），并结合STR-GRPO算法，能够使智能体在长程和复杂任务中更精准地选择动作，避免因记忆模糊导致的操作失误。

title: Robust Autonomous UAV Landing on Maritime Platforms via Multimodal Agentic AI and Active Wave Compensation
authors: Francisco S. Neves, Pedro N. Pereira, Raul D.S.G. Campilho, Andry M. Pinto
abstract: Autonomous aerial inspection of marine infrastructure is frequently compromised by stochastic sea states, introducing risks of high-kinetic impacts, post-landing toppling, and sensory occlusion. This paper proposes a decoupled, multi-vehicle landing framework synchronizing an Unmanned Surface Vehicle (USV) equipped with a 3-RPU stabilized platform with a robust Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV). The architecture utilizes two independent Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) agents: a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) agent providing high-frequency wave-motion compensation for the landing deck, and a multimodal RL agent for the UAVs final approach. Evaluated in high-fidelity maritime simulations, the system achieved a 100% landing success rate across 15 trials in wave states varying from calm to rough. Results show a mean stabilization efficacy of 87.8%, maintaining the landing surface within 1 degree of the horizontal plane for 96% of the mission duration in rough conditions, effectively contributing to safer landings.
zh_title: 通过多模态智能AI和主动波浪补偿实现海上平台无人机鲁棒自主着陆
translation: 海上基础设施的自主空中检查经常受到随机海况的影响，引入高动能冲击、着陆后倾覆和传感器遮挡的风险。本文提出了一种解耦的多车辆着陆框架，同步配备3-RPU稳定平台的无人水面舰艇（USV）和鲁棒无人机（UAV）。该架构利用两个独立的深度强化学习（DRL）代理：一个软行动者-评论家（SAC）代理为着陆甲板提供高频波浪运动补偿，以及一个用于无人机最终进近的多模态强化学习代理。在高保真海上模拟中进行评估，系统在15次试验中，在从平静到波涛汹涌的海况下实现了100%的着陆成功率。结果显示平均稳定效率为87.8%，在恶劣条件下96%的任务持续时间内将着陆表面保持在水平面1度以内，有效促进了更安全的着陆。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种解耦的多车辆着陆框架，结合USV上的3-RPU稳定平台和鲁棒UAV，通过两个独立的深度强化学习代理实现，在海上模拟中在不同海况下实现了100%的着陆成功率和87.8%的平均稳定效率。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于结合了USV上的主动稳定平台和UAV上的多模态AI，通过解耦的DRL代理实现复杂的动态补偿和精确着陆。其在高保真模拟中展现的100%成功率和高稳定性效率证明了该方法在解决海上无人机着陆难题方面的巨大潜力，对于海洋基础设施检查等应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 海上基础设施的自主空中检查经常受到随机海况的影响，导致高动能冲击、着陆后倾覆和传感器遮挡的风险。
method: 本文提出了一种解耦的多车辆着陆框架，同步配备3-RPU稳定平台的无人水面舰艇（USV）和鲁棒无人机（UAV）。该架构利用两个独立的深度强化学习（DRL）代理：一个软行动者-评论家（SAC）代理为着陆甲板提供高频波浪运动补偿，以及一个用于无人机最终进近的多模态强化学习代理。
results: 在高保真海上模拟中进行评估，系统在15次试验中，在从平静到波涛汹涌的海况下实现了100%的着陆成功率。结果显示平均稳定效率为87.8%，在恶劣条件下96%的任务持续时间内将着陆表面保持在水平面1度以内。
conclusion: 该系统通过多模态智能AI和主动波浪补偿，显著提高了无人机在海上平台着陆的鲁棒性和安全性，在高动态海洋环境中展现出卓越的性能和稳定性。

title: Automating Cause-Effect Specification with Knowledge Graphs and Large Language Models
authors: Javal Vyas, Milapji Singh Gill, Mehmet Mercangöz
abstract: Engineering specifications such as interlocks, alarm rationalization tables, and cause-and-effect (C&E) matrices remain central to process control and safety, yet their creation is still predominantly manual, document-driven, and prone to inconsistency. This paper presents a semantic-AI framework that automates the generation of C&E logic by combining a knowledge graph (KG) with a constrained large language model (LLM) layer. The KG builds on an established modular alignment ontology to represent process structure, operating modes, faults, symptoms, causes, and mitigation actions in a machine-interpretable form. The LLM then transforms this information into operator-ready safety narratives and Semantic Web Rule Language (SWRL) rules under strict ontology and vocabulary constraints, grounding the generated artifacts in the underlying semantic model. The workflow is demonstrated on a modular process plant, showing how engineering semantics, diagnostic relations, and machine-verifiable specifications can be generated from a unified knowledge representation with reduced manual effort.
zh_title: 使用知识图谱和大型语言模型自动化因果规范
translation: 工程规范，例如联锁、警报合理化表和因果 (C&E) 矩阵，在过程控制和安全中仍然至关重要，但它们的创建仍然主要依赖人工、文档驱动且容易出现不一致。本文提出一个语义AI框架，通过结合知识图谱 (KG) 和受约束的大型语言模型 (LLM) 层来自动化因果逻辑的生成。知识图谱建立在已建立的模块化对齐本体论之上，以机器可解释的形式表示过程结构、操作模式、故障、症状、原因和缓解措施。然后，大型语言模型在严格的本体论和词汇约束下，将这些信息转换为操作员就绪的安全叙述和语义网络规则语言 (SWRL) 规则，将生成的工件建立在底层的语义模型中。该工作流在一个模块化流程工厂中得到演示，展示了如何从统一的知识表示中以减少人工工作的方式生成工程语义、诊断关系和机器可验证的规范。
tldr: 本文提出一个结合知识图谱和受约束大型语言模型的语义AI框架，以自动化生成过程控制和安全中的因果逻辑，减少人工工作并提高一致性。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过结合知识图谱的结构化知识表示能力和大型语言模型的文本生成与转换能力，为自动化复杂的工程规范（如因果矩阵）提供了一个创新方案。其关键在于利用LLM的语义理解和生成能力，同时通过KG和本体论施加严格的约束，确保生成内容的准确性和机器可验证性，有效解决了传统手动创建过程中的低效和不一致问题。
motivation: 工程规范（如因果矩阵）的创建目前仍主要依赖人工、文档驱动且易于出现不一致性，这对于过程控制和安全至关重要。
method: 本文提出了一个语义AI框架，它结合了知识图谱（KG）与受约束的大型语言模型（LLM）层。KG基于模块化对齐本体论来表示过程结构、操作模式、故障、症状、原因和缓解措施。LLM将KG信息转换为操作员就绪的安全叙述和SWRL规则，并严格遵循本体论和词汇约束。
results: 该工作流在一个模块化流程工厂中得到验证，展示了如何从统一的知识表示中生成工程语义、诊断关系和机器可验证的规范，并显著减少了人工工作。
conclusion: 该框架能够通过结合知识图谱和受约束的大型语言模型，自动化因果逻辑的生成，从而提高工程规范的创建效率、一致性和机器可验证性。

title: Hybrid Topological Data Analysis and LSTM Networks for Enhanced Network Intrusion Detection Using CIC-IDS2017 Dataset
authors: Amar Jeet, Bhaskar Ranjan Karn, Dinesh Kumar
abstract: Network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) are crucial in cybersecurity infrastructure, needing advanced techniques to detect hostile activity in network traffic. This research introduces a hybrid approach that combines Topological Data Analysis (TDA) with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks to improve anomaly detection in network security. Our multi-layered design combines TDA's persistent homology with LSTM networks to capture topological characteristics of network traffic patterns and simulate temporal sequences. We assessed our methodology using the CIC-IDS2017 dataset, which includes over 2.8 million labelled flows, 77 network variables, and 14 attack categories that reflect modern threat landscapes such as DDoS, brute force, web attacks, penetration, and botnet activities. Integrating Betti curves and persistence diagrams with deep learning architectures enhances feature extraction performance. Our hybrid TDA+LSTM model has an AUC of 1.000 and F1-score of 1.000, with 5-fold cross-validation producing a mean AUC of 1.000 $\pm$ 0.000 and mean F1 of 0.999 $\pm$ 0.001. An ablation research demonstrates the complimentary contributions of topological (F1=0.990) and temporal characteristics (F1=1.000). Comparative research shows that the suggested strategy beats TDA+Random Forest (F1=0.994) and Isolation Forest (F1=0.835) baselines in several attack categories.
zh_title: 混合拓扑数据分析和LSTM网络在CIC-IDS2017数据集上增强网络入侵检测
translation: 网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）在网络安全基础设施中至关重要，需要先进的技术来检测网络流量中的恶意活动。本研究引入了一种混合方法，结合了拓扑数据分析（TDA）和长短期记忆（LSTM）网络，以改进网络安全中的异常检测。我们的多层设计结合了TDA的持久同源性与LSTM网络，以捕获网络流量模式的拓扑特征并模拟时间序列。我们使用CIC-IDS2017数据集评估了我们的方法，该数据集包含超过280万个标记流、77个网络变量和14种攻击类别，反映了DDoS、暴力破解、Web攻击、渗透和僵尸网络活动等现代威胁。将Betti曲线和持久图与深度学习架构集成可以增强特征提取性能。我们的混合TDA+LSTM模型在5折交叉验证下具有1.000的AUC和1.000的F1分数，平均AUC为1.000 $\pm$ 0.000，平均F1为0.999 $\pm$ 0.001。消融研究证明了拓扑（F1=0.990）和时间特征（F1=1.000）的互补贡献。比较研究表明，所提出的策略在多个攻击类别中优于TDA+随机森林（F1=0.994）和隔离森林（F1=0.835）基线。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种结合拓扑数据分析（TDA）和长短期记忆（LSTM）网络的混合方法，用于增强网络入侵检测。该模型在CIC-IDS2017数据集上表现出色，AUC和F1分数均接近1.000，优于现有基线。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于将拓扑数据分析（TDA）与深度学习模型LSTM相结合，有效利用了网络流量的拓扑和时间双重特性。在CIC-IDS2017数据集上取得的近乎完美的性能（AUC和F1分数均为1.000）非常引人注目，表明该方法在处理复杂网络入侵方面具有巨大潜力。消融研究也很好地证明了TDA和LSTM各自的贡献。未来的工作可以探索该模型在更大数据集或实时环境中的泛化能力和计算效率。
motivation: 网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）在网络安全基础设施中至关重要，需要先进的技术来检测网络流量中的恶意活动。
method: 本研究提出了一种结合拓扑数据分析（TDA）和长短期记忆（LSTM）网络的混合方法。多层设计结合了TDA的持久同源性与LSTM网络，以捕获网络流量模式的拓扑特征并模拟时间序列。通过将Betti曲线和持久图与深度学习架构集成，增强了特征提取性能。
results: 该方法在包含280多万个标记流、77个网络变量和14种攻击类别的CIC-IDS2017数据集上进行了评估。混合TDA+LSTM模型取得了1.000的AUC和1.000的F1分数，5折交叉验证的平均AUC为1.000 $\pm$ 0.000，平均F1为0.999 $\pm$ 0.001。消融研究表明拓扑（F1=0.990）和时间特征（F1=1.000）有互补贡献。与TDA+随机森林（F1=0.994）和隔离森林（F1=0.835）基线相比，该策略在多个攻击类别中表现更优。
conclusion: 结合拓扑数据分析（TDA）和长短期记忆（LSTM）网络的混合方法显著增强了网络入侵检测能力，在CIC-IDS2017数据集上取得了卓越的性能，并优于现有基线。

title: PrISM-IQA: Image Quality Assessment Made Practical for Smartphone Photography
authors: Shuyan Zhai, Jiaqi He, Weixia Zhang, Liang Wang, Zhenjie Lee, Zufeng Zhang, Kede Ma
abstract: Existing smartphone image quality assessment (IQA) methods commonly reduce perceptual quality to a single score. However, this scalar formulation is poorly aligned with practical image signal processor (ISP) tuning, where engineers must identify specific quality issues, estimate their severities, and determine whether they are acceptable or require intervention. In this work, we introduce a Practical ISP-aware Structured Model for IQA (PrISM-IQA), which reformulates smartphone IQA as a multi-issue ordinal diagnosis problem. Rather than regressing a single quality score, PrISM-IQA predicts an \textit{ordered} severity level -- absent, minor, severe, or critical -- for each ISP-relevant issue, covering both global image-level artifacts and local content-dependent defects. To produce logically consistent predictions, PrISM-IQA combines cumulative ordinal encoding with structured inference that captures within-issue monotonicity as well as cross-issue subsumption and exclusion relations. We evaluate PrISM-IQA on a reconstructed SPAQ benchmark annotated with $53$ ISP-relevant quality issues and on a small-scale expert-annotated real-world dataset. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of PrISM-IQA for practical issue-level diagnosis, reveal transferable perceptual quality representations through linear probing, and further show how its predictions can support actionable and meaningful ISP tuning.
zh_title: PrISM-IQA：让智能手机摄影的图像质量评估更具实用性
translation: 现有的智能手机图像质量评估（IQA）方法通常将感知质量简化为一个单一分数。然而，这种标量公式与实际的图像信号处理器（ISP）调优并不匹配，因为工程师需要识别特定的质量问题、评估其严重程度，并确定这些问题是可接受的还是需要干预。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种用于IQA的实用ISP感知结构化模型（PrISM-IQA），它将智能手机IQA重新定义为多问题序数诊断问题。PrISM-IQA不进行单一质量分数的回归，而是为每个与ISP相关的问题（涵盖全局图像级伪影和局部内容相关缺陷）预测一个“有序”的严重程度等级——缺失、轻微、严重或关键。为了产生逻辑一致的预测，PrISM-IQA将累积序数编码与结构化推理相结合，捕捉问题内部的单调性以及问题间的包含和互斥关系。我们在一个包含53个ISP相关质量问题的重构SPAQ基准测试和一个小规模专家标注的真实世界数据集上评估了PrISM-IQA。实验结果证明了PrISM-IQA在实际问题级诊断中的有效性，揭示了通过线性探测实现的可迁移感知质量表示，并进一步展示了其预测如何支持可操作且有意义的ISP调优。
tldr: PrISM-IQA将图像质量评估从单一评分转变为多维度的具体问题诊断，帮助ISP工程师精准识别并解决图像质量问题。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将图像质量评估从单一评分任务转变为多问题诊断任务，更贴近ISP工程师的实际工程需求。它通过引入顺序编码和结构化推理，解决了质量评估中各问题间的逻辑关联性问题，具有很高的实用价值和可解释性。
motivation: 现有的智能手机IQA方法通常只输出一个单一质量分数，这无法满足ISP工程师在实际调优中识别具体质量问题、评估严重程度并决定是否需要干预的需求。
method: 提出PrISM-IQA模型，将IQA重构为多问题序数诊断问题；采用累积序数编码（cumulative ordinal encoding）预测每个问题的严重程度（缺失、轻微、严重、关键），并结合结构化推理来处理问题间的单调性、包含和互斥关系。
results: 在重构的SPAQ基准测试和专家标注的真实数据集上，PrISM-IQA展现了出色的问题级诊断能力，验证了其学习到的表征具有可迁移性，并能有效支持实际的ISP调优工作。
conclusion: PrISM-IQA成功地将智能手机IQA转变为一种可操作、可解释的问题诊断工具，不仅提升了评估的准确性，还为ISP调优提供了直接的指导。

title: Scientific Explanations in Health Sciences: Causality, Trust, and Epistemic Adequacy
authors: Martina Mattioli, Marcello Pelillo
abstract: Medical Artificial Intelligence (AI) is widely expected to transform clinical practice, yet the decision-making processes of many Machine Learning (ML) models remain opaque. Explainability has been advanced as a partial remedy to clarify why AI generates predictions, particularly in high-stakes contexts. Despite ongoing efforts, debates on what constitutes an adequate medical explanation remain unsettled. Yet, explanation has long been a central topic of inquiry in the philosophy of science and medicine. The insights developed in these fields, however, have been largely overlooked in contemporary explainable AI (XAI) research, leaving its foundational assumptions insufficiently examined. To address this gap, this paper develops a critical review at the intersection of philosophy of science and XAI. It examines prevailing accounts of what counts as an explanation in the health sciences and assesses their adequacy for informing XAI in medicine, arguing that they provide necessary conditions for a philosophically grounded approach to explainability in this domain. Building on this foundational philosophical literature, the discussion identifies three central axes of analysis: the role of causality in medical reasoning, the epistemic and relational dimensions of medical trust, and the criteria of explanatory adequacy as shaped by the pragmatic needs of diverse stakeholders. By integrating philosophical analysis with current developments in medical AI, the paper outlines principles for designing XAI systems that offer explanations that are not only epistemically robust but also aligned with the epistemic and practical requirements of clinical decision-making, shaping ongoing debates in medical XAI toward underexplored conceptual foundations.
zh_title: 医疗科学中的科学解释：因果关系、信任和认识论充分性
translation: 医疗人工智能（AI）有望彻底改变临床实践，但许多机器学习（ML）模型的决策过程仍然不透明。可解释性被认为是澄清AI为何生成预测的部分解决方案，尤其是在高风险环境中。尽管付出了持续的努力，但关于什么构成充分的医学解释的争论仍未解决。然而，解释长期以来一直是科学和医学哲学研究的中心主题。但这些领域发展的见解在当代可解释AI（XAI）研究中在很大程度上被忽视了，导致其基础假设未得到充分审视。为解决这一差距，本文在科学哲学和XAI的交叉领域进行了批判性回顾。它考察了医疗科学中对解释的普遍看法，并评估了它们在指导医学XAI方面的充分性，认为它们为该领域的可解释性提供了哲学基础的必要条件。在这一基础哲学文献的基础上，讨论确定了三个核心分析轴：因果关系在医学推理中的作用，医学信任的认识论和关系维度，以及由不同利益相关者的实际需求塑造的解释充分性标准。通过将哲学分析与医学AI的最新发展相结合，本文概述了设计XAI系统的原则，这些系统提供的解释不仅具有认识论上的稳健性，而且符合临床决策的认识论和实践要求，从而将医学XAI的持续辩论引向了探索不足的概念基础。
tldr: 该论文探讨了在医疗人工智能（AI）领域，如何为不透明的机器学习模型提供充分的解释。它结合了科学哲学和可解释人工智能（XAI）的见解，重点关注因果关系、信任和解释的充分性，旨在为设计符合临床决策需求的XAI系统提供原则。
ai_comments: 该论文在科学哲学和可解释AI（XAI）之间建立了重要的桥梁，尤其是在医疗领域。它敏锐地指出了当前XAI研究中对哲学基础的忽视，并提出了一个强有力的框架来解决这个问题。论文强调的因果关系、信任和解释充分性是构建可靠和可信赖的医疗AI系统的关键要素。然而，将这些哲学概念转化为实际可操作的XAI算法和评估指标可能是一个挑战，这或许是未来研究可以进一步探索的方向。
motivation: 当前医疗AI的机器学习模型决策过程不透明，尽管可解释性被认为是部分解决方案，但关于什么是充分的医学解释仍存在争议。科学哲学和医学领域的现有见解在当代可解释AI研究中未得到充分利用，导致其基础假设未被充分审视。该论文旨在弥合这一差距。
method: 通过对科学哲学和可解释AI（XAI）交叉领域的批判性回顾，审视了医疗科学中对解释的普遍看法，并评估了其在医学XAI中的充分性。论文整合了哲学分析和当前的医学AI发展，重点分析了因果关系、信任的认识论和关系维度以及解释充分性的标准。
results: 该论文提出了一个基于哲学文献的框架，强调了因果关系、信任和解释充分性在医学XAI中的重要性。它为设计不仅具有认识论上的稳健性，而且符合临床决策认识论和实践需求的XAI系统提供了原则。
conclusion: 该论文认为，将科学哲学中的因果关系、信任和解释充分性等概念应用于医学XAI，可以为该领域提供一个有哲学基础的方法，并指导XAI系统设计，使其解释既符合认识论要求，又能满足临床实践的需求。

title: V-Line Tensor Tomography in a Disk: Theoretical and Numerical Reconstruction
authors: Rahul Bhardwaj, Madhu Gupta
abstract: In this article, we investigate V-line transforms for symmetric $m$-tensor fields whose support lies inside a disk of radius $R$ and centered at the origin. We provide an explicit characterization of the kernel of the V-line transforms acting on a symmetric $m$-tensor field and derive a new inversion formula using a decomposition result. In addition, we present a comprehensive numerical verification and validation of the inversion algorithms for these V-line transforms for vector fields and symmetric $2$-tensor fields, which were recently developed in \cite{bhardwaj_2024,bhardwaj2025tensor}. The reconstruction results obtained for various phantoms demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed numerical methods, including in the presence of noise.
zh_title: 圆盘中的V线张量断层扫描：理论与数值重建
translation: 在本文中，我们研究了对称m阶张量场的V线变换，这些张量场的支撑位于半径为R且以原点为中心的圆盘内。我们提供了作用于对称m阶张量场的V线变换核的显式表征，并利用分解结果推导出了一个新的反演公式。此外，我们对向量场和对称2阶张量场的V线变换反演算法进行了全面的数值验证和确认，这些算法最近在\[bhardwaj_2024,bhardwaj2025tensor\]中开发。针对各种模型的重建结果表明，所提出的数值方法有效且鲁棒，包括在存在噪声的情况下。
tldr: 本文研究了圆盘内对称m阶张量场的V线变换，提供了核的显式表征，推导了新的反演公式，并对向量场和对称2阶张量场的反演算法进行了数值验证，结果表明所提出的数值方法有效且鲁棒，即使在存在噪声的情况下。
ai_comments: 该论文通过表征V线变换并提供新的反演公式，对张量断层扫描领域做出了贡献。数值验证突出了这些方法的实际适用性和鲁棒性，特别是它们处理噪声的能力，这对于实际应用至关重要。
motivation: 研究对称m阶张量场的V线变换，并推导新的反演公式。此外，对已有的向量场和对称2阶张量场的V线变换反演算法进行全面的数值验证和确认。
method: 研究了对称m阶张量场的V线变换，显式表征了V线变换核，利用分解结果推导了一个新的反演公式。此外，对向量场和对称2阶张量场的V线变换反演算法进行了全面的数值验证和确认。
results: 提供了作用于对称m阶张量场的V线变换核的显式表征，并推导了一个新的反演公式。针对各种模型的重建结果表明，所提出的数值方法有效且鲁棒，包括在存在噪声的情况下。
conclusion: 本文推导的反演公式以及验证的数值方法对于圆盘中的V线张量断层扫描是有效和鲁棒的，即使在存在噪声的情况下也是如此。

title: Calibration, Not Compilation: Detecting and Repairing Misspecified Probabilistic Programs Written by Language Models
authors: Jian Xu, Delu Zeng, John Paisley, Qibin Zhao
abstract: Language models increasingly write probabilistic programs (in NumPyro, Stan, or Pyro), but a program that compiles, runs, and passes every unit test can still be \emph{statistically} wrong -- a Gaussian likelihood for heavy-tailed data, a Poisson for over-dispersed counts, an invalid prior support, or a pathological parameterization. The right verifier is therefore not a test suite but the Bayesian workflow itself: posterior predictive checks, simulation-based calibration, sampler diagnostics ($\hat R$, divergences, ESS), and held-out predictive density. We study this calibration oracle along three axes. \textbf{Detection:} on a benchmark of $14$ misspecification types across $10$ model families ($200$ instances), it flags the bug with AUC $0.97$ ($88\%$ at $2\%$ FPR \emph{when handed the correct reference program, an upper bound}) -- and a fully \emph{reference-free} version that uses no correct program reaches $62$--$78\%$ (the upper figure from a small automated model search), versus $0\%$ for a unit-test oracle. \textbf{Repair:} used as feedback in an LLM repair loop across fifteen models, calibration significantly outperforms unit-test feedback -- which is itself \emph{significantly worse than no feedback at all}, a passing test inducing false confidence that suppresses repair -- and improves over no feedback on strong-but-unsaturated models (GPT-5.1 $33{\to}92\%$, Claude $75{\to}100\%$; paired McNemar, $n{=}228$). \textbf{Reality:} on programs LLMs write from scratch for neutral briefs, $15$--$47\%$ of runnable ones are statistically misspecified (unit tests catch none), and calibration-guided repair significantly beats LLM-as-judge review, a Bayesian-workflow checklist, and data-summary self-debug. Across all three, the lesson is the same: for probabilistic programs, correctness is calibration, not compilation.
zh_title: 校准而非编译：检测与修复大型语言模型编写的错误概率程序
translation: 大型语言模型越来越多地编写概率程序（如NumPyro, Stan, 或 Pyro），但一个能编译、运行并通过所有单元测试的程序在统计上仍可能是错误的——例如针对重尾数据的正态似然、针对过度离散计数数据的泊松分布、无效的先验支持或病态的参数化。因此，正确的验证器不是测试套件，而是贝叶斯工作流本身：后验预测检查、基于仿真的校准、采样器诊断（$\hat R$, 发散, ESS）以及保留的预测密度。我们从三个维度研究了这个校准预言机。检测：在一个涵盖10个模型家族中14种错误类型的基准测试（200个实例）上，它以0.97的AUC标记出错误（在给定正确参考程序的情况下，2%误报率下准确率为88%）——而一个完全无需参考程序的版本达到了62-78%（上限数字来自小型自动模型搜索），相比之下单元测试预言机为0%。修复：在15个模型的LLM修复循环中用作反馈时，校准显著优于单元测试反馈——单元测试反馈本身甚至比完全没有反馈更差，因为通过的测试会诱导虚假的信心从而抑制修复——并且在强但未饱和的模型上优于无反馈（GPT-5.1从33%提升至92%，Claude从75%提升至100%；配对McNemar检验，n=228）。现实：在LLM为中性简报从零开始编写的程序中，15-47%的可运行程序在统计上是错误的（单元测试无法捕获任何错误），并且校准引导的修复显著优于“LLM作为裁判”的审查、贝叶斯工作流检查清单和数据摘要自调试。在所有三个维度上，教训是一样的：对于概率程序，正确性在于校准，而不是编译。
tldr: 大型语言模型编写的概率程序即便能通过编译，也常存在统计错误；本文提出利用贝叶斯校准指标作为反馈来检测和修复这些错误，效果远胜于传统单元测试。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一个深刻的观点：对于概率编程而言，“代码能运行”（编译通过）并不等同于“逻辑正确”（统计校准）。作者通过引入贝叶斯工作流中的校准指标作为反馈机制，成功解决了大型语言模型在生成概率程序时常见的统计错误，这在概率编程自动化领域具有重要的实用价值和方法论意义。
motivation: 大型语言模型生成的概率程序即使通过了编译和单元测试，仍可能存在严重的统计错误（如分布选择错误或参数化错误），传统的测试方法无法检测这些隐含的统计失效。
method: 提出了一种基于贝叶斯工作流（如后验预测检查、仿真校准、采样器诊断等）的“校准预言机”方法，用于检测和修复LLM生成的概率程序中的统计错误，并将其作为反馈循环引导LLM进行修复。
results: 在检测任务中，参考版本AUC达到0.97，参考自由版本达到62-78%；在修复任务中，校准反馈显著优于单元测试反馈及无反馈，且在真实场景中能有效识别并修复15-47%的统计错误程序。
conclusion: 对于概率程序，正确性在于统计校准而非简单的编译通过。使用基于校准的反馈机制能显著提高LLM修复概率程序的能力，远胜于传统的单元测试。

title: A Tutorial on Autonomous Fault-Tolerant Control Using Knowledge-Grounded LLM Agents
authors: Javal Vyas, Milapji Singh Gill, Artan Markaj, Felix Gehlhoff, Mehmet Mercangöz
abstract: Fault recovery in process plants still relies heavily on plant operators, especially when faults fall outside predefined supervisory logic. Operators interpret alarms, procedures, P\&IDs, interlocks, and process trends, then decide how to move the plant to a safe operating mode without triggering a shutdown. This paper examines how Large Language Model (LLM) agents can support such recovery decisions. The proposed framework treats the LLM as a constrained supervisory planner. It uses plant-specific knowledge to propose recovery actions, and every proposal is checked by an external validator (symbolic or simulation-based) before actuation. The paper develops three design dimensions for applying the framework: the recovery patterns for which LLM agents are useful, the validation strategies that separate admissible from inadmissible proposals, and the deployment constraints imposed by latency, knowledge engineering, safety integration, and model lifecycle management. To make the framework directly usable, two openly available executable Python environments are provided. Both re-implement established case studies, a modular mixing module and a continuous stirred-tank reactor, extended with configurable faults and defined interfaces for custom recovery and validation methods.
zh_title: 自主容错控制的知识引导大模型智能体教程
translation: 过程工厂的故障恢复仍然严重依赖工厂操作员，特别是当故障超出预定义的监管逻辑时。操作员解读警报、程序、P&IDs、联锁和过程趋势，然后决定如何在不触发停机的情况下将工厂转移到安全运行模式。本文探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）智能体如何支持此类恢复决策。提出的框架将LLM视为一个受约束的监管规划器。它利用工厂特定知识提出恢复动作，并且每个提议在执行前都由外部验证器（基于符号或仿真）进行检查。本文开发了应用于该框架的三个设计维度：LLM智能体适用的恢复模式，区分可接受和不可接受提议的验证策略，以及由延迟、知识工程、安全集成和模型生命周期管理带来的部署约束。为了使该框架可以直接使用，提供了两个公开可用的可执行Python环境。两者都重新实现了已建立的案例研究——一个模块化混合模块和一个连续搅拌反应器，并增加了可配置故障和用于自定义恢复及验证方法的接口。
tldr: 利用大模型智能体（LLM agents）辅助过程工厂在超出预定义逻辑的故障下进行恢复，通过外部验证器确保恢复动作的安全性和有效性，并探讨了设计维度和部署约束。
ai_comments: 该研究将LLM应用于过程控制领域的故障恢复，具有重要的实际意义。通过外部验证器来保证LLM决策的安全性是一个关键的创新点。然而，对于LLM在处理复杂、非预期故障时的鲁棒性和泛化能力，以及验证器在不同场景下的效率和准确性，仍需进一步研究。模型生命周期管理和安全集成方面的部署约束也值得关注。
motivation: 过程工厂在应对超出预定义逻辑的故障时，仍严重依赖人工操作员的决策，需要一种更智能的支持方式。
method: 将大模型（LLM）视为受约束的监督规划器，利用工厂特定知识提出恢复动作，并由外部验证器（符号或基于仿真的）进行校验后执行。探讨了恢复模式、验证策略和部署约束（延迟、知识工程、安全集成、模型生命周期管理）。
results: 提出了一个框架，并提供了两个可执行的Python环境，重现了模块化混合模块和连续搅拌反应器案例研究，并增加了可配置故障和自定义恢复/验证接口。
conclusion: 大模型智能体（LLM agents）能够支持超出预定义逻辑的故障恢复决策，通过外部验证器可以确保恢复动作的安全性和有效性。框架的设计维度和部署约束为实际应用提供了指导。

title: Intrinsic decomposition and editing of 3D Gaussian splats
authors: Alexandre Lanvin, Jeffrey Hu, Simon Lucas, Adrien Bousseau, George Drettakis
abstract: Intrinsic decomposition which expresses image colors as the product of diffuse albedo and shading, possibly augmented with view-dependent residuals has a long history in image editing as it enables the modification of object colors and textures without altering lighting. We extend intrinsic decomposition to radiance fields represented with Gaussian splatting by proposing solutions to three key aspects of such decomposition. First, we describe how to model the intrinsic decomposition as independent sets of Gaussian primitives, which allows each set to adapt to the characteristics of the layer it represents. Second, we present an optimization procedure guided by data-driven predictions to disentangle multi-view photographs of a scene into the aforementioned intrinsic sets. Finally, we provide an editing workflow where users modify the texture of planar surfaces simply by modifying the albedo of that surface in one image. Capturing this edit within the intrinsic radiance field allows re-rendering of the edited scene with plausible lighting under arbitrary viewpoints.
zh_title: 三维高斯泼溅的内禀分解与编辑
translation: 内禀分解（将图像颜色分解为漫反射反照率和阴影的乘积，可能还包含视点相关的残差）在图像编辑中有着悠久的历史，因为它可以在不改变光照的情况下修改物体颜色和纹理。我们将内禀分解扩展到使用高斯泼溅表示的辐射场，并针对此类分解的三个关键方面提出了解决方案。首先，我们描述了如何将内禀分解建模为独立的高斯图元集，这使得每个集合能够适应其代表的层的特征。其次，我们提出了一种由数据驱动的预测引导的优化程序，将场景的多视图照片分解为上述的内禀集。最后，我们提供了一种编辑工作流，用户可以通过修改一张图像中平面表面的反照率来修改纹理。将此编辑效果保存在内禀辐射场中，可以实现在任意视点下使用合理的光照重新渲染编辑后的场景。
tldr: 该研究将内禀分解扩展到三维高斯泼溅表示的辐射场，通过建模、优化和编辑工作流，实现了对场景纹理的编辑，并能在任意视点下重新渲染具有合理光照的编辑后场景。
ai_comments: 该研究巧妙地将内禀分解的概念与新兴的三维高斯泼溅技术相结合，为辐射场的编辑开辟了新的可能性。通过将分解建模为独立的高斯图元集和引入数据驱动的优化，该方法在解耦场景的内在属性方面取得了显著进展。其提供的编辑工作流直观易用，能够实现对场景纹理的精确控制，并在任意视点下保持光照一致性，这在虚拟现实、增强现实和内容创作等领域具有重要的应用潜力。然而，对于复杂非平面表面的编辑效果以及分解的鲁棒性仍有待进一步探索。
motivation: 在图像编辑领域，内禀分解（将图像颜色分解为漫反射反照率和阴影的乘积）具有悠久的历史，因为它可以在不改变光照的情况下修改物体颜色和纹理。本研究旨在将内禀分解的概念扩展到使用高斯泼溅表示的辐射场。
method: 1. 将内禀分解建模为独立的高斯图元集，使每个集合能够适应其代表层的特征。2. 提出一种由数据驱动的预测引导的优化程序，将场景的多视图照片分解为上述内禀集。3. 提供一种编辑工作流，用户可以通过修改一张图像中平面表面的反照率来编辑纹理，并将编辑效果保存在内禀辐射场中，从而在任意视点下重新渲染具有合理光照的编辑后场景。
results: 成功地将内禀分解扩展到三维高斯泼溅表示的辐射场，并实现了一个编辑工作流，允许用户通过修改反照率来编辑平面表面的纹理，并在任意视点下重新渲染。
conclusion: 本研究成功地将内禀分解扩展到了三维高斯泼溅表示的辐射场，并提出了一种新的编辑方法，能够实现对场景纹理的解耦编辑，并在任意视点下进行逼真渲染。

title: A Lifecycle and Application-Stack Survey of Large Language Model Vulnerabilities: Attacks, Risks, Defenses, and Open Problems
authors: Seyed Bagher Hashemi Natanzi, Bo Tang
abstract: Large language models are no longer only text generators. They are increasingly embedded in retrieval pipelines, enterprise assistants, coding environments, robotic systems, security-operation workflows, and autonomous agents that can read private data, call tools, write files, execute code, and act across organizational boundaries. This shift changes the security problem: risks do not arise from the model weights alone, but from the full lifecycle and application stack through which data, prompts, model outputs, tools, memories, and user authority interact. This paper systematizes the literature on vulnerabilities in large language model systems through a lifecycle and application-stack lens. We organize attacks across eight stages: data collection, pretraining, post-training alignment, model packaging and supply chain, retrieval and memory, prompting and inference, tool/agent execution, and deployment/maintenance. For each stage, we analyze attacker capabilities, affected security objectives, representative attacks, practical risks, evaluation practices, and defenses. We further map LLM-specific vulnerabilities to confidentiality, integrity, availability, safety, privacy, fairness, accountability, and agency-control objectives. Unlike taxonomies that list isolated attack names, the proposed systematization emphasizes where trust boundaries fail, how untrusted data becomes executable instruction, how delegated authority amplifies model errors, and why point defenses rarely compose. We close with a research agenda for secure LLM systems, including compositional security, provenance-aware retrieval, tool-call containment, long-horizon agent evaluation, privacy-preserving adaptation, realistic red teaming, and deployment-grade incident response.
zh_title: 大型语言模型漏洞的生命周期和应用栈调查：攻击、风险、防御和开放问题
translation: 大型语言模型不再仅仅是文本生成器。它们越来越多地嵌入到检索管道、企业助手、编码环境、机器人系统、安全操作工作流和自主代理中，这些代理可以读取私人数据、调用工具、写入文件、执行代码并跨组织边界行动。这种转变改变了安全问题：风险不再仅仅来自模型权重，而是来自数据、提示、模型输出、工具、记忆和用户权限相互作用的整个生命周期和应用栈。本文通过生命周期和应用栈的视角，系统化了大型语言模型系统中的漏洞文献。我们将攻击分为八个阶段：数据收集、预训练、后训练对齐、模型打包和供应链、检索和记忆、提示和推理、工具/代理执行以及部署/维护。对于每个阶段，我们分析了攻击者能力、受影响的安全目标、代表性攻击、实际风险、评估实践和防御措施。我们进一步将LLM特有的漏洞映射到保密性、完整性、可用性、安全性、隐私、公平性、问责制和代理控制目标。与仅列出孤立攻击名称的分类法不同，本文提出的系统化方法强调了信任边界在何处失效、不可信数据如何变为可执行指令、委托权限如何放大模型错误以及为何点防御很少能组合。最后，我们提出了一个安全LLM系统的研究议程，包括组合安全、溯源感知检索、工具调用遏制、长周期代理评估、隐私保护适应、现实红队测试和部署级事件响应。
tldr: 本文通过生命周期和应用栈视角，系统化整理了大型语言模型系统中的漏洞，涵盖攻击、风险、防御和开放问题。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于其独特的“生命周期和应用栈”视角，而非仅仅关注模型本身。它提供了一个全面的框架来理解和分类LLM系统中的各种漏洞，并强调了系统级而非点防御的重要性。对于LLM安全研究和实践者来说，这是一个非常有价值的系统化工作，为未来的研究指明了方向。
motivation: 随着大型语言模型被广泛嵌入各种应用中，安全问题不再仅限于模型权重，而是涉及数据、提示、模型输出、工具、记忆和用户权限等整个生命周期和应用栈的交互。因此，需要对LLM系统中的漏洞进行系统性分析。
method: 本文通过生命周期和应用栈的视角，系统化了大型语言模型系统漏洞的文献。将攻击组织为八个阶段（数据收集、预训练、后训练对齐、模型打包和供应链、检索和记忆、提示和推理、工具/代理执行、部署/维护），并分析每个阶段的攻击者能力、安全目标、代表性攻击、实际风险、评估实践和防御措施。此外，还将LLM特有的漏洞映射到各种安全目标。
results: 论文分析了八个阶段的攻击及其相关方面，并将LLM特有漏洞映射到保密性、完整性、可用性、安全性、隐私、公平性、问责制和代理控制目标。强调了信任边界失效、不可信数据如何变为可执行指令、委托权限如何放大模型错误以及点防御为何难以组合。
conclusion: 本文提出了一个安全LLM系统的研究议程，包括组合安全、溯源感知检索、工具调用遏制、长周期代理评估、隐私保护适应、现实红队测试和部署级事件响应。

title: Tone-Conditioned Curriculum Learning for Low-Resource Bantu Speech Recognition
authors: Kesego Mokgosi, Vukosi Marivate, Sitwala Mundia, Unarine Netshifhefhe, Tsholofelo Hope Mogale, Thapelo Sindane
abstract: Southern Bantu languages are spoken by over 80 million people, yet current foundation ASR models still produce zero-shot WER above 100%, which limits practical use in education and public services. We addressed this gap with a tone conditioned curriculum framework for 6 Southern Bantu languages that combined hybrid difficulty scoring, gated adapters driven by tonal statistics and staged curriculum training. We trained on a community corpus and tested transfer to NCHLT to measure robustness beyond matched evaluation. Results revealed clear interactions between architecture and language, with W2V-BERT outperforming Whisper on Nguni languages by 3 to 4 WER points whilst Whisper performed better on Sotho-Tswana languages. W2V-BERT with tone conditioning reached 28.41% average WER across datasets and 23.79% on Xitsonga transfer. No single model suited all 6 languages, so deployment should pair model selection per language with validation across corpora.
zh_title: 面向低资源班图语语音识别的声调条件化课程学习
translation: 南部班图语的使用人数超过8000万，但目前的基础ASR模型在这些语言上的零样本WER仍高于100%，这限制了其在教育和公共服务中的实际应用。我们提出了一种针对6种南部班图语的声调条件化课程学习框架，结合了混合难度评分、由声调统计驱动的门控适配器以及分阶段课程训练。我们在社区语料库上进行训练，并测试了向NCHLT的迁移能力以衡量模型在匹配评估之外的鲁棒性。结果显示，模型架构与语言之间存在明显的相互作用：在Nguni语言上，W2V-BERT比Whisper的WER低3到4个点，而Whisper在Sotho-Tswana语言上表现更好。带有声调条件化的W2V-BERT在数据集上的平均WER达到28.41%，在Xitsonga迁移任务上达到23.79%。由于没有单一模型适用于所有6种语言，因此部署时应根据每种语言进行模型选择，并结合跨语料库验证。
tldr: 通过引入声调条件化和课程学习策略，显著提升了低资源班图语的语音识别性能，并发现不同语言语系对模型架构的偏好存在显著差异。
ai_comments: 该研究巧妙地将声调信息（Bantu语言的重要特征）引入语音识别框架，通过课程学习策略有效提升了低资源语言的识别性能。其创新点在于针对不同语系（Nguni与Sotho-Tswana）模型表现的差异性分析，为实际部署提供了宝贵的经验指导。
motivation: 现有的基础ASR模型在南部班图语上的零样本识别性能极差（WER > 100%），无法满足教育和公共服务等实际需求。
method: 提出一种声调条件化课程学习框架，包含混合难度评分、基于声调统计的门控适配器以及分阶段课程训练策略。
results: W2V-BERT在Nguni语系上表现优于Whisper，而在Sotho-Tswana语系上Whisper表现更佳；W2V-BERT结合声调条件化在数据集上实现了28.41%的平均WER，在Xitsonga迁移任务上达到23.79%。
conclusion: 研究表明，不存在单一的通用模型，针对不同Bantu语言应采取特定的模型选择策略，并结合声调条件化课程学习以优化识别效果。

title: LiteMatch: Lightweight Zero-Shot Stereo Matching via Cost Volume Stabilization
authors: Md Raqib Khan, Santosh Kumar Vipparthi, Subrahmanyam Murala
abstract: Despite rapid progress in learning-based stereo matching, high accuracy is often achieved at the cost of heavy backbones and computationally intensive 3D cost volume processing, resulting in substantial memory and runtime overhead. More critically, these methods frequently struggle to generalize across domains, limiting their practical deployment. We present \textit{LiteMatch}, a lightweight stereo matching framework that achieves strong zero-shot generalization through cost volume stabilization-without expensive 3D convolutions. LiteMatch employs two complementary encoders: a Cross-View Correspondence Encoder (CVCE) to capture global cross-view interactions, and a High-Frequency Encoder (HFE) that enhances fine structural details via FFT-based frequency cues. To stabilize the cost volume, we introduce the \textit{Cost Volume Consistency Loss (CVC-Loss)}, a voxel-wise binary cross-entropy objective applied to softmax-normalized cost distributions. By encouraging sharp and unimodal disparity probabilities, CVC-Loss promotes stable cost distributions and enables rapid convergence. A lightweight refinement module further produces sharp full-resolution disparities with low-iteration updates, avoiding heavy recurrent refinement. With a flexible design ranging from 3.36M to 9.58M parameters, LiteMatch achieves exceptional zero-shot generalization, delivering competitive EPE and D1 performance across Scene Flow, KITTI, Middlebury, ETH3D, and DrivingStereo. Our results establish that lightweight architectures can indeed generalize across domains without sacrificing accuracy. \href{https://mdraqibkhan.github.io/Litematch}{\textcolor{blue}{Code}}
zh_title: LiteMatch：通过代价体稳定实现的轻量级零样本立体匹配
translation: 尽管基于学习的立体匹配取得了快速进展，但高精度往往以沉重的骨干网络和计算密集型3D代价体处理为代价，导致大量的内存和运行时开销。更关键的是，这些方法在跨域泛化方面常常表现不佳，限制了它们的实际部署。我们提出了LiteMatch，一个轻量级立体匹配框架，通过代价体稳定实现强大的零样本泛化，而无需昂贵的3D卷积。LiteMatch采用两个互补的编码器：交叉视图对应编码器（CVCE）用于捕捉全局交叉视图交互，以及高频编码器（HFE）通过基于FFT的频率线索增强精细结构细节。为了稳定代价体，我们引入了代价体一致性损失（CVC-Loss），这是一种应用于softmax归一化代价分布的体素级二元交叉熵目标。通过鼓励尖锐和单峰的视差概率，CVC-Loss促进了稳定的代价分布并实现了快速收敛。一个轻量级细化模块通过低迭代更新进一步产生清晰的全分辨率视差，避免了繁重的循环细化。LiteMatch具有从3.36M到9.58M参数的灵活设计，实现了卓越的零样本泛化，并在Scene Flow、KITTI、Middlebury、ETH3D和DrivingStereo上提供了有竞争力的EPE和D1性能。我们的结果表明，轻量级架构确实可以在不牺牲精度的情况下实现跨域泛化。
tldr: LiteMatch是一个轻量级立体匹配框架，通过代价体稳定和双编码器设计，实现了在不同领域间卓越的零样本泛化能力，同时保持了高精度。
ai_comments: LiteMatch的创新之处在于其轻量级设计和通过代价体稳定实现的零样本泛化能力，这解决了传统深度学习立体匹配模型在计算资源和跨域适应性上的痛点。特别是CVC-Loss的引入，有效地优化了代价分布，加速了收敛。其灵活的参数规模和在多个数据集上的优秀表现，表明了该方法在实际应用中的巨大潜力。
motivation: 现有的学习型立体匹配方法虽然精度高，但通常需要庞大的骨干网络和计算密集型3D代价体处理，导致内存和运行开销巨大，并且在跨域泛化能力上表现不佳，限制了实际部署。
method: LiteMatch是一个轻量级立体匹配框架，通过代价体稳定实现强大的零样本泛化，避免了昂贵的3D卷积。它包含两个互补编码器：交叉视图对应编码器(CVCE)用于捕捉全局交叉视图交互，高频编码器(HFE)通过基于FFT的频率线索增强精细结构细节。为稳定代价体，引入了代价体一致性损失(CVC-Loss)，这是一种应用于softmax归一化代价分布的体素级二元交叉熵目标，鼓励尖锐和单峰的视差概率，促进稳定的代价分布和快速收敛。一个轻量级细化模块通过低迭代更新生成清晰的全分辨率视差，避免了繁重的循环细化。

title: Moral Safety in LLMs: Exposing Performative Compliance with Puzzled Cues
authors: Mohammadamin Shafiei, Shuyue Stella Li, Yulia Tsvetkov
abstract: As large language models take on morally consequential roles in healthcare, legal, and hiring contexts, we need to examine whether their ethical behaviors are genuine or superficial. We show that current fairness evaluations substantially overestimate moral safety. Models appear fair when demographic identity is stated as an explicit label, yet become measurably less fair when the same identity must be inferred. We term this failure \emph{performative compliance}, where a model is fair when the presentation resembles a fairness evaluation and less fair as that cue weakens. We introduce a cue-variation methodology that holds the moral dilemma and the demographic identity fixed and varies only how that identity is conveyed. Hiding the explicit label raises harmful decisions by $+4.4$~pp and changes model safety rankings, and the shift persists when models correctly infer the demographic, ruling out attribution error. We propose the \textbf{Cue Visibility Gap}, a model-agnostic robustness metric that can be added to any existing fairness benchmark to separate genuine from performative moral safety. Fairness evaluations that omit cue variation measure surface compliance, not moral robustness, and should not ground deployment decisions in high-stakes settings.
zh_title: 大型语言模型中的道德安全：揭示其在困惑线索下的表演性合规
translation: 大型语言模型在医疗、法律和招聘等领域扮演着具有道德影响的角色，因此我们需要检验其伦理行为是真实的还是肤浅的。我们发现，当前的公平性评估大大高估了道德安全。当人口统计学身份以明确标签形式呈现时，模型显得公平；然而，当必须推断相同身份时，模型的公平性显著下降。我们将这种失败称为“表演性合规”，即当呈现方式类似于公平性评估时，模型表现出公平，而当这种线索减弱时，公平性则降低。我们引入了一种线索变异方法，该方法保持道德困境和人口统计学身份不变，仅改变身份的传达方式。隐藏明确标签使有害决策增加了4.4个百分点，并改变了模型的安全排名，即使模型正确推断出人口统计学信息，这种转变依然存在，排除了归因错误。我们提出了“线索可见性差距”（Cue Visibility Gap），这是一个与模型无关的鲁棒性指标，可以添加到任何现有的公平性基准中，以区分真实的道德安全和表演性道德安全。省略线索变异的公平性评估衡量的是表面合规而非道德鲁棒性，不应作为高风险环境下部署决策的依据。
tldr: 大型语言模型在明确的身份标签下表现出公平，但在需要推断身份时公平性显著下降，这种现象被称为“表演性合规”。研究引入了线索变异方法，并提出了“线索可见性差距”指标，以区分真正的道德安全和表面合规。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了“表演性合规”和“线索可见性差距”的概念，揭示了LLMs在道德评估中的深层问题。其方法论通过控制变量（仅改变身份传达方式）有效地分离了模型的表面公平性和内在鲁棒性，对现有公平性评估提出了重要挑战和改进方向。这对于LLMs在高风险领域的实际部署具有重要的指导意义，提醒开发者和用户不能仅仅依赖表面的公平性指标。
motivation: 大型语言模型在医疗、法律和招聘等具有道德影响的领域中扮演重要角色，因此需要检验其伦理行为是真实的还是表面的，并指出当前的公平性评估可能高估了道德安全。
method: 研究采用了一种线索变异方法，保持道德困境和人口统计学身份不变，仅改变身份的传达方式。通过隐藏明确的身份标签，观察模型决策的变化，并排除了归因错误。提出了“线索可见性差距”作为模型无关的鲁棒性度量。
results: 当人口统计学身份作为明确标签时，模型显得公平；而当必须推断相同身份时，公平性显著下降。隐藏明确标签使有害决策增加了4.4个百分点，并改变了模型的安全排名。即使模型正确推断出人口统计学信息，这种转变依然存在，排除了归因错误。
conclusion: 当前的公平性评估（如果省略线索变异）仅衡量表面合规而非道德鲁棒性，不应作为高风险部署决策的依据。提出了“线索可见性差距”作为区分真实道德安全与表演性道德安全的模型无关鲁棒性指标。

title: Technical Report of RoboSpatial Challenge at CVPR 2026: Selective Reasoning Activation and Reference-Frame Disambiguation for Embodied Spatial Reasoning
authors: Yuxiang Xie, Qi Lv, Jianming Xing, Zijian Hong, Xiang Deng, Weili Guan, Liqiang Nie
abstract: Vision-language models achieve strong general perception but often struggle with the spatial reasoning required for embodied tasks. We present RoboSpatialBrain, our submission to the RoboSpatial Challenge at the Embodied Reasoning in Action Workshop, CVPR 2026, built on RoboBrain2.5-8B-NV. RoboSpatialBrain combines two training-free, inference-time mechanisms: a forced <think> prefix activation strategy paired with a task-specific post-prompt that elicits deliberate reasoning on context and compatibility tasks, and an explicit reference-frame redirection pipeline that resolves camera-centric and object-centric ambiguity for context tasks. We additionally explore fine-tuning RoboBrain2.5 on compatibility data and present a detailed analysis of its interaction with prompting. RoboSpatialBrain achieved first place in the RoboSpatial Challenge, with an overall success rate of 80.9\% on RoboSpatial-Home. Code is available at https://github.com/YuxiangXie2003/RoboSpatialBrain.
zh_title: CVPR 2026 RoboSpatial挑战赛技术报告：具身空间推理中的选择性推理激活与参考系消歧
translation: 视觉语言模型虽然实现了强大的通用感知，但在具身任务所需的空间推理方面往往表现吃力。我们介绍了RoboSpatialBrain，这是我们提交给CVPR 2026具身推理行动研讨会（Embodied Reasoning in Action Workshop）中RoboSpatial挑战赛的作品，基于RoboBrain2.5-8B-NV构建。RoboSpatialBrain结合了两种无需训练、推理时的机制：一种强制<think>前缀激活策略，配合引发对上下文和兼容性任务进行深思熟虑的任务特定后提示；以及一种显式的参考系重定向流水线，用于解决上下文任务中相机中心和物体中心的模糊性。此外，我们还探索了在兼容性数据上对RoboBrain2.5进行微调，并对其与提示词的交互进行了详细分析。RoboSpatialBrain在RoboSpatial挑战赛中获得第一名，在RoboSpatial-Home上的总体成功率为80.9%。代码可在https://github.com/YuxiangXie2003/RoboSpatialBrain获取。
tldr: RoboSpatialBrain通过推理时思考策略和参考系重定向技术，解决了视觉语言模型在具身任务中空间推理能力不足的问题，并在CVPR 2026挑战赛中夺冠。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了无需训练的推理时机制，通过强制思考前缀和显式参考系重定向来解决视觉语言模型在具身空间推理中的空间感知挑战。其局限性在于主要基于特定基座模型（RoboBrain2.5-8B-NV），泛化性尚需进一步验证。
motivation: 现有视觉语言模型虽然具备强大的通用感知能力，但在处理具身任务所需的复杂空间推理时表现不佳，存在上下文和兼容性理解困难及参考系模糊问题。
method: 提出RoboSpatialBrain，采用两项无需训练的推理时机制：1. 强制<think>前缀激活策略及特定任务后提示；2. 显式的参考系重定向流水线。此外，探索了基于兼容性数据的微调方法。
results: 在RoboSpatial-Home数据集上取得了80.9%的成功率，并获得了CVPR 2026 RoboSpatial挑战赛的第一名。
conclusion: RoboSpatialBrain通过结合推理时思考激活策略与参考系消歧管道，有效提升了具身智能体在空间推理任务中的表现，并在CVPR 2026 RoboSpatial挑战赛中夺冠。

title: FARS: A Fully Automated Research System Deployed at Scale
authors: Qiong Tang, Xiangkun Hu, Xiangyang Liu, Yiran Chen, Yunfan Shao
abstract: Recent automated research systems show that language-model agents can generate hypotheses, run experiments, and write complete manuscripts, but most evidence still comes from selected examples, human-framed topics, or a few pre-defined research tasks. We present FARS (Fully Automated Research System), a fully automated AI-for-AI research system designed to operate across research topics at scale. FARS autonomously generates and advances projects through ideation, planning, experimentation, and writing, using stage-specific agents coordinated through a shared workspace that records proposals, code, logs, results, and manuscripts. In its first public deployment, FARS produced 166 complete research papers spanning 67 fine-grained AI/ML topics while preserving intermediate artifacts as an auditable corpus rather than a curated set of successes. We evaluate this corpus with 282 structured reviews from volunteer reviewers covering 140 papers, including overall ratings, sub-scores, integrity checks, and LLM-use disclosure. The reviews indicate that FARS can produce review-worthy and occasionally strong AI/ML research artifacts in a large-scale public deployment, while also exposing recurring failure modes in narrow experimental scope, methodological limitations, and integrity issues.

title: Think in English, Answer in Korean: Efficient Adaptation of Multilingual Tool-Using Agents
authors: Utsav Garg, Sungjin Hong, Jason Jung, Justin Lee, Shaan Desai, Joon Hee Kim, Anirudh Shrinivason, Edmond Wen, Susie Park
abstract: We present LuckyStar 111B, a 111B-parameter hybrid reasoning model developed through a collaboration between Cohere and LG CNS for Korean-English enterprise agents under practical memory and serving constraints. The model trains from Cohere's fully post-trained Command A model rather than a new pretraining run, and uses preamble conditioning to switch between concise non-reasoning behavior and longer tool-oriented reasoning. We study four choices for scaling tool-using agents efficiently: multilingual supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for multi-step tool-use tasks, language-consistency rewards for Korean user-facing responses, and 4-bit quantization for single-GPU serving. The adapted model improves mathematical reasoning, function calling, and agentic natural-language-to-SQL (NL2SQL) performance while preserving general Korean and English instruction-following quality. These results provide a practical recipe and failure-mode analysis for adapting post-trained multilingual models to verifiable agentic workflows under memory-constrained deployment.
zh_title: 用英语思考，用韩语回答：多语言工具使用代理的高效适配
translation: 我们介绍了LuckyStar 111B，这是一款由Cohere和LG CNS合作开发的111B参数混合推理模型，旨在满足韩英企业代理在实际内存和推理约束下的需求。该模型并非从零开始预训练，而是基于Cohere完全后训练的Command A模型进行训练，并使用前导词调节（preamble conditioning）在简洁的非推理行为和较长的工具导向推理之间进行切换。我们研究了四种高效扩展工具使用代理的选择：多语言监督微调、针对多步工具使用任务的可验证奖励强化学习、针对韩语用户响应的语言一致性奖励，以及用于单GPU服务的4-bit量化。适配后的模型提高了数学推理、函数调用和代理自然语言转SQL（NL2SQL）的性能，同时保留了通用的韩语和英语指令遵循质量。这些结果为在内存受限的部署环境下，将后训练的多语言模型适配到可验证的代理工作流中提供了实用的方法和故障模式分析。
tldr: LuckyStar 111B通过高效微调与量化，在受限的计算资源下显著增强了大模型处理韩英双语工具调用及推理任务的能力。
ai_comments: 该研究在资源受限（内存和推理）的实际企业场景下，探索了大型语言模型向特定代理任务转型的可行路径。其创新点在于通过预训练模型的持续微调（而非从零训练）以及灵活的指令调节（Preamble Conditioning），实现了推理能力与多语言交互的平衡，为工业界部署高效Agent提供了极具参考价值的工程范式。
motivation: 在满足企业级内存和推理约束的条件下，开发能够高效处理韩语-英语任务的工具使用型代理模型。
method: 基于Cohere Command A模型进行持续训练，采用前导词调节（Preamble Conditioning）控制模型行为，并结合多语言监督微调、面向多步工具任务的可验证奖励强化学习、韩语反馈的语言一致性奖励，以及4-bit量化技术。
results: 模型显著提升了数学推理、函数调用和NL2SQL任务的性能，同时保持了良好的韩语和英语指令遵循能力，实现了在单GPU上的高效部署。
conclusion: LuckyStar 111B 证明了在资源受限的条件下，通过特定的多语言微调、强化学习及量化技术，可以有效提升大模型在工具调用、数学推理及NL2SQL任务中的表现，同时维持高质量的双语指令遵循能力。

title: Improving Certified Robustness via Adversarial Distillation
authors: Matteo Melis, Jesus Martinez Del Rincon, Vishal Sharma
abstract: Certified training aims to produce models whose predictions can be formally verified against adversarial perturbations, typically by optimising upper bounds on the worst-case loss over an allowed perturbation set. For neural networks, certified training methods based purely on tight relaxation bounds produce networks that are amenable to certification, but sacrifice standard accuracy. Conversely, adversarial training often yields stronger empirical robustness and standard accuracy, but the resulting models are generally difficult to certify with neural network verifiers. Recently, the literature has shown that better standard-certified accuracy trade-offs can be achieved by combining adversarial training objectives with loose over-approximations based on Interval Bound Propagation (IBP), effectively interpolating between lower and upper bounds of the worst-case loss. Building on this, we introduce AD-CERT, a certified training objective that combines adversarial distillation with an IBP upper bound. We show that distilling adversarial information over the logit space from an empirically robust teacher provides an effective lower bound surrogate for certified training, with AD-CERT achieving state-of-the-art certified performance on several robustness benchmarks. Furthermore, in a unified setup, distilling adversarial information at the logit-level is shown to improve certified accuracy over a robust feature-space distillation objective by up to 5.40 percentage points.

title: DynFly: Dynamic-Aware Continuous Trajectory Generation for UAV Vision-Language Navigation in Urban Environments
authors: Wen Jiang, Hanfang Liang, Li Wang, Kangyao Huang, Wang Xu, Wei Fan, Jinyuan Liu, Shaoyu Liu, Hongwei Duan, Bin Xu, Xiangyang Ji, Huaping Liu
abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large models have significantly improved UAV vision-language navigation (UAV-VLN) by enhancing high-level perception and reasoning. However, existing methods mainly focus on predicting discrete actions, local targets, or sparse waypoints, while the continuous transition from navigation intent to executable UAV motion remains weakly modeled. This motion-interface gap limits the continuity, stability, and executability of generated UAV trajectories. To address this gap, we propose DynFly, a dynamic-aware continuous trajectory generation framework that bridges high-level navigation reasoning and executable UAV motion. DynFly bridges high-level navigation intent and continuous UAV motion through a lightweight trajectory generation layer. Specifically, it represents expert trajectories in B-spline control-point space and employs a Spline-DiT generator to learn conditional trajectory generation via flow matching. Furthermore, we introduce UAV-oriented dynamic-aware supervision over position, finite-difference velocity, finite-difference acceleration, heading consistency, and local target alignment, enabling the generated trajectories to better satisfy UAV motion characteristics. And our trajectory generation framework can also be integrated with an existing UAV-VLN framework while preserving its original visual-language reasoning pipeline. Extensive experiments on the OpenUAV UAV-VLN benchmark show that DynFly improves both navigation performance and trajectory quality. On the Test Unseen Full split, DynFly improves the strongest baseline by 4.69 NDTW, 2.40 SDTW, 2.14 SR points and 4.87 OSR points, while reducing NE by 4.51 m.

title: Positivity-preserving dynamical low-rank methods for the Vlasov equation
authors: Katharina Kormann, Murtazo Nazarov, Junjie Wen
abstract: In this manuscript, we introduce positivity-preserving correction methods for low-rank approximations of the Vlasov equation. The key idea is to formulate structural properties, including positivity-preservation, as constraints and to seek a minimal correction term that is added to the low-rank solution, by solving a quadratic programming problem. As a result, the corrected solution satisfies the constraints and preserve these properties, while remaining close to the original low-rank solution. Two positivity-preserving schemes are proposed in this work, and one of them also preserves the total mass and momentum of the system. We apply the proposed methods to a Vlasov--Poisson and Vlasov--Poisson-BGK employing a spectral discretization in space and an explicit Runge--Kutta scheme in time. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

title: Sensitivity Lower Bounds via Locally Testable Codes
authors: Yuichi Yoshida, Zihan Zhang
abstract:
Sensitivity quantifies how far an algorithm's output can move in Hamming distance when a single input element is perturbed. We present a general scheme turning any locally testable code (LTC) into a sensitivity lower bound for the CSP encoded by the code.
  Instantiating it with the $c^3$-LTC yields a constant $\varepsilon > 0$ for which every $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm for satisfiable Max E3LIN2 has sensitivity $Ω(n)$, strengthening the previous $Ω(n^δ)$ lower bound known only for general instances. Standard reductions give an $n^{1-O(\varepsilon)}$ lower bound for $n^{-\varepsilon}$-approximation algorithms for maximum clique, and an $Ω(k)$ bound for $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithms for maximum $k$-coverage, among others. These lower bounds match trivial upper bounds and imply that even slightly stable algorithms cannot achieve these approximations.
  A second instantiation, using a simple repetition code, shows that any $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm for Max Cut on bipartite graphs has sensitivity $Ω(1/\varepsilon)$ as long as $\varepsilon = O(1/\sqrt{n})$, extending the prior result for exact algorithms (the regime $\varepsilon < 1/n$). Thus even on bipartite graphs, where a perfect cut always exists, near-optimal solutions cannot be maintained stably.
  Our sensitivity lower bounds have two applications. First, they yield averaged sensitivity lower bounds, implying that any nearly optimal randomized algorithm for Max E3SAT has linearly many output bits that, after fixing the random seed, are Boolean functions with large influence. Second, via the sensitivity-to-locality connection, they imply locality lower bounds in the non-signaling model, which generalizes $\mathsf{LOCAL}$ and quantum-$\mathsf{LOCAL}$.

title: Sparsity-Inducing Divergence Losses for Biometric Verification
authors: Dimitrios Koutsianos, Ladislav Mošner, Yannis Panagakis, Themos Stafylakis
abstract: Performance in face and speaker verification is largely driven by margin-penalty softmax losses such as CosFace and ArcFace. Recently introduced $α$-divergence loss functions offer a compelling alternative, particularly due to their ability to induce sparse solutions (when $α>1$). However, standard geometric margins are designed for the softmax function and do not naturally extend to this generalized probabilistic framework. In this paper we propose Q-Margin, a novel $α$-divergence loss that introduces a principled probabilistic margin. Unlike conventional methods that apply geometric penalties to the logits (unnormalized log-likelihoods), Q-Margin encodes the margin penalty directly into the reference measure (prior probabilities). This formulation naturally encourages discriminative embeddings while preserving the beneficial sparsity properties of the $α$-divergence. We demonstrate that Q-Margin achieves competitive or superior performance on the challenging IJB-B and IJB-C face verification benchmarks and similarly strong results in speaker verification on VoxCeleb. Crucially, against ArcFace and CosFace baselines trained under an identical recipe, Q-Margin consistently improves at low False Acceptance Rates (FARs), a capability critical for practical high-security applications. Finally, the extreme sparsity of the Q-Margin posteriors enables exact and memory-efficient training, offering a scalable solution for datasets with millions of identities.

title: ECHO: Prune to act, trace to learn with selective turn memory in agentic RL
authors: Zijun Xie, Binbin Zheng, Enlei Gong, Jihua Liu, Yuyang You, Lingfeng Liu, Jiayao Tang, Guanqun Zhao, Aoqi Hu, Zeyu Chen
abstract: Long-horizon language agents must repeatedly interact with tools, accumulate evidence, and make decisions under bounded context windows. Existing context-management methods make such rollouts feasible by truncating distant history, folding past turns into summaries, or selecting compact memory states. However, these breakthroughs introduce two coupled limitations. First, as the number of turns grows, historical observations are progressively removed or collapsed into compressed states, making it harder for the policy to reuse fine-grained evidence. Second, once the original turns are no longer source-addressable, outcome-based RL loses an explicit path for aligning policy updates with the evidence that supported a successful final answer. To this end, we propose ECHO, a selective turn-memory framework that jointly addresses history collapse and traceable learning through source-indexed reconstruction. Specifically, ECHO compresses each completed environment turn into a compact memory record, reconstructs bounded policy contexts by selecting from these records, and reuses the selected source indices to route positive outcome credit to the evidence and selection actions that support successful answers. On BrowseComp-Plus, ECHO reaches 43.4% held-out accuracy, outperforming GRPO (28.9%) and the rolling-summary baseline SUPO (36.1%), while using fewer turns and lower trajectory volume than SUPO (Figure 1). Additionally, the trained policy improves zero-shot generalization across multi-objective QA, code generation, and deep information-seeking benchmarks on both dense and MoE backbones.
zh_title: ECHO：在智能体强化学习中通过选择性回合记忆实现剪枝行动与溯源学习
translation: 长程语言智能体必须在有限的上下文窗口内重复与工具交互、积累证据并做出决策。现有的上下文管理方法通过截断远期历史、将过去的回合折叠为摘要或选择紧凑的内存状态，使得此类执行成为可能。然而，这些突破引入了两个相互关联的局限性。首先，随着回合数的增加，历史观察被逐渐移除或压缩，使得策略更难重用细粒度的证据。其次，一旦原始回合不再是源可寻址的，基于结果的强化学习就失去了将策略更新与支持成功最终答案的证据对齐的明确路径。为此，我们提出了 ECHO，一个通过源索引重构共同解决历史崩溃和可追溯学习的选择性回合记忆框架。具体而言，ECHO 将每个完成的环境回合压缩为紧凑的记忆记录，通过从这些记录中进行选择来重构有界的策略上下文，并重复使用选定的源索引将积极的结果信用路由到支持成功答案的证据和选择动作上。在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，ECHO 达到了 43.4% 的保留准确率，优于 GRPO (28.9%) 和滚动摘要基准 SUPO (36.1%)，同时使用的回合数和轨迹量比 SUPO 更少。此外，训练后的策略在密集和 MoE 主干网络上的多目标问答、代码生成和深度信息搜索基准测试中改善了零样本泛化能力。
tldr: ECHO 框架通过对交互历史进行压缩并建立溯源索引，解决了长程智能体在有限上下文下的信息丢失与归因难题，显著提升了任务准确率与泛化能力。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地提出了通过“源索引重构”来解决长程语言智能体在上下文管理中的历史信息丢失与强化学习归因困难问题。其优势在于平衡了记忆压缩与可追溯性，为长程任务中的策略优化提供了更高效的路径。局限性在于该方法可能增加了内存索引维护的复杂性。
motivation: 现有的上下文管理方法（如截断或摘要）在长程任务中会导致历史细节丢失，且使得强化学习无法将最终结果与支撑成功的具体证据进行有效对齐，限制了智能体的性能。
method: 提出 ECHO 框架，将环境交互回合压缩为紧凑的记忆记录；通过选择性记录重构策略上下文，并利用源索引将强化学习的结果奖励反向归因至支持成功的特定证据与选择操作。
results: 在 BrowseComp-Plus 基准测试中，ECHO 达到 43.4% 的准确率，优于 GRPO（28.9%）和 SUPO（36.1%），并表现出更好的零样本泛化能力。
conclusion: ECHO 框架通过选择性记忆和源索引重构，有效解决了长程语言智能体在有限上下文中的信息丢失与归因难题，显著提升了任务完成准确率及泛化能力。

title: ForecastAgentSearch: Towards a Multi-Expert Agent Search System for Geopolitical Event Forecasting
authors: Miaomiao Cai, He Chang, Yunshan Ma, See-kiong Ng
abstract: Geopolitical event forecasting is a challenging task, as it requires understanding complex regional contexts, dynamic event signals, and uncertain future outcomes. Recent advances in large language model agents provide new opportunities for building forecasting systems that can reason with diverse sources and expert perspectives. In this paper, we present \textit{ForecastAgentSearch}, a preliminary framework that formulates geopolitical event forecasting as a multi-expert agent search problem. Given a forecasting query, the system first analyzes the task context, then searches and ranks relevant expert agents based on their regional knowledge, domain expertise, reliability, and complementarity. The selected agents provide specialized analyses, which are further coordinated to generate a final forecast with explanations and uncertainty awareness. We discuss the key design challenges of agent profiling, expert retrieval, ranking, and multi-agent coordination, and outline possible evaluation protocols for future development. This work aims to provide an initial step toward searchable and reliable agent-based forecasting systems.

title: SAMBA: A Scatter-Guided Masked Bidirectional Mamba Foundation Model for SAR Target Recognition
authors: Ke Wang, Xiaoyi Pan, Zhaoyu Gu, Xiaofeng Ai, Zhiming Xu, Feng Zhao, Shunping Xiao
abstract: Synthetic aperture radar automatic target recognition (SAR ATR) is critical for Earth observation and defense, but its practical deployment is constrained by scarce annotated training data. Self-supervised pre-training alleviates this label bottleneck, yet prevailing Transformer architectures incur prohibitive quadratic computational complexity, and conventional universal masking neglects the unique electromagnetic scattering properties intrinsic to SAR imagery. To address these limitations, we propose SAMBA (Scattering-Guided Bidirectional Mamba), an efficient self-supervised pre-training foundation model for SAR target interpretation. Our framework features three core innovations: (i) a linear-complexity Mamba encoder with a mid-sequence class token to mitigate computational bottlenecks; (ii) a three-level hierarchical Scattering-Guided Masked Autoencoder (SG-MAE) masking strategy guided by SAR physical priors, aligning the pretext task with SAR's intrinsic imaging mechanism; (iii) a lightweight SpatialMix feature interaction module to enhance cross-region feature fusion. We also design a two-stage cross-domain pre-training pipeline to optimize the overall pre-training process. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that SAMBA consistently delivers superior performance across all pre-training configurations, with substantially fewer parameters than both CNN and Transformer baselines. Compared with the default masking strategy in standard MAE, the proposed SG-MAE strategy further boosts the model's few-shot transfer capability. Benchmarking on seven downstream datasets covering classification and detection tasks shows SAMBA achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on most metrics, fully validating its robust generalizability across diverse SAR interpretation tasks. Source code and pre-trained weights are publicly available at https://github.com/mynswkk/SAMBA.

title: Practical High-Fidelity Novel-View Synthesis of Mounted Lepidoptera
authors: Kristof Overdulve, Lode Jorissen, Nick Michiels
abstract: Mounted butterflies are among the most striking objects in natural history collections. However, their beauty is notoriously hard to digitize in 3D: they are small and fragile, with microscopic hairs and vein structures. Capturing them in sufficient detail, therefore, requires a macro lens, which has a very limited Depth of Field (DoF). Moreover, a camera body cannot be maneuvered beneath a pinned specimen to photograph its ventral surface (the underside of the wings). We introduce an end-to-end pipeline that resolves these challenges to turn such specimens into photo-realistic 3D models viewable from every direction. It combines three ingredients: handheld focus stacking for all-in-focus macro capture without a tripod, a non-contact first-surface mirror system that exposes the ventral surface without touching the specimen, and a segmentation-free, mirror-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting extension. We validate the reconstructions on four diverse specimens.

title: WorldRoamBench: An Open-World Benchmark for Long-Horizon Stability of Interactive World Models
authors: Ting-Bing Xu, Jiacheng Sui, Zhe Gao, Kewei Shi, Wenjin Yang, Zhicheng Liu, Zhaoxu Sun, Mingchao Sun, Hongyu Pan, Fan Jiang, Mu Xu, Qi Fan, Yong Li, Baoquan Chen
abstract: Despite rapid progress in interactive world models (IWMs), existing benchmarks evaluate action following only at trajectory level and ignore memory and interaction physics. We introduce WorldRoamBench, an open-world benchmark for long-horizon stability across four dimensions, each with tailored innovations: (i) Action: per-frame action metric bypassing cross-model semantic scale disparity and exposing failures hidden by trajectory; (ii) Vision: segment-based drift metric capturing non-monotonic mid-sequence collapse missed by start-vs-end comparisons; (iii) Physics: controllability-gated evaluation over mechanics, optics, and 3D consistency, scoring plausibility under faithful action execution; (iv) Memory: action-decoupled protocol evaluating scene memory via transition-localized 3D point-cloud reconstruction and subject memory via tracking-plus-VLM reasoning. The benchmark comprises 600+ test cases across Nature, Urban, and Indoor scenes in first/third-person views with WASD 10-60s continuous interaction. Evaluating 10+ open/closed-source models reveals none reliably satisfies all dimensions; even the best achieves only moderate scores. Advances on WorldRoamBench are steps toward IWMs that are stable, physically grounded, memory-faithful, and deployable in real-world applications.

title: REDI: Corpus Aware Patch Ranking for DINOv3 Token Reduction
authors: Chanjong Im, Sebastian Diem, Thomas Mandl
abstract:
Most token reduction methods for Vision Transformers seek favorable tradeoffs between accuracy and efficiency by pruning, merging, or pooling patch tokens. REDI (Relevance for DINOv3 Token Reduction) studies this question through a controlled supervised reference: how should a fixed token budget be allocated across patches for image classification? REDI quantizes final block DINOv3 patch representations into a visual vocabulary and derives class conditioned corpus scores using supervised TF-IDF over visual words. For each validation image, the ground truth class selects a row of the TF-IDF table, and four transformed views produce a TF-IDF map aligned to a reference center crop. A separate dense pass on the same crop provides an attention map. After independent min max normalization, their elementwise product defines the REDI score. A fixed keep, merge, and compress operator then uses score rank to assign patch roles and score magnitude to weight merging and compression.
  With precomputed REDI scores, a frozen DINOv3 ViT-B/16 backbone, and the same linear classifier used for dense evaluation, the operator reduces the sequence length from 201 to 107 tokens, a 46.8% sequence reduction. The REDI variant based on incoming attention mass achieves 84.706% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K, compared with 83.514% for the dense baseline, 82.634% for incoming attention mass alone, and 81.796% for supervised TF-IDF alone. The same corpus term also improves reduced classification for three alternative attention formulations relative to their attention only counterparts. Together, these controlled comparisons indicate that class specific corpus statistics and image specific attention provide complementary signals for patch ranking in this setting.

title: ShellMaker: Language-Guided Exterior Completion under Structural Constraints
authors: Ruiqi Xu, Daniel Aliaga
abstract: Despite advances in indoor scene generation, synthesizing coherent building exteriors consistent with generated interiors remains largely unexplored. Existing methods can generate floor plans and wall layouts but typically stop at a structural shell, lacking stylistically consistent facades and roofs. Completing these exteriors is challenging because the footprint, wall geometry, and opening semantics must remain fixed-constraints that unconstrained generative models often violate. We introduce ShellMaker, a language-guided exterior completion framework that operates under these structural constraints. Given a building scaffold and a text style prompt, ShellMaker generates a complete exterior mesh with PBR materials by combining parametric roof generation, LLM-based part-aware prompt refinement, joint wall-roof material retrieval, and geometry-aware assembly. Operating on a format agnostic scaffold representation, ShellMaker generalizes to indoor generators, CityGML, and CAD inputs, while maintaining structural consistency and improving architectural coherence over retrieval and unconstrained generative baselines. The project page is available at https://ruiqixu37.github.io/ShellMaker_web/
